jobs.title: Product Owner, SME Banking Digital
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Owner to lead the transformation of ideas into seamless, intuitive product experiences. The ideal candidate excels in planning, designing, scaling, and commercializing products, with a proven ability to test, validate, and optimize throughout the product lifecycle.
  
  
This role requires a strong client focus and business acumen to effectively prioritize and deliver on competing demands. You will inspire and influence cross-functional teams to achieve positive outcomes with executional excellence. If you are a creative problem solver who thrives on tackling complex challenges and building products from inception to scale, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Key responsibilities include product management, governance, and commercialization activities to support client channel onboarding and the development of scalable digital solutions. Additionally, you will serve as a key point of contact for education, thought leadership, and product expertise related to client channel onboarding.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives, addressing key strategic issues and functional architecture in close collaboration with business, operations, and technology teams, with a focus on shaping and executing the client channel onboarding strategy to achieve business objectives.
* Ensure alignment of channel onboarding product goals with overall business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Drive the implementation of digital solutions across the channel onboarding domain and operations, fostering ongoing partnerships with internal stakeholders and clients.
* Facilitate business change management and process design by developing and reviewing detailed software/functional requirements and process flow diagrams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, communicating project progress to Senior Sponsors, Business Sponsors, Steering Committees, and the Program Management Office as appropriate.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for S2B channel onboarding to senior stakeholders and team members.
* Stay abreast of industry trends, technological advancements, and best practices within the channel onboarding domain.
* Leverage innovative solutions to enhance operational efficiency and client satisfaction

**Business**

* As the product owner, responsible for crafting the product’s vision, roadmap, and maximizing the delivery of business value in SME CADM.
* Collaborate closely with channel operations team, business units, product owners and IT resources throughout all stages of project life cycle - including investigation, analysis, design, development, testing, and implementations - to ensure business requirements are successfully implemented.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPI’s) to measure the success of various initiatives
* Institutionalize innovative ideas to accelerate the Bank’s digital footprint.

**Processes**

* Manage the Book of Work, ensuring effective prioritization and alignment with stakeholder timelines.
* Oversee and streamline processes related to information controls, productivity, and regional/country enhancements, including workflows and procedures.
* Manage the product backlog and collaborate with technology teams to digitize client and internal operational workflows for onboarding.
* Review and approve use case scenarios and test cases; coordinate and support user acceptance testing and production verification.
* Ensure governance and compliance with all bank risk assessments and policies.
* Own and approve CADM data usage and define/manage data access for CADM users; strategize and implement identity and access management applications, ensuring no toxic access.
* Collaborate with regional and country digital teams to gather product customizations, facilitate country adoption, and support documentation, guidelines, and training for identity and access management tools.
* Collect and analyze data to inform product direction and define enhancements to attract new clients.
* Deliver the digital strategy for client channel onboarding, ensuring global scalability while accommodating local requirements.
* Act as a people influencer and product owner to deliver proof of concepts and execute incubation ideas across business lines and locations, ensuring governance and controls.
* Develop and implement plans to increase awareness of digital transformation within client channel onboarding.
* Define and drive training programs to enhance digital automation capabilities among channel operations staff and stakeholders.
* Identify and address inefficiencies in channel operations, proposing workflow optimizations.
* Leverage data analysis to inform decisions and improve operational metrics.
* Identify and mitigate risks in channel operations.
* Partner with operations and business units to streamline processes, mitigate risks, and drive efficiencies.
* Measure and evaluate outcomes of change initiatives post-implementation.
* Assess the impact of process changes to ensure no additional manual touchpoints are introduced.

**People & Talent**
The role is not a people leader role however the role involves coordination between multiple parties
  
  

* Work Closely with channel operations team, business teams, peer product owners, engineering lead, architects to define and implement Solutions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams for successful implementation and deployment of client channel onboarding capabilities
* Engage actively with legal and compliance to raise awareness of new product features and secure acceptance of the changes.

**Risk Management**

* Ensure adherence to risk management framework.
* Act as the risk control owner under the Group’s risk management framework at the appropriate level.
* Ensure that bank is not exposed to risks due to client channel onboarding data management by enforcing role-based access control, embed market specific data localization as part of the product design.

**Governance**

* Aligning with new Ways of Working Management Standards (nWOWS)
* Oversee & track implementation timelines, resolve impediments / blockers, ensure change communication & transition
* Good understanding of change management and project management
* Identify, analyse, prepare risk mitigation tactics and manage anticipated resistances
* Good understanding of ADO dashboard, key metrices and functions

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Lead to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Operations team
* IAM team
* Business Stakeholders across Cash, Trade, Financial Markets
* Channel product owners across Cash, Trade, Financial Markets
* Technology team
* DCS management team
* Agile Coach

**Skills And Experience**

* Strong business and product expertise on user entitlements and client onboarding
* Product Owner experience
* Understanding of product development lifecycle
* Strong project management and planning skills, including organizational & time management skills
* Clarity of communication style and ability to face off against senior stakeholders
* Digital Transformation

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in banking, with a strong focus on managing digital channels; experience in Fintech environments is highly desirable.
* At least 5 years of hands-on experience in identity and access management or channel onboar

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Bright Money**

Bright Money is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products to help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and get access to suitable loans and credit cards. These are the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck-to-paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with a financial service marketplace revenues, for loans, credit cards, and credit building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by 3 top global venture capital firms, and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was founded in 2019 by a founding team from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi Data Scientists (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, recently joined by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright is a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture that will build a Global Consumer FinTech, all functions operating from India.'

**What is the team & role about?**

We are hiring a Platform Product Manager - Banking Platform to own and scale core banking and money-movement platform capabilities that power multiple financial products. This role focuses on bank account lifecycles, payment rails, partner integrations, and regulatory-ready infrastructure, enabling product teams to build reliably and at scale.

This is a senior product leadership role combining deep platform ownership, people management, executive-level communication, and structured problem-solving. You will operate as a trusted partner to Engineering leadership and CXOs, translating complex technical and regulatory challenges into clear decisions and execution plans.

**What will you do?**

**Product Ownership & Strategy**

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one or more Banking Services platform domains (e.g., account onboarding, verification, bank transfers, settlements).
* Define clear product goals, success metrics, and trade-offs across reliability, compliance, and feature delivery.
* Manage the full product lifecycle—from discovery and requirements to launch, adoption, and optimization.

**Banking Infrastructure & Money Movement**

* Drive platform capabilities supporting bank account lifecycles and money movement (e.g., ACH equivalents, local bank transfers, instant payments, reconciliation workflows).
* Lead integrations with banking partners, payment processors, and financial infrastructure providers.
* Ensure strong handling of edge cases such as failures, retries, reversals, exceptions, and settlements.

**Compliance, Risk & Resilience**

* Translate regulatory, scheme, and partner constraints into clear platform requirements (e.g., auditability, controls, data retention, reporting).
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Operations to ensure controls are embedded into platform design.
* Drive platform resilience designing for partner outages, degraded modes, and recovery scenarios.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Write high-quality PRDs and platform requirements that engineers can execute against with clarity.
* Prioritize across run-the-business work, platform improvements, and new enablement initiatives.
* Lead cross-functional execution across multiple engineering teams.

**Stakeholder & Internal Customer Experience**

* Act as the product owner for internal consumers of the platform (Product, Engineering, Ops).
* Improve developer and internal product team experience through clear APIs, documentation, and self-serve capabilities.
* Communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly to senior leadership.

**Ideal candidate profile looks like?**

**Experience & Background:**

* 5 - 12 years of Product Management experience, with strong exposure to backend, platform, or infrastructure products.
* Prior people management experience, including mentoring or managing Product Managers
* Exposure to high-scale, high-availability systems with strict SLAs.
* Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud architectures.
* Strong systems thinking and technical fluency, comfortable working deeply with engineers on architecture and trade-offs.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Experience defining and using KPIs/OKRs to drive prioritization and outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proven ability to manage complex dependencies and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Non-Fit Profiles:**

* Domain experts without Platform Ownership experience.
* PMs from Low-Scale or Low-Reliability Environments.
* Product Managers without deep technical depth.
* Pure UI/ UX-First Product Managers.
* Program Manager or Project Managers.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience building internal platforms or developer-facing products.
* Exposure to global-scale, high-availability systems.
* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or other regulated systems.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale – liquidity potential at $1–3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You run your own BU with an independent P&L.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Location flexibility: 5 days from the Bangalore office in a week

Principal Product Manager, Core Network
jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Part Of**
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
  
  
****What you'll be responsible for****
You will own the product strategy and evolution of the CPN Payments Engine — the core infrastructure that powers payment creation, routing, settlement, and lifecycle management across the network. You’ll define the long-term vision and roadmap for the engine, identifying opportunities to expand its capabilities while improving reliability, performance, and scale. Working across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and commercial teams, you’ll lead complex product decisions and investments that enable OFIs and BFIs to move money efficiently across an expanding set of corridors and rails, translating platform improvements into measurable network and business outcomes.
  
  
****What you'll work on****

* Set the Payments Engine strategy: Own the long-term product vision and roadmap for payment creation, processing, routing, and settlement, aligning investments with CPN and Circle priorities.
* Advance payment performance at scale: Establish the product strategy for improving success rates, latency, resilience, and processing efficiency, using data to identify systemic opportunities and prioritize investments.
* Evolve API and protocol capabilities: Define the direction for OFI Payments APIs and BFI quoting and settlement protocols, balancing developer experience, interoperability, compliance, scalability, and network reliability.
* Expand the capabilities of the network: Identify and lead investments that unlock new payment use cases, corridors, rails, and partner capabilities while building reusable infrastructure that scales across the network.
* Shape observability and operational control: Define product capabilities for monitoring, alerting, exception management, and operational tooling that improve visibility into payment health and enable faster resolution of network issues.
* Lead complex cross-functional decisions: Partner with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, BD, and other product leaders to navigate architectural and business trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and drive alignment on high-impact investments.
* Establish product leadership for payment infrastructure: Develop frameworks, metrics, and product practices that improve decision-making across CPN, mentor other product managers, and serve as a subject matter expert on payment infrastructure across Circle.

****What you'll bring to Circle****
****Core requirements****

* 10+ years of relevant experience, including significant Product Management experience building payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure products.
* Deep experience owning platform or infrastructure products such as APIs, payment processing systems, settlement platforms, routing systems, or developer-facing capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to define product strategy and lead highly complex initiatives spanning multiple engineering and cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical and technical fluency, with the ability to use payment performance, reliability, and operational data to identify systemic issues and guide product investment decisions.
* Track record of delivering measurable improvements to large-scale systems, including reliability, success rates, latency, scalability, operational efficiency, or customer outcomes.
* Ability to evaluate complex technical and business trade-offs and translate them into clear product decisions, priorities, and long-term platform investments.
* Strong cross-functional influence and communication skills, including the ability to build alignment with senior leaders and stakeholders across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and commercial teams.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Deep knowledge of payment networks, cross-border payments, settlement systems, correspondent banking, stablecoins, or blockchain-based financial infrastructure.
* Experience with enterprise API products, two-sided networks, and compliance-forward payment systems, including concepts such as SLAs, payment lifecycle events, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or the Travel Rule.

**This role is based in our Bangalore office and requires employees to work from the office on a regular basis.**
*Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.*
*Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.*
We are an
**equal opportunity employer**
. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.
  
  
*Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to*
*accommodations@circle.com*
*for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.*

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager  – Digital Assets
jobs.description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
  
  
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
  
  
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
  
  
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.
  
  
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.
  
  
**About The Role**
Nium moves billions in payments every month for some of the world’s most demanding companies — banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms operating across 100+ countries. We built that on fiat rails. The next layer is digital currency: stablecoins, on/off-ramps, and card products that let customers spend, settle, and move value in USDC as naturally as they do in dollars or euros.
  
  
We’re hiring a Staff PM – Digital Assets to own that build. Not the strategy document — the actual product. If you’ve shipped a stablecoin wallet, a crypto-funded card, or a fiat-to-digital conversion flow and you understand what it takes to get that through compliance, engineering, and go-live in a regulated environment, this is your rol
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own stablecoin-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it
* Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line
* Design and ship on/off-ramp flows — fiat-to-digital and digital-to-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience
* Drive stablecoin-based cross-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production-grade
* Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy
* Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required
* You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck
* Strong payments foundation — cross-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it
* Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no-go decisions
* Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against
* Comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign-off

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins + payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
* Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin-funded card products
* On/off-ramp conversion rate and time-to-settlement
* Time-to-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
* Regulatory coverage: number of markets with compliant, live digital asset product

**What We Offer At Nium**
**We Value Performance:**
Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.
  
  
**We Care for Our Employees:**
The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our discretionary year-end shut down (dependant on company OKRs). We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).
  
  
**We Upskill Ourselves:**
We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.
  
  
**We Celebrate Together:**
We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!
  
  
**We Thrive with Diversity:**
Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.
  
  
**Beware of recruitment scams:**
Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites.
**Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**
. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Product Design Manager - UX, Product Design
jobs.description:
**About PhonePe Limited:**
Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.
  
  
PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode - hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.
  
  
**Culture:**
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
Custom description
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
We're looking for a strategic, highly structured Lead Product Designer / Design Manager to head the design for our Payment Gateway and Web Platforms pod. You'll own the end-to-end design strategy for this scope, bring operational clarity to complex, multi-quarter projects, and lead and grow a team of 4–5 designers.
  
  
This is a high-leverage role. The Payment Gateway is how online businesses accept payments through PhonePe — the experience you design is felt by merchants and, downstream, by every customer who pays them. The details are hard, the constraints are real, and the work directly moves the business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities (Competencies & Role Expectations)**

* Co-own Product Roadmaps: Work closely with leadership to understand the overarching business vision and translate it into actionable, design-first GTM strategies for our Payment Gateway and Web Platforms.
* Mentorship & Team Structuring: Manage, mentor, and scale a pod of 4-5 designers. Pivot effectively from individual contribution to strategic delegation—optimizing team structures, guiding career growth, and overseeing the quality of hires.
* Influence & Partner: Build deep trust with business unit leadership. Operate as a "first team" with leaders by helping them achieve their functional goals through design. Proactively resolve conflicts and align stakeholders toward common objectives.
* Build to Learn: Direct intuitive product architecture with a strong “build to learn” mindset. Emphasize continuous prototyping, synthesize insights from usability testing, and weave them into the core product strategy.
* Drive Measurable Outcomes: Define North Star metrics for your features and utilize data to form actionable insights. Ensure that design outputs directly influence business revenue and deliver measurable results.
* Holistic Architecture: Direct the team to take a holistic view of the product ecosystem, employing journey maps and service blueprints to align stakeholders and improve end-to-end service delivery.
* Orchestrate Complex Delivery: Own the planning, triaging, and delivery of multiple large, complex projects spanning across quarters. Balance competing priorities and tactically unblock teams to deliver work faster.
* Elevate Visual Systems: Deliver best-in-class, cohesive visual experiences by unifying design systems, motion, and UX copy. Foster tight feedback loops between graphics, creative, and product design teams.
* Technical Synergy: Translate complex technical/backend capabilities into highly scalable, delightful, and user-friendly interfaces, ensuring designs exploit technical constraints to enable speed and security.
* High-Quality Handoffs: Leverage your deep understanding of frontend systems and code as a medium. Deploy robust processes for smooth, repeatable engineering handoffs through high-touch communication and clear documentation.

**Qualifications**
**What We’re Looking For**

* 7–10 years of product design experience, with real ownership of complex enterprise, B2B, or fintech platforms.
* 1–2 years managing and scaling direct reports — you've grown designers, not just reviewed their work.
* Proven craft: A portfolio that shows depth: interaction design, visual rigor, and clear reasoning behind each decision.
* Technical acumen: Deep comfort navigating technical constraints to design scalable, developer-friendly interfaces. You speak engineering's language.
* Systems thinking: You design for the whole product and are fluent with design systems — when to extend one and when to break from it.
* Strong communication: You write clear UX copy, make a tight case for a direction, and give direct, useful feedback. You manage stakeholders without losing the user's point of view.

**Design Microsite Link : https://design.phonepe.com/**

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Jupiter**

Jupiter is a money app for people who are building their lives in India. From one app you can open a savings account with our partner bank, pay on UPI, save towards goals in Pots, borrow, buy insurance, invest, and see where your money actually goes. Our Edge+ CSB Bank RuPay credit card works on UPI and earns Jewels, our rewards currency, on the brands people already shop with.

We are a product company at heart. We obsess over small details, we read what customers tell us, and we would rather do fewer things properly than many things badly.

**Why this role exists**

AI is already part of how Jupiter works. Our product team uses an in-house assistant that reads our Confluence, Figma, Amplitude, Databricks and support tickets to answer questions and draft PRDs, right inside Slack. Engineering has a bot that turns a Jira ticket into a draft pull request. Marketing has a creative studio that designs ads, critiques its own work against a checklist and tells us what every run cost.

Those started as tools for us. The next step is bigger: putting AI in front of customers in a product that handles their money, where a confident wrong answer is not a small bug. We are looking for a PM who wants to own that problem, with the judgement to know where AI helps and the discipline to prove it before it ships.

**What you will do**

* **Find the problems worth solving with AI.**
  Explaining a declined payment, making sense of a card bill, help that actually closes the ticket, a Money tab that answers questions in plain words. You will also say no to the ideas where a better screen would do the job.
* **Own products end to end.**
  Problem, PRD, evals, launch, and the numbers after launch. You stay with it until it works for customers, not until it is merged.
* **Write the evals before the feature.**
  Define what good looks like with real examples, build the test sets with engineering, and decide the score that is good enough to ship. When the model changes, you know within a day whether things got better or worse.
* **Design for the moments AI gets it wrong.**
  What the assistant says when it does not know, when it hands over to a person, and how a customer corrects it. These moments decide whether people trust us.
* **Keep it safe and compliant.**
  Work with compliance, risk and our partner banks so everything we build respects RBI guidelines, the DPDP Act and our partners' policies. Customer data stays where it belongs.
* **Treat cost and speed as product decisions.**
  Know what each conversation costs, pick the right model for each job, and cut what does not earn its keep.
* **Raise the bar for the whole team.**
  Help other PMs, designers and analysts use AI well in their own work, and keep improving the internal tools they already rely on.

**Your first 90 days**

* **By day 30:**
  you use Jupiter every day, have read a few hundred support conversations, have sat with ops and compliance, and know our internal AI tools by using them.
* **By day 60:**
  you have picked one customer problem, made the case for it with real data, and put a working prototype in front of colleagues.
* **By day 90:**
  you have an eval set, a launch plan with guardrails, and a small rollout to real customers with one clear success metric.

**You will do well here if you**

* Have 4 to 8 years in product, with at least one AI or ML product shipped to real users. A demo does not count; something people used does.
* Can explain in plain words how language models fail (making things up, prompt injection, behaviour shifting between model versions) and how you would design around each.
* Are comfortable writing prompts, reading a model's outputs in bulk and spotting the pattern in what went wrong.
* Use data without being asked. You can write SQL, build a funnel in Amplitude, and tell a real change from noise.
* Write clearly. Your PRDs are short, specific and something an engineer can build from.
* Care about the person on the other side of the screen, especially when the subject is their money.

**Good to have**

* Experience in fintech, payments, lending or another regulated space.
* You have built with the Claude or OpenAI APIs yourself, even on a side project.
* Hands-on time with retrieval (RAG), agents that use tools, or eval tooling.
* You can sketch a flow in Figma before a designer picks it up.

**What you will work with**

* Claude and other frontier models through our AI gateway, and MCP to connect agents to our systems.
* Amplitude, Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Figma and Sense UI, our design system.
* A React Native app, and engineers, designers and analysts who like to move quickly and measure what they ship.

**How we work**

* Small teams own outcomes, not tickets.
* Decisions are written down with the reasoning, so anyone can pick up the thread later.
* We are honest about results. If a launch did not work, we say so and fix it.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Aspora**
People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.
  
  
Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.
  
  
We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.
  
  
**About The Role**
People build lives across borders, and Aspora helps the Indian diaspora send money home and grow wealth in India. Growth here is won in a user’s first three months: a friend’s referral, a first transfer, a return next month. This role exists to turn that journey into a growth engine that compounds with every new cohort. You will own growth for our product, working closely with design, engineering, data and our CLM team.
  
  
You decide which bets to make, how big they should be, and when to stop one that isn’t working. What you build will shape how fast Aspora grows, and the growth playbook we take into every new market
  
  
Location
  
  
In Office || Bangalore
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* This is a role with full ownership of the journey at the heart of Aspora’s core business.
* Diagnose where growth leaks. Go deep into funnels on every launch and older bet, and publish insights the whole team acts on.
* Own the number and the path. Check the numbers daily, hold a clear view on opportunity areas, and open new growth threads.
* Grow referral and activation. Ship reward constructs and product bets that bring more users in and get them to a first transfer.
* Make new users stay. Lift retention in the first three months by turning a first transfer into a monthly habit.
* Size every bet to matter. Set the payback before launch, read the result honestly, and call it early when a bet isn’t working.
* Build trust after every transfer. Shape the post-transfer experience so customers feel informed and in control, even when timing slips.

What We’re Looking For
  
  
You’re not someone who measures a quarter by features shipped. You measure it by the number you moved, and you can show exactly how.
  
  

* You’ve moved a growth number. You owned an acquisition, activation or retention metric in a consumer app and can walk through what moved it.
* You live in the data. You write your own SQL or analytics queries and read an experiment properly: control groups, sample checks, significance.
* You’ve run rewards with a payback. You designed referral, cashback or incentive programmes with the unit economics worked out before launch.
* You ship experiments end to end. Hypothesis, launch, readout and the next iteration, more than once, on dates you agreed and kept.
* You go to the source. You’ve turned user calls, session replays or research into a product decision that changed what shipped.
* You know consumer products. You’ve built product or growth at a consumer app, and Indian consumer fintech experience is a strong plus.
* You own the goal, not the task. You hold the number, the path to it and the next thread to pull, without waiting to be asked.
* Most importantly, you want a number that is clearly yours, in a business where every cohort you keep compounds.

Why Aspora?
  
  

* Own growth end to end, the core of Aspora’s business, with a number that is clearly yours.
* Set the growth playbook Aspora carries into new markets and the products we build on top of remittance.
* Full ownership from day one, not a slice of someone else’s roadmap.
* Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and ESOPs aligned with Aspora’s long-term vision.

* Highly motivated, energetic, thorough, detail oriented with proven ability to lead projects.

* Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions.

The Business Analyst-Technical plays an important role within RTP International, supporting the definition, prioritisation, and delivery of technology capabilities across our markets.

The role combines technical product management and business analysis responsibilities with ownership of feature and user story definition, as well as active participation in backlog management and quarterly planning ceremonies.

  **features, user stories, use cases and acceptance criteria**
  .
* Maintain feature/user story
  **data quality**
  ensuring they are validated, mapped, and aligned to strategic objectives, with technical dependencies, customer outcomes, and delivery milestones captured.

  **team ceremonies**
  such as daily standups, sprint demo, and retrospective meetings, amongst others.
* Maintain
  **alignment**
  between technical requirements, and product outcomes throughout the feature lifecycle.

  **prioritisation and trade-off decisions**
  based on business / technology value, risk, and delivery capacity.

  **feature and technical documentation**

  activities across RTP International, working across relevant workstreams and cross-functional stakeholder groups.

  **feature dependencies, delivery risks, and cross-market outcomes**
  .

Partner with stakeholders to provide accurate, concise, and decision-focused data across your assigned domain in RTP International to the agility enablement team and technology backlog management colleagues to support reporting, including:

  intake, status, trends, and prioritisation.
* **QP Planning**
  committed and uncommitted outcomes
* **OKR**
  progress and achievement
* **Vulnerability**
  status and remediation progress
* **TIMS**
  progress and exceptions

Use reporting not only to communicate status, but to

.

  **3-6 years of experience**

* Excellent analytical, communication, problem-solving, and documentation skills with tools such as
  **JIRA and Confluence**
  .
* Strong experience in
  **requirements elicitation, business process analysis, stakeholder management, and solution definition**
  .
* Expertise in writing
  **BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications**
  .
* Good understanding of
  **REST APIs, microservices, system integrations, databases (Oracle/DB2/SQL), and enterprise application architecture**
  .

  , facilitating backlog grooming, sprint planning, UAT, and release activities.

  .
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
* Attention to detail with a commitment to producing high-quality results.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.

Nice to Have :

  **Java/Spring Boot, React, or similar technologies**
  .

Our solutions streamline all working capital-related processes, including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Cash Flow Management, and Treasury, across both cloud and SAP environments.
  
  
Our 10+ hubs across Europe, North America, and India support over 2,800 clients worldwide, reflecting the trust we've built with a diverse global community.
  
  
Join us as we lead the future of finance automation!
  
  
**Role Summary:**
We are looking for a Technical Product Owner to sit at the intersection of engineering and product for our Credit & Risk suite. This role is for someone who can go deep into ABAP, RAP and Fiori technical topics to design and guide developers, write Epics and User Stories that developers and QA can implement and test without ambiguity, and — when dedicated QA capacity is limited — test the functionality themselves. Prior Product Owner experience is not required as long as strong Project Management and Agile delivery skills are in place.
  
  
The person will work closely with the Product Manager to understand, follow, and contribute to the Roadmap, and will collaborate in depth with customers, external credit agencies, Solution Architects, and Consulting to explain the product, gather feedback, and turn it into actionable backlog items
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deep-dive into technical topics in SAP ABAP, RAP and Fiori to design solutions and guide developers through implementation.
* Write clear, well-structured Epics and User Stories that are easy for developers and QA to implement and test.
* Perform hands-on testing / QA yourself for critical items when dedicated QA capacity is limited.
* Understand, follow, and actively contribute to the product Roadmap set by the Product Manager.
* Collaborate in depth with customers, external credit agencies, Solution Architects, and Consulting teams — explaining the product, capturing feedback, and translating it into requirements.
* Bring significant/strategic topics to the Product Manager for joint discussion and decision-making.
* Apply a working understanding of SAP functional processes and Finance tables to ground technical decisions in real business context.
* Demonstrate excellent communication, active listening, and critical reasoning across technical and non-technical audiences.

**Must-Have:**

* Hands-on technical experience with SAP ABAP, RAP and Fiori/UI5 — enough to design solutions and guide developers, not just review code.
* Strong Project Management / Agile delivery skills (Scrum, sprint planning, Backlog management) — Product Owner title/experience is not mandatory if this is solid.
* Basic understanding of SAP functional processes; exposure to Finance tables (e.g. BSEG, BSID, Credit Management tables) is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated ability to write Epics and User Stories that developers and QA can pick up and implement/test with minimal back-and-forth.
* Willingness and ability to personally execute QA/Testing when QA capacity is constrained.
* Proven experience collaborating directly with customers, partners, or external agencies — explaining a product and incorporating feedback.
* Excellent communication and active-listening skills, with strong critical reasoning to navigate ambiguous, technical, and business conversations alike.

**Good-to-Have:**

* Prior experience as a Product Owner or in a similar product/technical-lead role.
* Domain exposure to Credit Management, Credit Risk, Order to Cash (O2C), or Accounts Receivable.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA (or ECC-to-S/4HANA migration context).
* Familiarity with JIRA/Confluence or similar Agile tooling for Epics/Story and Roadmap management.
* Exposure to integrations with external credit bureaus/agencies (e.g. credit reporting or credit insurance providers). Exposure to AI/ML-driven features such as credit exposure or risk-prediction models.
* Prior experience working with Solution Architects and Consulting teams in a customer-facing capacity.

* Own the vision and the roadmap :
* Turn the company vision into a product strategy and a roadmap the whole company can plan against.
* Help us prioritize opportunities as we expand the product, go up-market, and explore new possibilities.

* Track RBI, NHB and CERSAI direction and public infrastructure such as ULI, and build ahead of it instead of reacting to it.
* Sit in on key enterprise deals and renewals, and bring back what the product needs to win the next one.
* Ship, hands-on :
* Write specs, prototype with AI tools and review output quality yourself. This is a player-coach role.
* Partner with Engineering, Data Acquisition and Data Science to balance speed with platform reliability and compliance-grade accuracy.
* Make AI a product advantage : document understanding in 14 languages, title reasoning and automated risk signals that a credit officer can trust and audit.
* Drive adoption and ARR with GTM and Sales :
* Co-own adoption and ARR targets with the Sales and GTM leads. A product is not shipped until customers are using it and paying for it.
* Work on positioning, messaging and launch content, so the market understands what each product does and why it matters to a lender.
* Equip Sales and Customer Success with demos, proof points, ROI cases and competitive answers, and join key pitches, renewals and expansion conversations.

* Leverage experience in B2B SaaS to make informed decisions around monetization, pricing, and product enhancements that help grow ARR and ACV.
* Lead and grow the team :
* Hire, coach and raise the bar for product managers and designers.
* Set a lightweight operating rhythm for discovery, prioritization, releases and feedback loops with Sales and Delivery.
* Represent product to the board, investors, customers and ecosystem partners.
* Foster a culture of low ego, high impact, and continuous learning.

* 10+ years in product management, including 3+ years leading product managers.
* You have owned a B2B platform, API or data product end to end and scaled it from early traction to a large customer base.

More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Possess a solid understanding of Trading, Rebalancing, and OMS systems used in the US and European wealth management industry. You understand trading products in terms of their users, business value, technical landscape, data, vendors, and can relate these to other areas of the Addepar ecosystem
* Document and communicate goals for the product and drive an innovative product roadmap that conveys the team vision and goals to our clients
* Build consensus with the team to prioritize and define increments of work based on level of effort, interdependencies, and other relevant criteria
* Assist in adjusting strategy in response to changing company, business, market, and technical needs.
* Identify appropriate users, partners, competitors, and market trends from which to elicit input and draw inspiration

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of relevant work experience and education in product management, software development, user workflows, and efficiently leading teams
* Fundamental knowledge in finance, trading, and investments, specifically with trading for wealth management firms
* Ability to communicate finance domain knowledge, problems and knowledge well both in person and in writing for internal development and sales teams as well for clients and 3rd party data partners
* Ability to partner with engineering to define the functional and technical implementation to tackle a business problem. This includes understanding of high level data development concepts, data modelling and the ability to write and review technical requirements documents
* Practical knowledge of agile thinking and lean practices; project management, and a strong ability to guide teams through project iterations
* A superpower for identifying the appropriate tools, people and techniques to accomplish objectives

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

**Job Summary**

The Digital Analytics Manager will support enterprise digital analytics operations by translating Business Measurement Requirements (BRDs) into Solution Design Reference (SDRs) including data-layer design, web tagging, validation, governance, and reporting solutions. The role partners with marketing, legal privacy, IT, development teams, platform owners, and external agencies to implement and sustain reliable analytics across websites and digital experiences. * Implement and enhance website and application analytics using Adobe Analytics, Adobe Data Collection/Launch, Adobe Data Layer patterns, events, variables, report suites, segments, and calculated metrics.

* Perform stage and production QA/UAT for page views, search interactions, downloads, login events, campaign pixels, consent signals, URL-based behaviors, and other digital interactions.
* Maintain analytics privacy and data-minimization requirements by identifying unintended user-data collection, defining remediation requirements, validating changes, and escalating unresolved risks.

* Conduct analytics environment governance activities, including audits and cleanup of unused segments and calculated metrics, documentation maintenance, naming standards, and configuration hygiene.

* Prepare recurring project status updates and supporting documentation for analytics operations, including in-flight work, backlog, risks, completion status, and next steps.
* Provide tool support, access administration, knowledge transfer, and technical guidance for Adobe Analytics and related MarTech platforms.
* Collaborate across time zones with internal teams, consultants, agencies, and vendors, serving as a technical point of contact for analytics implementation and validation work.
* Maintain the platform roadmap and backlog; prioritize enhancements with stakeholders
* Build and maintain operational dashboards for usage, adoption, and operational metrics

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years administering enterprise Adobe Analytics and Adobe Data Collections
* Demonstrated experience implementing and validating digital analytics for websites or web applications.
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics, Adobe Data Collection/Launch, browser debugging, data layers, events, variables, segments, calculated metrics, and report-suite validation.
* Ability to read technical requirements, inspect browser behavior, test across stage and production environments, and clearly document defects and expected outcomes.
* Experience coordinating work with software developers, IT teams, product owners, analytics stakeholders, privacy partners, agencies, and vendors.
* Working knowledge of digital privacy, consent signals, data minimization, and responsible collection of user-related information.
* Experience using work-management and incident-tracking systems such as Workfront, Jira, and ServiceNow.
* Strong written communication, follow-through, documentation, prioritization, and cross-time-zone collaboration skills.
* Knowledge of analytics governance practices, naming conventions, solution design documentation, dashboard delivery, and operational reporting.
* Adobe Analytics or related digital analytics certification is beneficial.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.
* OR Associate's degree or equivalent degree and 5+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.
* OR High school Diploma or equivalent and 7+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.

jobs.title: Senior Manager-Enterprise Digital Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Digital Deployment Strategy**

* Define the overall deployment and rollout strategy for enterprise digital products, platforms, and services.
* Develop deployment roadmaps covering **PoC, Pilot, MVP, Production, Phased Rollout, and Enterprise Scale**.
* Determine rollout sequencing across business units, locations, channels, customer segments, or operating environments.
* Identify deployment dependencies, constraints, risks, assumptions, and readiness requirements early in the lifecycle.
* Define repeatable deployment frameworks, playbooks, and patterns that can be used across multiple digital initiatives.
* Align deployment strategy with business priorities, technology strategy, enterprise architecture, security requirements, and operational capabilities.

**2. Solutioning & Deployment Architecture**

* Translate business and product requirements into **deployable enterprise solutions**.
* Lead solutioning discussions across application, API, integration, cloud, data, AI, security, infrastructure, and operations.
* Work with Enterprise and Solution Architects to determine the appropriate technical approach and deployment model.
* Assess **build, buy, partner, reuse, and platform-based** options.
* Identify gaps in existing enterprise capabilities that could prevent successful deployment.
* Ensure solutions are designed with production deployment, scalability, resilience, security, observability, and supportability in mind.

**3. Cross-functional Program Orchestration**

* Drive execution across multiple product, engineering, architecture, infrastructure, security, operations, business, and partner teams.
* Establish a common deployment plan with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and decision points.
* Track cross-team dependencies and actively drive closure of blockers.
* Manage deployment risks, issues, assumptions, and escalations.
* Establish governance and operating cadence for large or strategically important rollout programs.
* Ensure all participating teams remain aligned to the deployment objective, timelines, and production outcomes.
* Facilitate executive-level reviews and decision-making where cross-functional intervention is required.

**4. Deployment Readiness**

* Define and manage **deployment readiness criteria** across technology and business dimensions.
* Ensure readiness of environments, infrastructure, integrations, data, security controls, observability, support processes, documentation, and operational teams.
* Coordinate UAT, pilot readiness, production readiness, cutover, and go-live activities.
* Identify gaps that may create operational or business risk after launch.
* Establish readiness checkpoints and ensure exceptions are explicitly assessed and managed.

**5. Product Rollout & Enterprise Scale**

* Drive successful production deployment and phased rollout of digital products and services.
* Coordinate launch activities across technology and business teams.
* Monitor deployment progress, adoption, operational issues, and business readiness during rollout.
* Lead resolution of issues that prevent or delay deployment and scale.
* Define expansion strategies for successful pilots and early deployments.
* Standardize successful deployment approaches for reuse across other products, business units, and markets.

**6. Business & Stakeholder Alignment**

* Work closely with business leaders and product teams to understand deployment objectives, constraints, and expected outcomes.
* Translate business priorities into actionable deployment strategies and execution plans.
* Communicate complex technical dependencies and risks in a clear business context.
* Build alignment across stakeholders with potentially conflicting priorities.
* Drive timely decisions on scope, sequencing, dependencies, investment, and deployment approach.
* Act as a key interface between business leadership and technology execution teams.

**7. Technology & Platform Readiness**

* Assess whether existing enterprise platforms and technology capabilities are sufficient to support large-scale deployment.
* Drive reuse of enterprise capabilities such as identity, integration, data, cloud, AI, observability, security, and common platforms.
* Identify platform capabilities that need to be enhanced to enable product rollout.
* Promote standardization of deployment and integration approaches across digital initiatives.
* Ensure new deployments do not create unnecessary technology duplication or fragmented architectures.

**8. Partner & Vendor Orchestration**

* Work with system integrators, technology vendors, cloud providers, startups, and strategic partners involved in deployment.
* Define technical and delivery boundaries between internal and external teams.
* Review partner solution approaches and deployment plans.
* Ensure partner dependencies and deliverables are aligned with enterprise rollout milestones.
* Drive resolution of cross-partner integration and deployment issues.

**9. Post-deployment Scale & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure structured transition from implementation into stable business-as-usual operations.
* Track deployment outcomes, adoption, operational performance, and user feedback.
* Identify recurring deployment bottlenecks and opportunities for process or platform improvement.
* Capture lessons learned and convert them into reusable deployment patterns.
* Continuously improve the enterprise approach to digital rollout and scale.

**Key Deliverables**

The role will own or contribute to:

* Enterprise deployment and rollout strategies
* Deployment roadmaps and rollout plans
* Solutioning and deployment approaches
* Pilot-to-production plans
* Cross-functional execution plans
* Deployment readiness frameworks and checklists
* Dependency, risk, issue, and escalation management
* Cutover and go-live plans
* Deployment playbooks and reusable rollout patterns
* Production-readiness assessments
* Scale-up and enterprise adoption strategies
* Executive deployment reviews and decision papers

**Success Measures**

Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

* Successful and timely **deployment of digital products and services**
* Reduction in **time from pilot to production**
* Successful enterprise rollout and coverage
* Reduction in deployment-related blockers and delays
* Effectiveness of cross-functional execution across multiple teams
* Production readiness and operational stability after launch
* Adoption and utilization of deployed capabilities
* Reuse of enterprise platforms and deployment patterns
* Reduction in duplicated technology and implementation effort
* Ability to scale successful pilots across the enterprise

**Required Experience & Skills**

* **5+ years of experience** in digital transformation, enterprise technology, solutioning, technology strategy, product deployment, program delivery, or related roles.
* Demonstrated experience in **large-scale deployment or rollout of digital products, platforms, or technology services**.
* Strong experience coordinating multiple technology and business teams toward a common production outcome.

The Business Analyst (BA) for the Alpha Index HUB (AIH) is a key contributor within the Product Organization, responsible for translating business, operational, and client needs into clear, actionable product requirements. **Experience**

**Preferred Domain Knowledge**

* Experience with financial services, index, benchmark, or market data platforms.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Senior Product Manager, Data Platform
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our consumer data platform. We have a modern cloud lakehouse in place and are now building the consumer data foundation on top of it: a canonical data model, a consumer data warehouse, and one trusted source of data for analytics, data science, risk and finance teams.
  
  
You’ll own the roadmap from the start. You’ll decide which use cases to deliver first, define how core consumer entities are modeled, and make sure each new use case builds on shared data instead of one-off pipelines. You’ll work closely with data engineering, data architecture, analytics and risk teams.
  
  
*This is not a dashboard-building role. You’ll own the data, definitions and metrics that dashboards, models and reports are built on.*
What you’ll do in your first 12 months
  
  

* Build a prioritized backlog of consumer data use cases with analytics, data science, risk and finance, and decide which 3–5 to deliver first.
* Define canonical consumer entities, such as customer, account, transaction, fee, merchant, country and currency, so they mean the same thing across products.
* Decide where products share a common model and where they need their own structures, and document the reasoning.
* Define single, governed definitions for core consumer KPIs such as active customers, revenue per user, lifetime value and churn.
* Write requirements engineers can build from: source-to-target mappings, grain, keys, history rules and data-quality checks.
* Track adoption: which teams have moved to the new models, how much they’re being used, and how many metric discrepancies have been resolved.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or an MBA, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years in a data product or risk data role.
* Experience starting with many competing data requests, choosing the few to build first, defining an MVP, and explaining the trade-offs to stakeholders.
* Experience working with engineering to deliver a data lake/lakehouse, data warehouse or shared data model used by multiple teams.
* Experience bringing together inconsistent data from multiple source systems into common entities, keys and definitions.
* Hands-on SQL: you can join across tables, profile data for nulls and duplicates, reconcile counts between systems, and check whether data supports a use case without waiting for an analyst.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with consumer payments, digital wallets or fintech.
* Experience with payments risk data such as fraud, account takeover, KYC/AML or transaction monitoring signals.
* Experience with modern cloud data platforms and tools, such as Snowflake, Databricks, dbt or major cloud providers’ data services.

Estimated Pay Range:
  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

jobs.title: Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
WE'RE HIRING! | Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager.

We are hiring a banking professional who can open, run and protect To The Moon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking relationships: INR pay-in, payout, virtual accounts, CMS and API banking for a crypto trading platform.

* **Department:** Strategic Partnerships (Banking & Payments)
* **Reports To:** Founder & CEO
* **Location:** Lucknow
* **Travel:** Regular travel to Mumbai, Delhi NCR & Bengaluru for bank meetings
* **Experience:** 5+ years in Banking or Fintech
* **Required Expertise:** Digital Banking, API Banking, CMS & Virtual Accounts
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Seniority:** Senior Executive to Manager, based on experience

**About ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd**

ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd is an FIU-IND registered Indian cryptocurrency exchange, headquartered in Jaipur and operating since 2021. We run spot and futures trading plus OTC on-ramp and off-ramp services for Indian users. INR flows, deposits, withdrawals and settlements, sit at the center of our business, and they depend on strong, compliant banking partners.

**Role purpose**

You will own ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking ecosystem end to end. That means finding and onboarding banks, getting API banking, virtual accounts and CMS live, and keeping every relationship healthy. You will also build backup banking so no single bank or payment rail can stop INR deposits or withdrawals.

**Key responsibilities**

1.Bank partnerships and onboarding

a. Find, pitch and onboard private, small finance, cooperative and new-age banks for current accounts, escrow/nodal accounts, pay-in and payout.

b. Present ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's business model, FIU-IND registration, AML/KYC framework and risk controls to bank product, risk and compliance teams.

c. Lead the bank's due diligence: documents, questionnaires, site visits and onboarding

paperwork.

2. API banking, virtual accounts and CMS

a. Set up and expand virtual account (VAN) structures for user-wise INR deposit collection

and auto-reconciliation.

b. Get API banking live for IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and UPI payouts, plus balance, statement and

status APIs.

c. Set up CMS for collections and bulk payouts, and drive integration with our tech team

through UAT and go-live.

d. Work with UPI collect, payment aggregator and PSP partners as extra deposit rails.

3. Relationship management

a. Act as the single point of contact for every banking partner, from relationship managers

up to senior leadership.

b. Handle account freezes, lien marks, LEA and cyber-cell requests, chargebacks and

transaction holds with the bank and our compliance team.

c. Run regular reviews of volumes, TAT, success rates and issues with each bank.

4. Negotiation and commercials

a. Negotiate pricing, transaction limits, float terms, MDR, payout charges and SLAs.

b. Review and close banking agreements, API terms and SLAs with our legal team.

5. Business continuity

a. Always keep at least two live banking partners for pay-in and payout, with tested

failover.

b. Spot risk early, regulatory changes, a bank's appetite for VDA business and line up

alternatives before they are needed.

6. Compliance and internal coordination

a. Work with compliance, finance, operations and tech so bank requirements under PMLA,

FIU-IND and RBI guidelines are met.

b. Keep partner dashboards, MIS and documentation current for management.

**Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years in banking or fintech, with hands-on work in digital banking, API banking, CMS and

virtual accounts.

* Has managed these products for a corporate client, a fintech platform, a stockbroker, a payment

aggregator or a crypto exchange from the bank side or the client side.

* Has taken at least 2–3 bank integrations (VAN, payout API or CMS) from first meeting to go-live.

* An active network of decision-makers in transaction banking, CMS, digital/API banking and

fintech partnership teams at Indian banks.

* Clear understanding of INR payment rails: IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, UPI, NACH, and escrow/nodal

account structures.

* Working knowledge of KYC/AML, PMLA, FIU-IND and RBI rules relevant to banks serving fintechs

and VDA businesses.

* Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

* Graduate in any field; MBA in Finance, Banking or Business preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Banking Products:** Knowledge of current, escrow and nodal accounts; virtual accounts; CMS collections and payouts; API banking; UPI collect and payout.
* **Technical Fluency:** Ability to read API documentation and understand webhooks, callbacks, reconciliation files and UAT; comfortable coordinating with developers and bank technology teams.
* **Negotiation:** Ability to negotiate pricing, transaction limits, SLAs and agreements while maintaining strong banking relationships.
* **Communication:** Strong presentation and email-writing skills; confident in meetings with bank CXOs, risk and compliance heads.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Ability to align compliance, finance, technology and operations teams around bank integration timelines.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to resolve account freezes, failed payouts, settlement delays and reconciliation gaps quickly.
* **Ownership:** Self-driven, works independently and takes complete responsibility for follow-through until go-live.
* **Integrity:** Handles confidential banking and customer data with utmost discretion.

**Good to have**

•Earlier work in a bank's transaction banking, CMS, digital banking or fintech alliances team.

•Experience at an Indian crypto exchange, stockbroker, payment gateway, PSP or NBFC.

•Has onboarded a VDA or high-risk business with a bank and understands the bank's concerns.

•Exposure to payment aggregator rules, cross-border payments or stablecoin on/off-ramp flows.

•Familiarity with reconciliation tools, MIS reporting and Excel-based analysis.

Pay: ₹444,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.description:
**VP of Product, Tokenized Deposits**

Full-time

**About DCM**

DCM Corp Limited builds interbank infrastructure for tokenized deposits in emerging markets. Our entry point is the payment itself: ISO 20022-native messaging with tokenized settlement, running alongside banks' existing core systems rather than replacing them. Our technology already runs a national interbank payment network in production. DCM is the exclusive implementation provider of tokenized deposit solutions for the ADI Foundation, the Abu Dhabi-based foundation backed by IHC, bringing these solutions to banks across MENA and sub-Saharan Africa.

**The role**

You will own the product: strategy, roadmap, and the way we implement it with banks. You will build and lead the product function, working closely with the leadership team.

**What you will do**

* Own the roadmap for our two products: Side-core, a layer that runs alongside a bank's core, and PMP (Payment Messaging Processing), an ISO 20022-native messaging and settlement platform
* Watch the market and shape where the product goes next: regulation, competing platforms, bank demand, and initiatives like CBDC and interbank ledger projects
* Develop the product line beyond current deployments (new capabilities, new deployment models, new markets) with a clear case for each
* Decide what is standard product and what is customization, and hold that line with clients
* Define our standard implementation approach with banks, from first workshop to pilot to production
* Turn what we learn at each client into product, with one prioritized backlog across all projects
* Work with engineering and partners to deliver, and take responsibility for acceptance

**What you bring**

* Tokenized money shipped to production (tokenized deposits, stablecoins or DLT-based settlement) in a regulated setting
* A product delivered to banks or payment operators as clients: workshops, scoping, pilot, production, security reviews
* Strong command of payments infrastructure and ISO 20022
* A record of growing a product line: finding what the market needs next and shipping it, not only running an existing roadmap
* 12+ years of experience, at least 5 leading products for B2B infrastructure
* Experience owning a product when engineering sits in another organization
* Comfortable acting as solution architect on early client projects
* Fluent English; based in the UAE or willing to travel

**Nice to have**

* MENA or African market experience, Arabic
* Familiarity with interbank ledger initiatives (Swift, regional networks) and EVM chains
* Product experience under SOC 2 or ISO 27001/27017/27018
* Public speaking or published work on tokenization

**What we offer**

* Real ownership of the product of a company bringing tokenized deposits to banks in new markets
* A competitive package for a senior hire
* A seat in decisions about what we build and who we build it for.
