jobs.description:
**Building the Future of Open Finance**
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
  
  
**The team**
Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.
  
  
Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.
  
  
The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.
  
  
**The opportunity**

* Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)
* Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases
* Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against

* Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding
* Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business
* Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers
* Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers
* Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them
* Strong technical fluency. You can read an RFC, challenge an architecture decision, and write an API spec that engineers respect
* Experience shipping developer-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or embeddable UI components

* Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house

**Senior Product Manager – Consumer Products**

* Conduct customer research, segmentation, competitor analysis, and market reviews to identify new opportunities and enhance existing products.
* Define product propositions, pricing, features, eligibility criteria, and customer value propositions in line with market needs and business objectives.
* Monitor portfolio performance and identify opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, utilization, retention, revenue, profitability, and customer experience.

* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to develop business cases, financial models, pricing strategies, and product performance analysis.
* Strong understanding of digital product development, customer experience, data analytics, AI, and automation.

* Experience

jobs.description:

Visa is evolving its consumer-facing platforms to create stronger customer value propositions, enable new product solutions, and support sustainable growth across CEMEA.

The ideal candidate will have proven experience testing digital retail account opening journeys, parent-child relationship linking, KYC/AML validations, and minor banking compliance rules across mobile banking apps and core banking systems.

* Hands-on experience in mobile app testing (iOS & Android) across real devices and simulators.
* Proficiency in API testing tools (Postman, Swagger) and backend database validation (SQL).

**Skills:** Digital Onboarding Testing , KYC/AML Compliance , Mobile App Testing

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree or MBA, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience of increasing complexity and responsibility in institutional investor relations, capital markets, private markets, asset management, investment banking, or related areas.
* Extensive experience developing and managing senior-level relationships with institutiona

jobs.title: Technology - Application Development, Summer Analyst, Bahrain 2027
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**You are the brain behind our work …**

At Citi, we do not just adapt to change – we drive it. Our Summer Technology Analyst Program is where forward thinking talents meet unparalleled opportunities. This is your chance to innovate, influence, and make an impact in the most global financial institution!

Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilizing a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high-performance enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.

**We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed…**

We are committed to teaching you the ropes. The **10 week** Summer Analyst Program starts in June with an in-depth education on the Analyst role’s fundamentals and the nuances of Citi’s culture. The program also includes on-the-desk training, an informative speaker series, and networking opportunities. Summer Analysts often return to Citi after graduating from university to become Full-Time Analysts and continue their career in technology.

**Your time here will look like this...**

You will work in an agile software development environment, developing quality and scalable software solutions using leading-edge technologies. Based on business requirements, you will develop code consistent with quality standards and offer support during testing cycles and post-production deployment. To ensure defect-free programming, you will use the appropriate tools to test and debug code and participate in the review of peer coding. You have additional support, too. You join a cohort of other new hires and go through training together to learn about our company, our tools and processes, and the technical skills you will need to succeed.

  
  

While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, some developers will have exposure within the following categories:

* **Back-End Development:** Java, Python, Spring Framework
* **Front-End Development:** Web (React, TypeScript, Angular, HTML5) and Mobile (Swift, Kotlin)
* **Generative AI & AI Agents****:** GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)
* **Data Analytics:** Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.
  

  

No matter your team placement, as a member in our program, you can expect:

* **Global Exposure**: Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.

* **Continuous Learning:** Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programs that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills.

* **Real Impact**: Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.

**To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria:**

* Graduation between Dec 2027 and July 2028.

* Educational background: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.

* A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions.

* Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.

* Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.

* Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.

* Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.

* Work Authorization: Authorized to work in Bahrain without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future.

**Who we think will be a great fit...**

A steadfast dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As global industries continue to evolve, we are seeking professionals who bring a global perspective to the future of banking and are eager to make an impact at the corporate level using AI. We value diversity and so do you.

This program is ideal for those who:

* Are ambitious, with a relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

* Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation.

* Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
You will run Capital.com's day-to-day social presence across the Middle East and North Africa. Social is often the first place a trader in the region meets our brand, so the work you publish shapes how people understand trading, risk and the platform before they ever open an account. You will sit in the MENA marketing team in Dubai, working with content, performance, compliance and product to turn market moments into clear, useful posts in Arabic and English. Our mission is to give traders clarity and technology they can rely on, and this role carries that into the feed every day.

### **What you will do:**

* Own the weekly content calendar for MENA channels: Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Snapchat and Telegram.
* Write and publish posts, captions, stories and short-form scripts in Arabic and English that explain markets plainly.
* React to market events (rate decisions, oil moves, earnings, gold) with timely, accurate content within agreed turnaround times.
* Brief the Video Editor and designers, review drafts and keep output on brand.
* Route every post through financial promotions review and keep required risk warnings in place.
* Manage community replies and DMs, escalating client issues to Customer Support and complaints to Compliance.
* Report weekly on reach, engagement, follower growth and social-sourced registrations, and act on what the numbers show.
* Work with the performance team so organic content supports paid campaigns and regional launches.

### **What you bring:**

* 3+ years managing brand social channels, or an equivalent portfolio that shows you grew an audience.
* Native-level Arabic and fluent English, with the judgment to write for Gulf and wider MENA audiences.
* Hands-on experience with native platform analytics and a scheduling tool such as Sprout Social, Hootsuite or Later.
* Comfort editing short-form video and graphics in CapCut, Canva or Adobe Express.
* Accuracy under time pressure: you check facts and figures before anything goes live.
Clear written communication and the ability to take feedback from Compliance without losing pace.  

### **Nice to have:**

* Experience in fintech, brokerage, banking or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of financial promotion rules (SCA, FCA COBS 4 or CySEC).
* Familiarity with UAE Media Council advertising and influencer requirements.
* Interest in markets and trading, and an understanding of CFDs.
* Experience with creator or influencer partnerships in the GCC.

### **What you will get in return:**

* **Competitive Salary:** We believe great work deserves great pay! Your skills and talents will be rewarded with a salary that makes you feel valued and motivated.
* **Work-Life Harmony:** Join a company that genuinely cares about *you*—because your life outside of work matters just as much as your time on the clock.
* **Annual Performance Bonus:** Your hard work doesn’t go unnoticed! Celebrate your achievements with a well-deserved annual bonus tied to your performance.
* **Generous Time Off:** Need a breather? Our annual leave policy lets you recharge and enjoy life outside of work without a worry.
* **Employee Referral Program:** Love working here? Share the love! Bring your talented friends on board and get rewarded for growing our awesome team.
* **Comprehensive Health & Pension Benefits:** From medical insurance to pension plans, we’ve got your back. Plus, location-specific benefits and perks!
* **Workation Wonderland:** Live your digital nomad dreams with 30 extra days to work remotely from anywhere in the world (some restrictions apply). Adventure awaits!
* **Volunteer Days:** Make a difference! Take two additional paid days each year to support causes you care about and give back to the community

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Head Of Product
jobs.description:
PhonePe is India’s leading digital payments platform with over 700 million registered users and 50 million registered merchants. Using PhonePe, users can send and receive money, recharge mobile, DTH, data cards, pay at stores, make utility payments, buy gold, and make investments. PhonePe went live for customers in August 2016 and was the first non-banking UPI app and offered money transfer to individuals and merchants, recharges and bill payments to begin with. PhonePe is one of the leading payments providers for merchants in India. PhonePe provides digital payments for offline merchants as well as online merchants.
  
  
**Job Description**
PhonePe is on a mission to change the landscape of digital payments and financial services in India. On this mission, we are committed to hiring the best while creating an environment of equal opportunity and empowerment. As a Head of Product at PhonePe, you will own and drive the roadmap for our payment solutions products for international merchants. You will work with other pod members and a diverse set of stakeholders towards a collective set of objectives. We work on complex technology, scale while iterating quickly and have a bias for impact in everything we do.
  
  

* Define a portfolio product strategy from first principles that becomes the org’s reference point; drives multi-pod execution and measurable portfolio outcomes
* Identify and deliver multiple Annual Operating Plan-shaping bets; consistently make correct profitability vs growth calls across portfolio, shift business trajectory with durable levers (pricing, distribution, unit economics, cost-to-serve)
* Design pod-level org structure and capability plan that materially increases throughput and quality; shape cross-functional Hiring AOP with high accuracy; prevent bottlenecks before they form.
* Build a strong leadership bench; direct reports consistently progress levels. Establish pod-wide talent mechanisms with counterparts that raise performance across functions.
* Design and evolve the pod operating system (planning, decision forums, execution reviews, launch readiness, learning loops) with measurable improvements in reliability and speed.
* Demonstrate thought leadership and be the go to person for product decisions for internal and external stakeholders.
* Engage with external customers and stakeholders, communicate objectives and progress.

**Qualifications**

* Excellent communication skills.
* At least 15+ years of experience in Product / Platform building and development.
* Strong business acumen and ability to partner with cross-functional teams.
* Contributes to business decisions regularly and proactively.
* Can build credibility via knowledge and judgment to persuade others.
* Conducts interviews for PM/SPM roles and for specific competencies.

**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and execution-focused
**Head of Product**
to lead our product vision, strategy, and roadmap. You will directly manage a team of 4–5 Product Managers and oversee a broader product organization of 20 professionals. In this role, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of our core messaging (SMS, RCS, WhatsApp), voice, and omnichannel APIs, balancing developer experience, enterprise scalability, carrier compliance, and commercial growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Product Strategy & Vision
  
  

* Define the Product Roadmap: Own and articulate a compelling multi-year product vision and quarterly execution roadmap aligned with company revenue and growth targets.
* Market & Competitive Intelligence: Stay ahead of emerging trends in the CPaaS ecosystems, including AI-driven conversational commerce, RCS Business Messaging, and omnichannel orchestration.
* Commercial Alignment: Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to establish pricing, packaging, and go-to-market (GTM) strategies that maximize customer acquisition and net dollar retention.

Leadership & Team Management
  
  

* Manage and Mentor: Directly lead, coach, and develop 4–5 Product Managers, fostering a high-performing, data-driven, and customer-obsessed culture.
* Organizational Oversight: Guide the broader product team—ensuring seamless collaboration across Product Management, UX/UI Design, Product Analytics, and API Documentation.
* Process Excellence: Establish scalable product development frameworks, discovery processes, and KPI tracking across all product pods.

CPaaS Domain & Technical Execution
  
  

* API & Developer Experience: Champion a "developer-first" mindset, ensuring our APIs, SDKs, and self-serve portals are intuitive, well-documented, and easy to integrate.
* Platform Reliability & Scale: Collaborate closely with Engineering and Telecom/Carrier Operations to ensure ultra-high availability, low latency, and optimal message deliverability across global routes.
* Compliance & Security: Ensure all product offerings adhere to global telecom regulations, data privacy laws (GDPR, TCPA, DPDP), and anti-spam/fraud standards (e.g., 10DLC, DLT in India).

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Experience: 15+ years of experience in Product Management, with at least 5+ years in a senior leadership role managing other Product Managers.
* Domain Expertise: Proven track record in CPaaS, cloud communications, telecom infrastructure, SaaS APIs, or B2B developer platforms.
* Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, webhooks, cloud architecture, and telecom protocols (SMPP, SIP, WebRTC) to credibly partner with engineering leadership.
* Scale & Growth: Demonstrated success scaling B2B products from mid-market to enterprise adoption, with direct ownership of P&L or revenue-impacting metrics.
* Analytical & Customer-Centric: Deep experience using product analytics to drive decisions, paired with a habit of engaging directly with enterprise customers and developers.
* Communication: Exceptional executive presence with the ability to influence board members, enterprise clients, telecom partners, and cross-functional teams.

**Key metrics**

* Revenue & Adoption: API consumption growth, Net Revenue
* Delivery & Quality: On-time roadmap execution, API uptime/latency benchmarks, and reduction in customer onboarding time.
* Team Health: Retention, career progression, and velocity of the 15-person product organization.

jobs.title: Vice President, Finance Data Product Management – P&L
jobs.description:
The VP, Finance Data Product Owner – P&L Data (India) is the execution lead for the P&L data product agenda on
**One Data Foundation**
, supporting the VP, Global Data Product Owner – P&L. The role starts with
**Revenue and Expense Accrual**
data and sits where Finance, Accounting and Technology meet. It works day to day with data producers, consumers and P&L process owners’ teams, and turns the Global Product Owner’s priorities into certified, reusable data products.
  
  
The leader works with process owners to understand how the data is used and what outcome it supports and documents the manual processes and adjustments on both the production and consumption sides. The goal is to raise productivity and efficiency and keep the data products golden by reducing manual manipulation and point-to-point sourcing. The role builds
**governance by design**
(CDEs, definitions, ownership, lineage, DQ rules and controls) into each product and uses AI and automation to modernize a largely waterfall and manual delivery lifecycle.
  
  
*The Global Data Product Owner sets product strategy, priorities, the portfolio roadmap and senior stakeholder agreements. This role executes, recommends and escalates. Controllers, Global Accounting and FP&A own the process and the reported numbers, and Technology owns engineering and production operations.*
**Key Accountabilities**

* Bridge Producers and Consumers
* Be the working-level link between upstream accrual data producers and downstream consumers, so issues are raised once, routed to the right producer and tracked to closure.
* Partner with P&L process owners’ teams (Controllers, Global Accounting, FP&A and other consumers) to understand how they use the data and the outcome they need. Surface pain points and new needs early to the Global Product Owner.
* Draft and maintain producer–consumer terms: definitions, scope, frequency, granularity, quality thresholds, ownership and issue handling, for approval by the Global Product Owner.
* Support the consumer forum by preparing the agenda and facts, and make differences in how consumers interpret or override the same data visible.
* Understand and Reduce Manual Work
* Document the manual processes, adjustments and overrides on the production and consumption sides of each in-scope P&L process. Quantify the effort and find the root causes.
* Recommend and drive fixes: move adjustments upstream or into the product so they are made once and governed, remove spreadsheet dependencies, and stop point-to-point sourcing. Priorities are agreed with the Global Product Owner.
* Use AI and automation to speed requirements, metadata, CDE identification, lineage, DQ rules, documentation and testing, within agreed controls.
* Execute the P&L Data Products
* Run day-to-day delivery of the accrual data products. Maintain the backlog, define requirements, and work with architecture and engineering on sources, transformations, business rules and lineage.
* Prepare each product for certification: definitions, CDEs, lineage, DQ rules and controls complete, reconciled to the authoritative source, and confirmed to meet accounting requirements.
* Fix issues at the source with producers, strengthen reconciliation, and maintain a shared business glossary.
* Publish and reuse on One Data Foundation, enhancing existing products before creating new ones, and support retiring legacy sources and BI reports in favor of certified data.
* Report, Escalate and Lead
* Give the Global Product Owner clear, regular updates on progress, risks and decisions needed. Escalate early and prepare materials for senior stakeholder discussions.
* Work across time zones with agreed overlap hours, documented handoffs and clear written follow-up.
* Guide and develop team members in India as the work grows.

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant banking or financial services experience in Finance, Accounting or P&L functions.
* Strong working knowledge of revenue and/or expense accruals, accounting concepts, controls and reconciliations.
* Solid grasp of data lineage, quality and governance principles, with the ability to analyze and validate data independently (for example, SQL) and reconcile it to source.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to analyze manual processes and adjustments to find root causes and efficiency opportunities.
* Experience working between business and technology teams, with the ability to influence without direct authority and work effectively with global stakeholders across time zones.
* Clear written and verbal communication that explains data issues in terms of business impact.
* Demonstrated curiosity and a record of improving ways of working through automation or AI.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Power BI or similar platforms; working knowledge of SQL and data modeling.
* Exposure to billing, revenue or general ledger systems and how they integrate with reporting platforms.
* Experience with platform migration or re-engineering programs, and with leading complex, multi-team work.
* Familiarity with GenAI or machine learning use cases in Finance, and agile or product ownership experience.
* Background in regulated or audit-sensitive environments, including regulatory and external reporting.
* Professional qualification (CA, CPA, CFA) or a degree in Finance, Accounting, Data or a related field.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS
  
  

* Delivery: accrual data products prepared and certified against the agreed plan, with documented producer–consumer terms.
* Manual work: manual processes and adjustments documented for each in-scope P&L process, with a measurable reduction in manual manipulation, spreadsheet dependencies and point-to-point feeds.
* Consistency and reuse: one agreed definition per P&L measure, more consumers on the certified products, and fewer report-level overrides.
* Issue efficiency: fewer duplicate issues sent to producers and faster resolution.
* Reliability: timely updates, early escalation and clean handoffs, as rated by the Global Product Owner.
* Partnership: process owners and producers report the role is fair, responsive and effective.

LEADERSHIP PROFILE AND CANDIDATE CALIBRATION
  
  

* Bridge-builder mindset (most important)

****What Good Looks Like****
Sits between producers and consumers by choice. Explains each side’s constraints to the other, gets both to commit to a shared agreement, and follows up until it holds.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Acts as a requirements taker or a ticket router. Describes the role as “gathering requirements” or “sending tickets.”
  
  

* Curious about the manual work

****What Good Looks Like****
Wants to see how consumers really use the data and finds the adjustments and spreadsheets behind it. Asks why until the root cause is clear.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Accepts manual adjustments as normal. Reports what people do without asking why.
  
  

* Ownership of execution

****What Good Looks Like****
Acts as an owner, not an order-taker. Follows through, flags problems early and keeps the Global Product Owner informed without being asked.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Waits for detailed direction or makes portfolio-level commitments without agreement from the Global Product Owner.
  
  

* Reuse-first and governance by design

****What Good Looks Like****
Defaults to one certified source and one definition. Builds CDEs, lineage, DQ rules and controls in as the product is built. Challenges point-to-point feeds and local copies.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Builds a new dataset for each request. Treats governance as a separate sign-off step.
  
  

* Curious and AI-forward

****What Good Looks Like****
Questions waterfall and manual ways of working. Experiments with AI and automation and keeps controls intact.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Defends the current process. Views AI as hype or as a replacement for judgment.
  
  

* Works well across time zone

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Design
jobs.description:
**About Navi**

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

**What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.**

**Why Explore a Career at Navi?**

**Where Ownership Creates Real Impact**

At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.

**Where Careers Accelerate**

Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.

**Where Great Talent Builds Together**

We take pride in building high talent-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.

**About the Team**

The Product Design team at Navi creates clear, intuitive experiences that put users first. We work end to end across research, interaction, and visual design to shape products that are simple, fast, and purposeful. Our approach is deeply data-driven, combining user insights and product analytics to continuously refine and improve the user experience.

**About the Role**

Navi is seeking a Senior Manager - Design to lead and scale our growing design team. This is a critical leadership role for someone who is not just an expert in design, but an expert in building a team that is "ruthless" in its approach to problem-solving. Your core responsibility will be to lead a team of talented designers who are experts in taste, data, and problem-solving, and who act as a force for alignment across the company. You will be instrumental in fostering a culture of relentless pursuit of excellence and pushing for an incredibly high bar for what we ship. You will be responsible for the overall success and strategy of the design function, from defining the "why" to ensuring a high-quality outcome. The ideal candidate has a strong backbone to take a stand for what is right for the customer and the company , but also has a humble heart to listen and learn.

**What You’ll Own**

* **Strategic Leadership:**

○ Partner with senior leadership (Product, Engineering, Business) to define the design vision and strategy for all charters, aligning with company goals and product principles.

○ Champion a customer-first mindset, ensuring the team starts with the customer's pain and obsesses over making their lives better.

○ Drive a culture of ruthless prioritization, ensuring the team is focused on doing fewer things, but better.

○ Seek clarity relentlessly to unblock your team and ensure everyone is moving fast with purpose and sense.

* **Team Leadership & Management:**

○ Recruit, coach, and lead a high-performing team of product designers, fostering their growth and helping them do their best work.

○ Conduct performance reviews, set career goals, and create a clear path for professional development for the team.

○ Instill the core Navi principles of end-to-end ownership and accountability.

* **Design & Process Excellence:**

○ Maintain and elevate an incredibly high bar for design quality, simplicity, and taste across all products.

○ Oversee the design process, ensuring it is data-informed and focused on clear outcomes.

○ Establish and evangelize best practices, design patterns, and standards across the organization.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* 7+ years of experience in product design, with a minimum of 2-3 years in a formal management or leadership role.
* A proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and leading high-performing design teams in a fast-paced, agile environment.
* A strategic portfolio that demonstrates how your leadership and design vision drove significant business impact and customer value.
* Deep domain expertise in fintech or a related industry.
* Expertise in user-centered design principles and methodologies.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus at a senior leadership level.

**The Navi OS**

The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.

* **Start with the Customer**
* Master the Details
* Act with Urgency
* Own the Outcome
* Build for a Decade - Not a Day
* Win as One

We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation.

To read more about the Navi OS, visit
navi.com/our-values

**Life at Navi**

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.

If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page:
navi.com/careers/life-at-navi

If solving meaningful problems, building at scale and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you,

**Navi could be the place for you.**

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
**Role:**

We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant to lead the Finance Controllership function at Whizzo Textiles, a fast-growing Series A startup in B2B technical textiles with cross-border operations. Reporting to the CFO, the Finance Controller will own financial reporting, month-end and year-end closure, budgeting and FP&A, internal controls, statutory compliance and investor reporting, and will build and lead a finance team that can scale with the business.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

Controllership & Financial Reporting

* Own month-end, quarter-end and year-end closure with defined close calendars and timelines.
* Prepare standalone and consolidated financial statements in line with Ind AS / applicable accounting standards.
* Review accounting policies and key judgements (revenue recognition, inventory valuation, leases, borrowings, impairment).
* Ensure accuracy and integrity of the general ledger, sub-ledgers and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Drive closure of statutory, internal and tax audits within committed timelines with no material observations.

  

FP&A, Budgeting & Business Partnering

* Lead annual budgeting, monthly rolling forecasts and long-range (3 - 5 year) business plans.
* Deliver monthly MIS covering P&L, cash flow, product/customer-wise margins and variance vs budget/forecast.
* Build product-wise and plant-wise profitability tracking to ensure input cost recovery and pass-through to customers.
* Prepare capex and investment evaluation models (ROI, payback, IRR) to support management decisions.
* Partner with sales, supply chain, production and procurement on pricing, cost optimization and margin improvement.

  

Working Capital, Treasury & Banking Oversight

* Oversee cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning and working capital (inventory, receivables, payables) management.
* Work with the Treasury & Banking team on banking limits, trade finance (LC, PCFC, export finance) and fund deployment.
* Support negotiation of borrowing costs, banking terms and insurance with banks and financial institutions.
* Ensure RBI/FEMA compliance for import/export transactions and cross-border payments.

  

Tax, Statutory Compliance & Governance

* Ensure timely compliance with Income Tax, GST, TDS, Companies Act and other statutory requirements with a zero-penalty track record.
* Coordinate with tax advisors on assessments, notices, transfer pricing and tax planning.
* Prepare Board packs and support Board/committee meetings and secretarial requirements.

  

Internal Controls & Risk Management

* Design, document and monitor internal financial controls (IFC), delegation of authority and approval workflows.
* Strengthen spend controls, contract compliance tracking and recovery of claims/liquidated damages from vendors and customers.
* Identify financial and operational risks and recommend corrective actions to leadership.

  

Investor Reporting, Fundraising & Transactions

* Own investor reporting, MIS packs and compliance with shareholder agreement covenants.
* Lead finance workstreams for fundraising, due diligence, valuation queries and data rooms.
* Support M&A, restructuring or entity consolidation from a finance and reporting perspective.

  

Team Leadership, Systems & Process Building

* Build, lead and mentor a high-performing finance & accounts team across locations.
* Design finance SOPs and policies suitable for a fast-scaling organization.
* Drive ERP implementation/optimization, automation and real-time dashboards for leadership visibility.
* Compress closure and MIS timelines through process standardization and automation.

  
  

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong command of Ind AS; exposure to IFRS / US GAAP is a plus.
* Hands-on experience in financial closure, consolidation and audit management.
* Proven FP&A, budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling skills.
* Sound knowledge of Indian direct and indirect taxation, Companies Act and FEMA.
* Working knowledge of working capital management, banking and trade finance.
* Experience with ERP systems (SAP / ZOHO) and advanced MS Excel; BI dashboard tools a plus.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management and communication skills, including with Board and investors.
* High ownership, integrity and ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.

  
  

**Qualifications & Experiences:**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA); CPA (USA) / ACCA is an added advantage.
* 6 - 8 years of post-qualification experience, including at least 3 - 4 years in a controllership or finance leadership role.
* Big 6 / statutory audit background preferred.
* Experience in manufacturing, textiles, export-import or capital-intensive industries preferred.
* Exposure to fundraising, investor due diligence or M&A transactions is a strong plus.
* Experience managing a team of 5 - 10 finance professionals.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a seasoned technology leader to serve as Senior Manager, Software Engineering. This role is accountable for end-to-end delivery across Azure Cloud, modern web applications, Salesforce, and payment platforms. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with disciplined execution, build high-performing engineering teams, and coordinate complex initiatives across multiple functions and geographies. This leader will translate business priorities into scalable technology outcomes while strengthening engineering practices, operational resilience, security, and accountability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end execution: Own planning, architecture alignment, engineering delivery, testing, release readiness, production launch, and post-production stabilization for a portfolio of strategic initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong working knowledge of Azure Cloud architecture and services, cloud-native design, integration patterns, APIs, and DevSecOps practices.
* Experience overseeing modern web application delivery, including front-end, back-end, security, performance, accessibility, and production support considerations.
* Experience with Salesforce platforms, custom development, integrations, release management, and governance.
* Experience with payment ecosystems, including transaction flows, integrations, reconciliation, resiliency, security, and regulatory or control requirements.

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

jobs.description:
**Hiring: Head of Technology / VP Engineering**

**Company:**
KGIL Fintech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (SwipeLoan)

**Location:**
Hinjawadi, Pune | Work from Office

**Experience:**
10–15+ years in Technology, Software Engineering, Architecture and Engineering Leadership

**CTC:**
₹18–24 LPA, depending on experience and technical expertise

**Reporting to:**
Founder & CEO

**About KGIL**

KGIL is building a diversified technology ecosystem with products spanning fintech, digital lending, credit solutions and emerging consumer internet businesses.

Through SwipeLoan and our expanding portfolio of digital platforms, we aim to develop and scale technology-driven businesses across multiple industries.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on technology leader with
**CTO-level capabilities**
who can take complete ownership of technology strategy, architecture, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity and product development across our growing ecosystem.

This is not a conventional IT management role.

The selected candidate must be capable of independently evaluating new business concepts, selecting appropriate technology stacks, designing scalable systems, building engineering teams and delivering end-to-end technology solutions.

We are looking for a technology generalist with deep engineering expertise who is comfortable working across different programming languages, frameworks, architectures and business domains.

The candidate should have the technical judgment and leadership ability to build products using both existing and emerging technologies, without being restricted to any single programming language or framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Technology Ownership**

* Own the complete technology function across existing and future KGIL platforms.
* Define long-term technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering roadmaps.
* Independently translate business ideas into technical requirements, architecture and execution plans.
* Take responsibility for technology decisions from product conceptualisation to development, deployment, scaling and maintenance.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the Founder & CEO.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, development timelines, resource requirements and infrastructure costs for new businesses.
* Ensure all platforms are secure, scalable, reliable and commercially efficient.

**2. Multi-Technology & Full-Stack Engineering Leadership**

Lead engineering across multiple technology stacks, including but not limited to:

* **Backend:**
  PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Python, Django, FastAPI, Java, Spring Boot, Go and other relevant technologies.
* **Frontend:**
  React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular and modern frontend frameworks.
* **Mobile Applications:**
  Flutter, React Native, native Android and iOS development.
* **Databases:**
  MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and other SQL/NoSQL technologies.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:**
  AWS, cloud-native architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless systems and CI/CD.
* **Integrations:**
  REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, third-party APIs, payment gateways and external services.
* **AI & Automation:**
  AI/ML integrations, LLM-based applications, intelligent automation and data-driven product capabilities.

The candidate is not expected to write production code in every language personally but must possess sufficient architectural and technical depth to evaluate, guide and manage engineering teams working across different technology stacks.

**3. New Product Development & Technology Expansion**

* Lead technology development for new businesses across fintech and non-fintech industries.
* Evaluate new product ideas and recommend the most suitable technology stack for each business.
* Design and deliver MVPs, scalable applications and enterprise-grade platforms.
* Lead development of consumer applications, marketplaces, subscription platforms, SaaS products, social networking applications and e-commerce solutions.
* Build reusable technology components, shared services and APIs wherever commercially appropriate.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, third-party platforms and outsourcing opportunities.
* Ensure new product launches meet defined timelines, budgets and quality standards.
* Support rapid experimentation, prototyping and product-market validation.

**4. Technology Architecture & Scalability**

* Design scalable, secure and high-performance application architectures.
* Make informed decisions between monolithic, modular and microservices architectures.
* Establish standards for API design, database architecture, system integrations and data management.
* Implement performance optimisation, caching, monitoring and system observability.
* Plan infrastructure capacity for high-volume applications and rapid user growth.
* Ensure appropriate system resilience, backup, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements.
* Identify and resolve technical debt and architectural limitations.

**5. Engineering Team Leadership & Recruitment**

* Lead existing backend, frontend, mobile, QA, DevOps and AI/ML teams.
* Independently recruit developers, architects and technical specialists based on business requirements.
* Build and manage multiple engineering teams working on different products simultaneously.
* Establish clear reporting structures, engineering ownership and accountability.
* Define development standards, code review processes and technical documentation requirements.
* Conduct technical interviews and assess candidate capabilities across different technology stacks.
* Mentor engineering leads and develop future technology leaders.
* Manage internal development teams, freelancers, technology vendors and outsourced partners.

**6. DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Cybersecurity**

* Own cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, production environments and system monitoring.
* Manage AWS infrastructure and evaluate alternative cloud services where appropriate.
* Establish robust CI/CD, release management and automated testing processes.
* Implement cybersecurity controls, vulnerability management, access controls and secure development practices.
* Oversee incident response, disaster recovery and infrastructure reliability.
* Coordinate technical security requirements relating to ISO 27001, applicable data protection laws and regulatory obligations.
* Ensure company-controlled access to source code, repositories, servers, cloud accounts and technology assets.
* Monitor infrastructure expenditure and implement cost optimisation initiatives.

**7. Fintech & Third-Party Integrations**

* Oversee technology integrations with banks, NBFCs, credit bureaus, KYC providers, Account Aggregators, payment gateways and other financial technology service providers.
* Ensure reliability, security and performance of partner APIs.
* Support lending journeys, credit eligibility systems, subscription payments and automated financial workflows.
* Coordinate with business and compliance teams on technology-related regulatory requirements.

**8. Product, Business & Leadership Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Founder & CEO to evaluate and execute new business opportunities.
* Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Finance, Business Development and Operations teams.
* Provide technical recommendations in business planning and strategic discussions.
* Prepare technology budgets, development roadmaps and resource allocation plans.
* Communicate technical risks, dependencies and investment requirements clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Take independent ownership of technical execution while keeping management informed of major decisions.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Mandatory**

* 10–15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 4–5 years in engineering leadership or architecture roles.
* Strong hands-on software engineering background with experience designing and scaling production app

* Identify banks and NBFCs interested in eligible DLG-supported lending arrangements.
* Develop new lending products and commercial opportunities.
* Negotiate partnership agreements and commercial structures.
* Build a sustainable and profitable lending portfolio.

* Maintain relationships with existing lending institutions.
* Identify additional opportunities in digital lending, loan distribution and co-lending arrangements where applicable.

* Oversee loan sourcing, disbursement coordination and portfolio monitoring.
* Work with regulated lending partners on approved DLG structures.
* Monitor portfolio performance, delinquency, defaults and guarantee utilisation.
* Coordinate reconciliation, claims, collections reporting and settlements with relevant teams.
* Develop operational SOPs and reporting dashboards.

* Track delinquency buckets, vintage performance and loss trends.
* Recommend appropriate risk controls and portfolio eligibility criteria.
* Coordinate with lending partners' credit and risk teams.
* Ensure the business operates within approved risk limits.

* Build capabilities in alliances, lending operations and portfolio MIS.
* Establish department-level targets and reporting systems.

* Coordinate agreement execution with Legal and Compliance.
* Maintain complete portfolio records, lender reconciliations and supporting documentation.

* 10–15 years of experience in NBFCs, banks, fintech or digital lending.
* Direct experience managing FLDG/DLG arrangements or credit-risk-sharing programmes.
* Strong existing relationships with banks and NBFCs.
* Knowledge of unsecured personal loans, business loans and digital lending.
* Understanding of credit underwriting, portfolio risk, collections and lending operations.
* Proven experience negotiating commercial lending partnerships.
* Ability to independently establish and manage a business vertical.
* Strong leadership, analytical and execution capabilities.

**Preferred Background**

Candidates currently working as AVP, VP, Business Head, Lending Partnerships Head, FLDG Head or Credit Partnerships Head in an NBFC, bank, fintech or lending platform.

**Our expectation:**
An entrepreneurial business leader who can establish a new lending vertical, generate sustainable revenue, manage risk and build a strong team from the ground up.

jobs.description:
**Job Description-**
Citi operates through five major business divisions — Services, Markets, Banking and International, Wealth, and U.S. Personal Banking. Each of these generates complex financial data and transactions that require robust technology infrastructure. Technology and Business Enablement is the division that cuts across all of them, providing shared platforms, controls, and transformation programs. Finance Technology lives within T&BE, making it a truly enterprise-wide function, delivering technology solutions for Finance, Accounting, Regulatory Reporting, and Treasury across all Citi businesses globally.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
:
  
  
The Finance Technology Product Management Analyst is a strategic professional who owns defining our overarching product strategy, spearheading business engagement and transformation and contributing to directional strategy for AI, integration and automation capabilities. It is a Techno-functional hands-on role with experience building products that solve real and pressing problems in highly complex and regulated environments.
  
  
Key responsibility will be to define Product vision, strategy and roadmap, develop solution proposals, business cases, solution design and tactics in engagement with Business and Technology stakeholders.
  
  
This role will be responsible for leading business process redesign, map existing and to-be processes for operational optimization, digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
With Data at the heart of everything we do, this role will require strong data analytical skills (using programming or AI tools), tracing lineage of data, and developing conceptual and logical data models.
  
  
The role is expected to drive cross-functional collaboration and effective communication with business and technology partners, to guide, influence and convince others and lay the direction for Product development.
  
  

* Ownership of the Product backlog and roadmap, strategy, outlining the vision and direction for the product offering over time, to ensure users derive the most value possible from the product.
* Participate in day-to-day product management for core products such as product delivery, client experience, and client communication strategies as well as help the team prioritize, negotiate, and remove obstacles to achieve business results
* Leada culture of innovation, “test and learn” experiments to create platform products that increase customer value. Analyze gaps in capabilities, opportunities for optimization and efficiency and enhancing user experience, remediating risk, and control gaps.
* Defines and measures the KPIs for a platform product

If you've been experimenting with new models, new tooling, or new patterns, that's exactly the kind of thinking we want in the room.

Familiarity with Financial products and asset classes, with an appreciation of how transactions flow from source product systems to financial reporting

jobs.title: Manager / Engineer - Pooling Substation/Switchyard (Wind Power Plant)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced **Manager / Engineer PSS** for Operations & Maintenance of **Pooling Substations associated with Wind Power Plants**.

  

The candidate will be responsible for safe and reliable operation, preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance and monitoring of **substation equipment, transformers, switchgear, protection systems and power evacuation systems**.

  

**Role & responsibilities**

  

1. **Pooling Substation Operations & Maintenance:** Manage complete day-to-day operations and maintenance activities of the Pooling Substation (PSS), ensuring safe, reliable and efficient electrical operations.

  

2. **Preventive & Breakdown Maintenance:** Plan and execute preventive, predictive, corrective and breakdown maintenance of substation electrical equipment to minimize failures and operational downtime.

  

3. **HT/EHV Electrical Equipment Maintenance:** Operate and maintain power transformers, HT/EHV switchgear, circuit breakers, isolators, CTs, PTs/CVTs, lightning arresters and associated substation equipment.

  

4. **33kV Collection & Power Evacuation Systems:** Monitor and maintain 33kV collection networks, HT/EHV switchyards and associated power evacuation systems to ensure reliable energy transmission.

  

5. **Transformer & Switchyard Equipment Inspection:** Conduct routine inspections of power transformers, switchyard equipment, electrical panels, batteries, auxiliary systems and associated electrical installations.

  

6. **Protection, Control & SCADA System Monitoring:** Monitor control and relay panels, protection relays, SCADA systems, DC supply systems, battery banks and battery chargers to ensure operational reliability.

  

7. **Electrical Testing & Maintenance Coordination:** Coordinate protection relay testing, circuit breaker testing, transformer testing, insulation testing and other scheduled electrical maintenance activities.

  

8. **Electrical Fault Diagnosis & Supply Restoration:** Investigate electrical faults, equipment trips and system abnormalities, coordinate troubleshooting and ensure safe and timely restoration of power supply.

  

9. **Shutdown Planning & Electrical Isolation:** Coordinate planned shutdowns, Permit-to-Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), equipment isolation, earthing and maintenance clearances with authorized personnel.

  

10. **Substation Performance & Equipment Health Monitoring:** Monitor voltage, current, power factor, transformer loading, equipment condition, energy evacuation and other operational parameters to maintain substation reliability.

  

11. **Maintenance Records & Technical Documentation:** Maintain operational logbooks, preventive maintenance schedules, equipment history, breakdown records, inspection checklists, electrical test reports and O&M documentation.

  

12. **Electrical Safety & Statutory Compliance:** Ensure strict compliance with PTW, LOTO, electrical isolation, earthing procedures, EHV safety requirements and applicable statutory regulations.

  

13. **Maintenance Team & Contractor Management:** Supervise Engineers, Technicians and contractor manpower, ensuring effective work allocation, maintenance productivity, technical quality and safe execution.

  

14. **PSS Operations & Performance Reporting:** Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports covering substation operations, equipment maintenance, tripping incidents, breakdowns, energy evacuation, manpower utilization and overall PSS performance.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

Candidates should have hands-on experience in **Wind/Solar Pooling Substation, Electrical Substation, Switchyard or Power Evacuation O&M**, with strong knowledge of transformers, switchgear, protection systems and HT/EHV electrical equipment.

jobs.title: Global AML Center, Vice President
jobs.description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are looking for an experienced leader with a strong track record in AML/KYC operations and transformation to provide senior leadership within the Global AML Center (GAC) in Hyderabad.
  
  
As part of the GAC leadership team, you will own delivery & transformation across AML/KYC portfolios - onboarding, event-driven reviews, periodic reviews, screening and quality assurance. You will also help shape and drive GAC’s strategic agenda. That means leading technology-enabled change, automation and AI adoption to build a scalable, standardized and data-led operating model. You will also take on Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) responsibilities for GAC: overseeing business management, budget and headcount planning, governance, and the site and people agenda in Hyderabad. You will balance strong day-to-day delivery with a clear view of where the function needs to be in the future.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The Global AML Center carries out AML/KYC activities as part of State Street’s global AML operating model. This includes Customer Identification Program (CIP), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), customer verification and customer risk rating across all business areas. Hyderabad is a key part of GAC’s global footprint.
  
  
Volumes, regulatory expectations and methodology changes keep growing, and adding capacity alone is not a sustainable answer. This role is central to changing how GAC operates: cutting manual effort, strengthening controls through technology and data, and positioning GAC as a strategic partner to the business rather than a purely operational function. As GAC grows, it also needs strong business management discipline: clear financial and headcount oversight, consistent governance, and a well-run site and people agenda.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As Vice President you will:
  
  
***Operational Leadership***

* Provide senior leadership for GAC operations in Hyderabad and act as a key point of contact for local India management and global stakeholders
* Own end-to-end delivery across assigned AML/KYC portfolios against agreed service, quality, risk and productivity standards
* Keep active oversight of volumes, pipeline, ageing and capacity, and raise emerging pressure before it affects delivery or compliance
* Set clear priorities across BAU, new business, remediation and regulatory commitments, and move resources as demand changes

***Strategy & Technology Change***

* Help shape GAC’s strategic direction and multi-year transformation roadmap, in line with business growth, regulatory change and the target operating model
* Lead strategic change initiatives from idea through to delivery and adoption, with clear business cases, measurable outcomes and benefits tracking
* Act as the business lead for technology change, working with Technology, product and change teams on enhancements to KYC platforms, workflow tools and data capability
* Identify and drive opportunities for automation, AI, digitization and workflow integration that reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times and strengthen controls
* Champion data-led decision making through better MI, dashboards and real-time visibility of pipeline, risk and performance
* Make sure process, policy and methodology changes are turned into sustainable system and operational changes, reducing reliance on manual workarounds
* Prioritize the change portfolio and balance investment, capacity and risk to deliver the greatest business value
* Build a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, and grow change and digital capability within the team

***Business Management & CAO***

* Act as CAO for GAC, partnering with the GAC Head on business management, planning and execution of the leadership agenda
* Lead annual budget, headcount and workforce planning, including capacity models, run-rate tracking, attrition and backfill planning
* Track expenses, productivity and cost efficiency, and support business cases for investment and location strategy
* Run the GAC management operating rhythm, including leadership meetings, governance forums, management reporting and executive or board materials
* Coordinate senior stakeholder and regulatory reporting, ensuring information is accurate, consistent and on time
* Track key initiatives, decisions and actions across the leadership team, making sure commitments are followed through
* Oversee administrative controls, including policies and procedures, entitlements and access, business continuity and resilience planning
* Partner with HR, Finance, Procurement, Real Estate and Technology on hiring, onboarding, workforce management, space and infrastructure
* Lead the Hyderabad site and culture agenda, including employee engagement, communications, town halls, recognition and talent programs

***Risk, Control & Governance***

* Maintain a strong control environment in line with AML/KYC policies, procedures and regulatory requirements
* Identify and address emerging operational and regulatory risks before they affect the business, and escalate where needed
* Ensure new technology, automation and AI solutions are put in place with appropriate controls, governance and risk oversight
* Support audit, regulatory and governance requirements

***Stakeholder Leadership***

* Work with Business Units, Compliance, Technology and Risk teams to resolve dependencies, close control gaps and drive accountability
* Represent GAC in senior forums with clear, fact-based views on delivery, strategy, risk, capacity and the decisions required
* Influence senior stakeholders to secure support and investment for strategic and technology initiatives

***People Leadership***

* Attract, develop and retain strong talent, and build leadership depth and succession across the Hyderabad organization
* Hold managers and teams accountable for outcomes while empowering them to make decisions, and create opportunities for them to realize their full potential
* Lead teams through change, building adoption and new ways of working

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD, client onboarding, periodic reviews, screening and financial crime controls
* Strategic thinking: the ability to set direction and turn a long-term vision into executable plans
* A proven track record of leading technology-enabled transformation, automation or digital change in a regulated environment
* An understanding of how workflow platforms, data, automation and AI can redesign operating models
* Proven ability to lead large, complex teams, including managing other managers
* A forward-looking approach to risk, with the ability to anticipate issues rather than react to them
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using MI, KPIs and capacity data to drive decisions
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively
* Strong business management and financial acumen, including budgeting, headcount and workforce planning
* Ability to run a disciplined management rhythm and produce clear executive and board-level materials
* A collaborative leadership style that balances empowerment with accountability

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of relevant experience in AML/KYC, financial crime or operations within a large global financial institution
* Demonstrated experience leading strategic transformation and technology change programs, from business case to adoption
* Significant senior people leadership experience, including leading leaders

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide.
