jobs.title: IT Business Lead Analyst - Vice President
jobs.description:
Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Citi enables clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.
  
  
The Derivatives Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions to Citi’s Risk organization which manages Citi’s exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software used to compute metrics that help mitigate Citi’s exposure to counterparty default. These include computation of optimal Margin Allocation for Portfolios and Trades, Haircut for Security and Cash Collateral, Trade and Collateral Liquidity, Collateral Concentration Levels and Wrong Way Risk, amongst others.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Liaise with stakeholders across the Risk and Front Office Technology, Counterparty Risk Management, Finance and Front Office business organizations, and external Market Regulators to assemble business requirements for Counterparty Risk Technology projects.
* Manage expectations of various stakeholder groups and help negotiate solutions to complex problems.
* Project manage complex Counterparty Credit Risk projects end to end. Accurately record, maintain, and report Program/Project management tracking data such as milestones via Citi’s internal project tracking systems.
* Help assemble/manage detailed documentation covering Counterparty Risk calculations and other processing, to be used to discuss technology implementation details with the Business users and Market Regulators in various countries/regions. Create flow diagrams, structure charts, and other types of system or process representations when appropriate.
* Facilitate and drive project meetings with both business and technology teams.
* Develop and review test scripts with business users as well as technology teams for System, User and Impact testing.
* Understand, analyse, and explain counterparty mark-to-future exposures on Derivatives books to users. Investigate Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA and related calculations for internal risk management and BASEL regulatory capital reporting based on the exposure profiles generated by the systems.
* Ability to trace changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and or legal agreements.
* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to demonstrate and analyse risk calculations.

**Knowledge/Experience:**

* 10-15 years related experience in Business Analysis and Project Management in Capital Markets domain.
* SDLC awareness including knowledge of quality issues in software development.
* Excellent understanding of the mechanics and life cycle of derivatives products, including Options, Futures, Forwards and Swaps. Knowledge of Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) products an advantage.
* Excellent understanding of Counterparty Credit Risk
* Potential Future Exposure, Margin (ISDA MNA and CSA), Collateral Haircut, Liquidity and Period of Risk, Settlement Risk.
* Understanding of Basel III/IV and any other relevant Risk Regulations and measures including PSE, RWA, EAD.
* Knowledge of Market Risk an advantage including Credit Value Adjustment (CVA).
* Extensive project management experience, including co-ordination across remote global teams.
* Where required supervise day-to-day staff management issues, work allocation but especially mentoring/coaching.
* Data Analysis capabilities (Database or Spreadsheet), with extensive experience using Excel required.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree an advantage.
* Graduate in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) or Finance disciplines.
* FRM/CFA or other Financial mathematics degree or certification is an advantage.

*Exceptional candidates who do not meet these criteria may be considered for the role provided they have the necessary skills and experience.*
**Competencies:**

* Excellent verbal and written English.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a large global team.
* Ability to take ownership and proactively follow up on issues.
* Ability to work well under pressure, to agreed and often challenging deadlines.
* Strong organization skills.

* Escalate delivery risks, dependencies and control issues promptly.
* Establish clear hand-offs, escalation paths, priorities and shared delivery plans across time zones.

jobs.title: Vice President, Technical Lead(FIX Order)- Equities
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Innovation Hub Overview**
Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate IT Equities Technology
  
  
Jefferies’ Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum—cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed & OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front-office workflows end-to-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting. Operating in a 24x7 follow-the-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C++/C#, cloud, modern visualization, low-latency messaging, and in-memory data stores—often developing new platforms from the ground up with clear ownership and impact. Role Overview
  
  
The Connectivity team is seeking a Vice President to lead the regional FIX Order and Execution Systems team based in Pune. This is a hands-on team leadership role with responsibility for setting priorities, allocating work, developing engineers, and coordinating the team’s delivery and production support. The team lead must bring proven experience leading technical teams, deep equities trading and FIX connectivity expertise, and a collaborative, accountable working style. The team’s technical scope includes FIX configuration, sell-side broker connectivity, messaging and system-performance analytics, automated testing, and CI/CD implementation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the local Pune regional team day to day: set priorities, allocate work, balance delivery and production-support demands, and maintain clear ownership and escalation paths within the team.
* Develop team capability through coaching, regular feedback, knowledge sharing, and delegation; build a supportive environment where engineers raise risks early and take ownership of outcomes.
* Represent the Pune team in global planning and incident coordination, communicating the local team’s capacity, dependencies, risks, and commitments and coordinating handovers with peer teams in other regions.
* Lead the design, implementation, certification, and production support of FIX order and execution systems.
* Translate front-office trading requirements into FIX session configurations, message mappings, validation rules, and routing logic.
* Configure and support sell-side broker FIX connectivity, including new sessions, client migrations, and production changes.
* Analyze FIX messages and application behavior across the complete order lifecycle.
* Diagnose session management, sequence, validation, order-state, reject, routing, and downstream processing issues.
* Build or enhance tools for connectivity configuration, certification, monitoring, and operational support.
* Analyze message volumes, latency, throughput, burst patterns, queue behavior, and capacity.
* Develop AI-assisted models or tools for generating and prioritizing test scenarios for FIX order and execution systems.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for configuration, code, testing, and deployment.
* Develop applications and automation using Java or Python.
* Define production-readiness criteria, monitoring requirements, support procedures, and rollback plans.
* Lead incident investigation and root-cause analysis for significant connectivity issues.

Required Qualifications
  
  

* Generally, 10 years of FIX engineering experience, with a strong emphasis on hands-on engineering of FIX order and execution systems, together with demonstrated experience leading a technical team.
* Proven experience leading a local technical team, including work allocation, coaching, delivery oversight, and production-support coordination, while collaborating with peer teams in other locations.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve outcomes through others: delegate effectively, give constructive feedback, resolve competing priorities, and build team capability rather than rely on individual intervention.
* Extensive experience with electronic equities trading and front-office FIX order and execution systems.
* Strong knowledge of the FIX protocol, including session and application layers.
* Experience configuring and supporting sell-side broker FIX connectivity.
* Detailed understanding of equity order messages and order-state transitions.
* Experience diagnosing FIX rejects, session failures, sequence issues, mapping problems, and routing defects.
* Experience analyzing messaging performance, latency, throughput, and system behavior.
* Intermediate or stronger development skills in Java or Python.
* Experience with automated build, test, deployment, and CI/CD tooling.
* Strong production-support, incident-management, leadership, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Familiarity with FIX Orchestra, FIX dictionaries, custom tags, and venue-specific extensions.
* Experience with QuickFIX/J, proprietary FIX platforms, ULLINK product suite, or comparable FIX technology; experience with Verifix or other FIX simulation tools.
* Experience with Solace, Kafka, or equivalent messaging platforms.
* Experience applying AI or machine learning to test generation, failure analysis, or operational analytics.
* Experience with Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or Elastic.

**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
  
  
At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.
  
  
Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

**Job Title: Technology Lead - Tribe Passport & Cloud Engineering**

**Role Description**

The role will lead the design and delivery of reusable cloud engineering, automation and DevOps capabilities, and provide senior technical ownership of Tribe Passport, a strategic ATO platform for engineering and management insights.

The successful candidate will take complex engineering challenges from concept to production, delivering secure, resilient and reusable solutions for adoption across multiple teams and applications.

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents

* Complex platform and application engineering problems move efficiently from architecture to production, with clear ownership and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Engineering controls covering security, OSS, deployment and operational readiness are embedded in engineering workflows rather than evidenced manually afterwards.
* Cloud and platform capabilities are designed for reuse and scale, reducing duplication and reliance on platform-specific implementation knowledge.
* Engineering teams benefit from clear technical standards, mentoring and reusable patterns that allow them to deliver more independently.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Extensive hands-on software and/or platform engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership of complex enterprise applications, cloud platforms or engineering capabilities.
* Strong development capability in Java and/or Python, with the ability to review code and designs, troubleshoot complex issues and contribute directly when required.
* Deep practical Google Cloud experience, ideally across GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL/PostgreSQL, Secret Manager, IAM/service accounts, networking, load balancing and observability.

* Proven delivery leadership covering architecture, backlog and dependency manage

**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Citi enables clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.

  
  

The Derivatives Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions to Citi’s Risk organization which manages Citi’s exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software used to compute metrics that help mitigate Citi’s exposure to counterparty default. These include computation of optimal Margin Allocation for Portfolios and Trades, Haircut for Security and Cash Collateral, Trade and Collateral Liquidity, Collateral Concentration Levels and Wrong Way Risk, amongst others.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  
  

* Liaise with stakeholders across the Risk and Front Office Technology, Counterparty Risk Management, Finance and Front Office business organizations, and external Market Regulators to assemble business requirements for Counterparty Risk Technology projects.

* Manage expectations of various stakeholder groups and help negotiate solutions to complex problems.

* Project manage complex Counterparty Credit Risk projects end to end. Accurately record, maintain, and report Program/Project management tracking data such as milestones via Citi’s internal project tracking systems.

* Help assemble/manage detailed documentation covering Counterparty Risk calculations and other processing, to be used to discuss technology implementation details with the Business users and Market Regulators in various countries/regions. Create flow diagrams, structure charts, and other types of system or process representations when appropriate.

* Facilitate and drive project meetings with both business and technology teams.

* Develop and review test scripts with business users as well as technology teams for System, User and Impact testing.

* Understand, analyse, and explain counterparty mark-to-future exposures on Derivatives books to users. Investigate Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA and related calculations for internal risk management and BASEL regulatory capital reporting based on the exposure profiles generated by the systems.

* Ability to trace changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and or legal agreements.

* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to demonstrate and analyse risk calculations.
  

  

**Knowledge/Experience:**

  
  

* 8-12 years related experience in Business Analysis and Project Management in Capital Markets domain.

* SDLC awareness including knowledge of quality issues in software development.

* Excellent understanding of the mechanics and life cycle of derivatives products, including Options, Futures, Forwards and Swaps. Knowledge of Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) products an advantage.

* Excellent understanding of Counterparty Credit Risk

* Potential Future Exposure, Margin (ISDA MNA and CSA), Collateral Haircut, Liquidity and Period of Risk, Settlement Risk.

* Knowledge of Market Risk an advantage including Credit Value Adjustment (CVA).

* Where required supervise day-to-day staff management issues, work allocation but especially mentoring/coaching.

* Graduate in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) or Finance disciplines.

* FRM/CFA or other Financial mathematics degree or certification is an advantage.

*Exceptional candidates who do not meet these criteria may be considered for the role provided they have the necessary skills and experience.*

  
  

**Competencies:**

  
  

* Excellent verbal and written English.

* Ability to collaborate effectively in a large global team.

* Ability to take ownership and proactively follow up on issues.

* Ability to work well under pressure, to agreed and often challenging deadlines.

Citi enables clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.

  
  

The Derivatives Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions to Citi’s Risk organization which manages Citi’s exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software used to compute metrics that help mitigate Citi’s exposure to counterparty default. These include computation of optimal Margin Allocation for Portfolios and Trades, Haircut for Security and Cash Collateral, Trade and Collateral Liquidity, Collateral Concentration Levels and Wrong Way Risk, amongst others.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  
  

* Liaise with stakeholders across the Risk and Front Office Technology, Counterparty Risk Management, Finance and Front Office business organizations, and external Market Regulators to assemble business requirements for Counterparty Risk Technology projects.

* Manage expectations of various stakeholder groups and help negotiate solutions to complex problems.

* Project manage complex Counterparty Credit Risk projects end to end. Accurately record, maintain, and report Program/Project management tracking data such as milestones via Citi’s internal project tracking systems.

* Help assemble/manage detailed documentation covering Counterparty Risk calculations and other processing, to be used to discuss technology implementation details with the Business users and Market Regulators in various countries/regions. Create flow diagrams, structure charts, and other types of system or process representations when appropriate.

* Facilitate and drive project meetings with both business and technology teams.

* Develop and review test scripts with business users as well as technology teams for System, User and Impact testing.

* Understand, analyse, and explain counterparty mark-to-future exposures on Derivatives books to users. Investigate Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA and related calculations for internal risk management and BASEL regulatory capital reporting based on the exposure profiles generated by the systems.

* Ability to trace changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and or legal agreements.

* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to demonstrate and analyse risk calculations.
  

  

**Knowledge/Experience:**

  
  

* 10-15 years related experience in Business Analysis and Project Management in Capital Markets domain.

* SDLC awareness including knowledge of quality issues in software development.

* Excellent understanding of the mechanics and life cycle of derivatives products, including Options, Futures, Forwards and Swaps. Knowledge of Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) products an advantage.

* Excellent understanding of Counterparty Credit Risk

* Potential Future Exposure, Margin (ISDA MNA and CSA), Collateral Haircut, Liquidity and Period of Risk, Settlement Risk.

* Understanding of Basel III/IV and any other relevant Risk Regulations and measures including PSE, RWA, EAD.

* Knowledge of Market Risk an advantage including Credit Value Adjustment (CVA).

* Extensive project management experience, including co-ordination across remote global teams.

* Where required supervise day-to-day staff management issues, work allocation but especially mentoring/coaching.

* Data Analysis capabilities (Database or Spreadsheet), with extensive experience using Excel required.
  

  

**Education:**

  
  

* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree an advantage.

* Graduate in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) or Finance disciplines.

* FRM/CFA or other Financial mathematics degree or certification is an advantage.

*Exceptional candidates who do not meet these criteria may be considered for the role provided they have the necessary skills and experience.*

  
  

**Competencies:**

**Role Purpose**

  

The role holder will manage end-to-end depository participant operations within a regulated bank environment, encompassing demat account opening and servicing, settlement monitoring, reconciliations, income and DP charge controls, and regulatory reporting. The role will ensure accurate and timely execution in accordance with applicable SEBI requirements, NSDL/CDSL rules and bye-laws, PMLA, and HSBC policies and operating procedures.

  

The incumbent will drive operational efficiency and customer service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services, maintain robust risk and control standards, manage audit and regulatory review requirements, and implement regulatory and system changes within prescribed timelines.

  

**Principal Accountabilities**

* + Oversee demat account opening, modification, servicing and closure, including verification of client documentation and KYC/AML requirements, periodic account reviews, and corporate demat requests.
  + Ensure accurate and timely processing of dematerialisation and rematerialisation requests (DRF/RRF), Delivery Instruction Slips (DIS), pledge, un-pledge and invocation requests, and off-market and inter-depository transfers.
  + Monitor settlement cycles and ensure timely reconciliation with depositories and clearing corporations.
  + Oversee daily, weekly and monthly reconciliations of client holdings, DP balances, suspense accounts and control accounts; investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks.
  + Manage provisioning of income entries and reconciliation of DP charges in coordination with Finance/Accounts.
  + Prepare and submit regulatory and depository reports within prescribed timelines and maintain accurate MIS for management review and compliance oversight.

**Customers / Stakeholders**

  + Liaise with NSDL/CDSL, registrars and transfer agents (RTAs), Finance/Accounts, Compliance and other internal stakeholders to resolve servicing and operational matters.
  + Drive customer-centric improvements in turnaround time and service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services.
  + Act as the principal contact for Demat operational and regulatory matters across Operations, Compliance, Legal, Technology, Risk, Finance, Treasury, the business and relevant depositories.
  + Coordinate responses to regulatory queries, inspections, internal and external audits, and compliance reviews.
  + Drive cross-functional actions independently, secure clear ownership and deliver within agreed timelines.
  + Provide concise management reporting on key operational risks, regulatory actions, exceptions and outstanding deliverables.
  + Promote disciplined execution, clear accountability and strong collaboration across first- and second-line stakeholders.

* **Leadership and Teamwork**
  

* + Demonstrate ownership and accountability for assigned DP operations and coordinate with stakeholders to meet operational, regulatory and audit deadlines.
  + Work collaboratively with branches, service teams, Compliance, Finance and Technology on regulatory implementation, escalations and process changes.

* **Operational Effectiveness & Control**
  

* Conduct periodic process and control reviews to identify operational and regulatory risks.
* Own audit and inspection observations, agree remediation plans and ensure timely, evidenced closure.
* Monitor implementation of regulatory and product changes and confirm that required controls operate effectively.
* Proactively identify and escalate material operational, regulatory, conduct or control risks.
* Regulatory and business deliverables completed within prescribed timelines.
* Timely and sustainable closure of audit, inspection, compliance and control actions.
* Accuracy and completeness of regulatory trackers, governance records, evidence and management information.
* Reduction in repeat exceptions, overdue actions and material control gaps.
* Effective implementation of regulatory, product and process changes with appropriate documentation and stakeholder sign-off.
* Positive stakeholder feedback and effective escalation of material risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation and digitisation to reduce manual intervention and operational errors.
* Track new and revised regulatory and depository circulars and implement required process and control changes within defined timelines.
* Identify operational risks and ensure adherence to maker-checker controls, segregation of duties, standard operating procedures and HSBC operational risk frameworks.
* Monitor exceptions, failed transactions and reconciliation breaks, ensuring timely resolution and escalation of control issues.
* Strengthen controls over DIS usage, fraud prevention and unauthorised transactions, and maintain adherence to applicable KYC/AML, PMLA and depository requirements.
* Manage internal and concurrent audits, compliance inspections and regulatory reviews relating to DP operations; ensure closure of observations within stipulated timelines.
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards and ensure timely implementation of actions arising from audits and regulatory reviews.
  

This specialist role requiring independent judgement, strong execution discipline and the ability to influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders. The role holder will operate within approved product programmes, HSBC policies, procedures and governance standards, escalating matters outside delegated authority or risk appetite.

The role holder will maintain HSBC internal control standards, comply with relevant Group and local policies and procedures, and ensure timely implementation and closure of internal and external audit points and issues raised by regulators, Compliance or Risk.

  

**Role requirements / Educational Qualifications /Certification / Experience:**

  

* Graduate or postgraduate qualification, with relevant experience in banking or financial services, preferably across Liabilities, Banking Operations, Product Management and/or Demat/DP Operations
* 4–10 years of experience in DP operations, custody operations or capital markets operations within a bank, brokerage or financial institution, with hands-on experience of NSDL/

jobs.title: Chief Data Office - Data Management & Governance Lead - Vice President
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

**Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the Business to provide a comprehensive view.**

As a Data Governance Lead (Vice President) within the Chief Data Office, you will lead Markets data quality and data lineage initiatives, partnering across business, control functions, and Technology to deliver measurable risk reduction, operational efficiency, and regulatory-ready outcomes.

**Job Responsibilities :**

* Lead discussions with technology teams to agree and implement technical solutions for data quality remediation, including control automation/industrialization, monitoring, and evidence generation where appropriate.
* Discover and document end-to-end data lineage, tracing data from creation to consumption to support regulatory requirements such as BCBS 239 and internal standards for critical data elements and critical data flows.
* Partner with Markets operations, technology, and product control teams to establish and document data quality controls across critical data flows, including control points, thresholds, exception workflows, and ownership.
* Implement and champion Data Quality practices across the Commercial & Investment Bank, supporting firmwide regulatory and strategic objectives by defining and driving adoption of data quality standards, thresholds, remediation SLAs, and control expectations.
* Provide advisory services on high-profile data initiatives, leveraging project management and business analysis expertise to embed data quality, data lineage, and control requirements into strategic change (e.g., platform migrations, new product initiatives) from inception.
* Influence and guide stakeholders at all levels to drive adoption of data quality standards and best practices, and lead stakeholder forums to drive decisioning, escalations, and risk acceptance where required.
* Represent the Chief Data Office in cross-functional forums, contributing to the development of data management strategies and frameworks, including data quality strategy, issue management cadence, control documentation standards, data lineage documentation standards, and executive-level materials for senior stakeholders.
* Define and maintain management reporting (KPIs/KRIs) for data quality performance, including issue aging, defect recurrence, lineage completeness, and control coverage, to support senior decision-making.
* Apply AI/LLM tools to accelerate data quality investigations and delivery (e.g., drafting lineage/control documentation, synthesizing investigation findings, generating validation logic/test cases), ensuring appropriate data handling, human oversight, and adherence to firm policies.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Significant experience in financial services, with a background in operations, finance, program management, data analytics, or business analysis, and demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional delivery across business and Technology stakeholders.
* Proven track record leading projects or business-as-usual initiatives focused on data quality, data lineage, control documentation, and metadata management, with clear accountability for outcomes, issue management cadence, and closure discipline.
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think strategically and connect detailed analysis to broader business objectives, including translating complex investigations into executive-ready options and recommendations.
* Proficiency in manipulating and analyzing large data sets using Excel (pivots, formulas, charts) and other data tools to validate issues, quantify impact, and evidence remediation effectiveness.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with experience engaging senior stakeholders across business and technology, including chairing working groups and contributing to senior steering forums.
* Self-starter with strong time management and organizational skills; adept at managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality outcomes under pressure while operating with strong risk discipline and attention to controls.
* Deep understanding of business practices and products within the Commercial & Investment Bank, with a focus on Markets.
* AI/LLM experience (required): demonstrated experience using AI/LLM tools to improve productivity in data quality and data lineage documentation, analysis, and/or control design, with strong judgment around confidentiality, appropriate use, and required human review/validation.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Expertise in data quality, data lineage, metadata management, and data control concepts, including standards and control frameworks.
* Experience in a Chief Data Office or Data Quality organization within an investment bank or large financial institution.
* Proficiency in querying databases or data stores for advanced data analysis.
* Skilled in producing executive-level PowerPoint presentations for senior audiences.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as BCBS 239 and industry best practices in data management, and ability to translate regulatory expectations into practical data quality, data lineage, and control outcomes.

Morgan and Chase brands. **Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Job Description-**

Citi operates through five major business divisions — Services, Markets, Banking and International, Wealth, and U.S. Personal Banking. Each of these generates complex financial data and transactions that require robust technology infrastructure. Technology and Business Enablement is the division that cuts across all of them, providing shared platforms, controls, and transformation programs. Finance Technology lives within T&BE, making it a truly enterprise-wide function, delivering technology solutions for Finance, Accounting, Regulatory Reporting, and Treasury across all Citi businesses globally.

**Responsibilities**:

The Finance Technology Product Management Analyst is a strategic professional who owns defining our overarching product strategy, spearheading business engagement and transformation and contributing to directional strategy for AI, integration and automation capabilities. It is a Techno-functional hands-on role with experience building products that solve real and pressing problems in highly complex and regulated environments.

Key responsibility will be to define Product vision, strategy and roadmap, develop solution proposals, business cases, solution design and tactics in engagement with Business and Technology stakeholders.

This role will be responsible for leading business process redesign, map existing and to-be processes for operational optimization, digital transformation initiatives.

With Data at the heart of everything we do, this role will require strong data analytical skills (using programming or AI tools), tracing lineage of data, and developing conceptual and logical data models.

The role is expected to drive cross-functional collaboration and effective communication with business and technology partners, to guide, influence and convince others and lay the direction for Product development.

* Ownership of the Product backlog and roadmap, strategy, outlining the vision and direction for the product offering over time, to ensure users derive the most value possible from the product.

* Leada culture of innovation, “test and learn” experiments to create platform products that increase customer value. Analyze gaps in capabilities, opportunities for optimization and efficiency and enhancing user experience, remediating risk, and control gaps.

* Defines and measures the KPIs for a platform product

* Is able to make trade-off decisions on multiple platform products in a portfolio

* Develop solution proposals, business cases, and budget requests

* Drive stakeholder alignment and iterative product delivery

* Lead business process redesign, operational optimization, digital transformation initiative and change management

* Manage cross-functional dependencies, regulatory and risk alignment, user adoption and change management.

* Work with Data: Data analysis to document business requirements at the right level, draw meaningful insights, and visualize conceptual and logical data models and flows. Collaborate with various teams and application owners to unify data concepts across finance applications across Citi.

If you've been experimenting with new models, new tooling, or new patterns, that's exactly the kind of thinking we want in the room.

* Appropriately assess risk and impact when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.

* Communicate like it matters. We're distributed across three continents. Clear, direct, proactive communication isn't a soft skill here. It's how the work gets done.

* Keep safety non-negotiable. We're building AI systems inside a global bank. Security, compliance, and AI safety aren't afterthoughts. You'll build with all of it in mind from the start. Report control gaps with transparency and take accountability of deliveries.

Familiarity with Financial products and asset classes, with an appreciation of how transactions flow from source product systems to financial reporting

jobs.title: Corporate Credit Underwriter - Commodities - Senior Vice President
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.

  
  

Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise. Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

  
  

ICM Underwriters manage a portfolio of relationships, being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with Business and Risk.

The successful candidate will join the Commodities Underwriting team and will manage a group of junior analysts based in Mumbai who support Underwriters in London. The Commodities Underwriting team is responsible for the coverage of commodity traders as well as clients from other commodity related industries globally.

**In this role, you’re expected to:**

  
  

Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting, including, but not limited to:

  
  

* Maintains underwriting coverage of an existing portfolio of clients while supporting the underwriting of prospective commodities managed clients (CMC); the geographical coverage will include companies from Europe and Asia.
* Manage a team of 4/5 junior analysts in Mumbai by focusing on talent development, workflow management, and performance evaluations.
* Adoption of leading practices in credit analysis, underwriting, and monitoring, including the end-to-end underwriting process, from early origination discussions to development of credit approval memos, and senior approval forums.
* Detailed review of financial analysis, due diligence, projection modeling, stress testing, risk ratings and other in-depth analysis performed by junior resources.
* Review and approval of Credit Approval Memos (CAM) packages for monitoring or transaction purposes.
* Partner with Front Office on structuring and production of term sheets for new transactions.
* Partners with Legal in the negotiation of credit terms related to trading documentation (such as ISDA, EFET and other trading documents).
* Facilitate relationships with key clients in Banking and Risk and other control functions.
* Support ICM Underwriting organization on strategic initiatives / projects as required.

**Risk Management Experience:**

  
  

* Senior credit approval authority covering large and complex underwritings, capital commitments, derivatives with multi-industry experience.
* Ability to work independently, demonstrated credit judgement and experience navigating risk policies.
* Experience in and exposure to global credit risk management standards.
* Ability to understand capital markets products and complex financing and product structures including derivatives.
* Ability to provide strategic insights and strong sensitivity to macro and regulatory issues.
* Able to discuss and address issues associated with the allocation of risk assets and risk capital in partnership with banking and product organizations.

**Client Relationships / Business Partnership:**

  
  

* Proven ability to understand nuances of local markets, local regulation, and the capabilities and practices of competitors
* Navigates organizational complexity and breaks silos
* Creates and sustains a network of strong partnerships with the business in all segments, geographies and other risk functions
* Provides well-reasoned, balanced assessments of risk/return trade-offs associated with transactions and client relationships
* Proven track record of partnering with global peers in leveraging and implementation of best practices

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

  
  

* Around 13+ years risk/risk-related credit work experience in banking/financial institutions or a commodity trader.
* Proven ability to effectively engage with Senior Credit Officers.
* Prior experience in managing a small team is preferred.
* Demonstrates strong ethics and integrity.
* Ability to see the ‘big picture’ in a complex environment.
* Can make decisions under pressure and short timeline.
* Excellent verbal & written communication skills. Active listening skills.
* Excellent presentation skills – adept at presenting effectively to audiences of various sizes and various constituencies.
  

  

**Education:**

  
  

* Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred.

jobs.description:
**About Us:**
Mubadala Investment Corporation (MIC) is a global investor, owned by the Government of Abu Dhabi, with USD 300+ BN assets under management, five global offices and business investments in 50+ countries. We innovate and invest across the world to create lasting value for our shareholders, our partners, and future generations.
  
  
MIC has recognized that the next frontier in competitive advantage will be driven by the adoption of AI and Machine Learning technologies. In response, a new AI Enablement Unit is has been formed to lead the effort to define and implement an AI strategy and embed AI into the fabric of the MIC organization.
  
  
**What you will do:**
MIC has the ambition of embedding AI in everything that we do. As part of this journey, the AI Enablement Team is helping the business move beyond isolated use cases. The goal is to change how core work gets done through agent-based workflows.
  
  
To meet this ambition, we are looking for a Product Owner to connect the business with AI delivery. You will work with business and corporate functions to find where agents can redesign processes from start to finish. You will then coordinate the right way to deliver each solution: proprietary build, low-code, or citizen self-development.
  
  
You will turn business needs into clear designs for agent-based workflows and send each one to the right delivery team. You will also make sure solutions are adopted and deliver measurable value. You will help business teams build the skills and confidence to experiment, build and scale their own solutions safely.
  
  
The role operates within a matrix structure. You will work with AI Strategy & Transformation, to align priorities with the enterprise AI strategy. The AI PMO, on intake, planning, governance and progress reporting; and the AI Product leads, the AI Lab and engineering teams, so that solutions are consistent, reusable and coordinated across MIC.
  
  

* Redesign core business activities with AI at the core: Work with business users to map investment processes and redesign them around agent-based workflows, rather than small automation gains.
* Turn business needs into agent designs: Write clear workflow specifications covering agent roles, tasks, decision points, data sources and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Choose the delivery path: Review each use case and send it to proprietary build, low-code or citizen self-development, based on complexity, risk, scale and value.
* Connect business and technical teams: Act as the main link between business owners, AI Product leads, the AI Lab and engineering. Ensuring, priorities and acceptance criteria are clear.
* Support business developer capability: Set up and support a business developer community with templates, reusable agent patterns, and guidance on when to escalate to a proprietary build.
* Drive reuse and standards: Work with the AI Product and architecture teams to collect and share reusable agents, prompts, connectors and patterns across functions.
* Ensure responsible, secure AI: Apply guardrails, data access controls, human-in-the-loop flows and AI policy compliance across all delivery paths, including solutions built by citizen developers.
* Support the use cases pipeline: Run intake, prioritization and progress tracking in alignment with the product lead. Manage dependencies and keep the full portfolio visible.
* Drive change and adoption: Work with the AI transformation team to run discovery workshops, hackathons and training. Build a culture of experimenting and learning by trying.
* Measure value and performance: Work with AI Strategy & Transformation to define KPIs such as cycle time, hours saved, adoption and $ impact. Track results and improve towards targets.

**What will you bring:**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in an investment company, private equity firm, sovereign wealth fund, or a due diligence advisory practice.
* Minimum 3+ years of experience in AI transformation: worked in product or transformation roles that connect business to tech. Has delivered AI process redesign and implementation in complex organisations.
* Applied AI across the investment lifecycle: demonstrated business-facing experience applying AI across investment activities.
* Business-to-technology translation: proven experience partnering directly with business users to gather and challenge requirements, demonstrate solutions, align stakeholders, and translate business needs into technically actionable scope and requirements
* Delivery Oversight Exposure: Hands-on experience overseeing and actioning progress against roadmaps, tracking milestones, dependencies, and capacity across multiple initiatives.
* Technology & Delivery Context: Experience working closely with technology or delivery teams, with a clear understanding of delivery constraints, trade-offs, and sequencing challenges.
* Risk & Issue Management: Proven experience identifying, tracking, and managing risks and issues across complex programs or portfolios.
* Senior Stakeholder interaction: Experience presenting portfolio status, risks, and trade-offs to senior leadership and governance forums.

**Technical & Soft Skills**

* Software and data fluency: working knowledge of APIs, relational and non-relational databases, programming languages, and modern libraries, with ability to engage credibily with engineering teams and assess technical feasibility.
* Applied AI architecture: Practical knowledge of AI skills, agents, plugins and MCP integration, including how these components connect models, tools, enterprise data, and user workflows.
* Prioritization & Trade-off Management: Ability to balance value, feasibility, and capacity when making portfolio recommendations.
* Roadmap & Planning Discipline: Strong capability to build and maintain realistic, dependency-aware roadmaps.
* Risk & Issue Resolution: Ability to surface delivery challenges early, drive mitigation actions, and escalate appropriately.
* Coordination with multidisciplinary teams: Strong collaboration skills when working with product tracks, business stakeholders and delivery or technical teams.
* Clear sStatus cCommunication: Ability to provide leadership with an accurate, honest view of progress and challenges.
* Decision support: Ability to frame issues and options clearly, enabling timely decisions and driving their follow-through.

**What we offer:**
A superior platform to grow your career including:
  
  

* Making a difference with a social and financial impact
* Great working environment with talented colleagues
* Market leading pay and benefits including performance pay
* Hybrid working and wellness benefits to help you live your best work and private life
* Opportunity to grow and develop through learning and experience
* Excellent work culture enabled by our values of Accountability, Inspiration, Integrity & Partnership.

Mubadala has an excellent working culture, enabled by our values of Accountability, Inspiration, Integrity & Partnership. You will operate in a diverse, energetic, and forward-thinking environment with hybrid working and wellness benefits to help you grow and develop, and market leading pay and benefits.
  
  
**Key Indicators:**
**Location:**
Abu Dhabi

: Remote working up to 5 days a month

jobs.description:
About
**Bright Money**

Bright Money
is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi’s Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India.

**What is the role about?**

Bright is looking for a Director - Engineering to lead and scale a core part of our engineering organisation in Bengaluru, reporting to the CTO. You will own delivery and technical direction for the systems behind Bright’s consumer app, credit decisioning, and AI products, and you will build the leadership layer that runs them.

This is a leader-of-leaders role. You will manage engineering managers and leads, shape architecture and platform strategy for your area within the CTO’s technical direction, own headcount, budget, and cloud spend for your teams, and partner with Product, Data Sciences, and the wider leadership team on what gets built next.

Bright is profitable, scaling fast in the U.S. market, and building AI into both the product and how the company runs. The systems are distributed, data-heavy, and carry real money and credit decisions, so engineering quality is a business outcome here, not an internal metric.

**What will you do?**

* Lead your organisation: Own and scale a multi-team group, with engineering managers and leads reporting to you; set the operating rhythm, standards, and performance bar across your teams.
* Build the leadership layer: Hire, coach, and retain senior engineers, leads, and managers, and develop the next line of engineering leadership beneath you.
* Technical strategy: Shape and execute architecture and platform strategy across services, data, and developer tooling for your area, in line with the CTO’s technical direction, and make the build-versus-buy and platformisation calls that shape how fast your teams can ship.
* Delivery at scale: Own end-to-end delivery of distributed, data-heavy systems - roadmap commitments, release predictability, and the trade-offs between speed and durability.
* Reliability & risk: Own availability, performance, security, and the engineering side of compliance obligations for the systems your teams run in a U.S. consumer-lending business.
* AI & ML in production: Partner with Data Sciences to productionise ML and Gen AI systems-serving, monitoring, and retraining - and raise engineering leverage through AI tooling across the org.
* Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Data Sciences, Infrastructure, and business teams on priorities, sequencing, and the commitments engineering makes to them.
* Planning & budget: Own annual and quarterly planning for your area - headcount, vendor decisions, cloud cost and TCO, and the resourcing choices behind them.
* Reporting & visibility: Report clearly to the CTO and the wider leadership team on progress, risk, capacity, and investment, and contribute to leadership reviews as needed.

**Ideal candidate profile**

**Experience & Background:**

* Experience: 12+ years in engineering, with 5+ years in engineering leadership and at least 2 years managing managers or leads.
* Organisation scale: Has led a multi-team group of 20+ engineers, and has grown a team through a period of rapid scaling.
* Systems depth: Deep hands-on background in distributed, high-throughput, data-heavy systems; still able to go deep in a design review and hold a credible technical argument.
* Architecture & platform: Proven ownership of architecture, platformisation, and developer tooling, with evidence of the delivery gains those investments produced.
* ML & AI in production: Experience productionising ML or Gen AI systems in partnership with data science teams.
* Commercial ownership: Experience owning engineering budgets, cloud cost and TCO, vendor decisions, and resource planning.
* Hiring record: A strong track record of hiring and developing senior engineers and engineering managers.
* Domain: Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or another regulated, high-reliability consumer business is a strong plus.
* Location: Based in Bengaluru, or willing to relocate.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Ownership: Takes accountability for outcomes beyond their own remit, not only for their teams’ deliverables.
* Technical credibility: Earns the respect of senior engineers through judgment and depth, not position.
* Strategic thinking: Connects technical choices to business outcomes and can defend the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.
* Builder of leaders: Measures success by the strength of the managers and engineers they develop.
* Pace: Thrives in a high-growth environment where structure is still being built, and brings clarity rather than waiting for it.

**Non-Fit Profiles**

* Individual contributors or architects without sustained people-leadership experience.
* Managers who have led a single team, without experience managing managers or leading a group through scale.
* Leaders who have moved fully away from technical depth and cannot hold their own in architecture and design discussions.
* Candidates from large, process-heavy environments who need established structure, and are uncomfortable in a fast-moving, ambiguous setting.
* Delivery or programme managers without hands-on engineering ownership.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale - liquidity potential at $1-3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You own delivery and technical direction for a core part of the platform, with a direct line to the CTO.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Benefits: Excellent benefits package in line with sector best practice.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Credit Card Sales
jobs.description:
**About WeRize**

Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).

This customer segment is not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health/life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit.

While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need proper guidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.

Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when compared to upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t work for this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a high-impact, business-driven
**Chief Manager / Associate Director – Credit Card Sales**
to lead and scale our Credit Card vertical. In this role, you will be responsible for building end-to-end sales strategies, managing banking and co-branded card partnerships, and scaling credit card distribution across our social freelance partner network in 5,000+ small towns.

You will act as the single point of contact between bank partners, internal product/tech teams, and our freelancer channel to drive high-volume, cost-effective, and compliant credit card issuance tailored to India’s middle-income segment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Sales Execution**

* Own the P&L, sales targets, and portfolio growth for the Credit Cards vertical across 5,000+ towns.
* Formulate and execute scalable sales strategies to drive credit card adoption through our unique tech-enabled freelancer distribution platform (
  **‘Finance ki Online Dukaan’**
  ).
* Analyze regional performance, conversion funnels, and customer approval rates to continuously optimize sales pipelines.

**Partnership & Ecosystem Management**

* Onboard, manage, and scale partnerships with leading banks, card issuers, and fintech partners.
* Collaborate with partner institutions to design customer journeys, credit policies, and product variants tailored to Tier 2/3/4 customer profiles.
* Serve as the key liaison for day-to-day operations, SLA management, and approval rate optimizations with partner banks.

**Partner Enablement & Channel Engagement**

* Work alongside channel and marketing teams to design training modules, sales enablement toolkits, and commission/incentive structures for local freelancers.
* Drive engagement, active sourcing, and product cross-selling across the freelancer network to maximize card issuance.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with internal Product, Tech, and Analytics teams to enhance digital application flows, minimize friction, and automate approval pipelines.
* Ensure strict adherence to RBI guidelines, partner bank compliance, data privacy, and ethical selling practices across the freelance network.

**Qualifications & Skill Set**

* **Experience:**
  8 to 15 years of core experience in Credit Card sales, partner management, or unsecured lending within Banks, NBFCs, or Fintechs.
* **Distribution Expertise:**
  Proven track record in scaling financial products through indirect channels, agency networks, DSAs, or tech-enabled social/freelancer distribution.
* **Banking Partnerships:**
  Prior experience managing relationships, integrations, and SLAs with major credit card issuing banks.
* **Data-Driven Approach:**
  Deep understanding of approval funnels, customer acquisition metrics (CAC, LTV), and credit underwriting basics for middle-income segments.
* **Entrepreneurial Mindset:**
  Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, solve unstructured problems, and take complete ownership of product-line growth.

jobs.description:
**About Navi**

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.

**Why Explore a Career at Navi?**

**Where Ownership Creates Real Impact**

At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.

**Where Careers Accelerate**

Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.

**Where Great Talent Builds Together**

We take pride in building high talent-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.

**About the Team**

The Data Science team at Navi plays a central role in building intelligent solutions that power our products and drive business impact. We work across key domains such as Lending, Collections, KYC, UPI Growth and Ads recommendation, applying advanced machine learning/deep learning/GenAI techniques to solve high-impact challenges. Our work involves a diverse range of data types—including text, image, and tabular data—and we closely collaborate with cross-functional teams like Product, Business, Engineering, etc. to deliver end-to-end solutions.

**About the Role**

As a Senior Manager – Data Science, you will set the strategic direction and drive the execution of high-impact data science initiatives across Navi’s fast-growing business verticals. You will serve as a key decision-making leader, shaping business strategy and delivering solutions that fuel critical functions—from lending and collections to UPI and personalized recommendations. This role demands a balance of deep technical expertise and business intuition; you will lead a high-performing team of data scientists to design scalable systems that deliver measurable outcomes. If you are passionate about solving complex, real-world problems at scale and leading cross-functional teams to drive innovation, this is your opportunity to create significant business value.

**What You’ll Own**

1. Lead and Develop a High-Impact Team

* Attract, mentor, and retain top-tier data science talent while fostering a culture of continuous learning and high performance.
* Cultivate the next generation of technical leaders, ensuring autonomy and operational excellence.
* Oversee comprehensive talent management, including career development, performance evaluations, and team health.

2. Strategic Vision & Performance

* Define the long-term data science roadmap and align team objectives with critical business outcomes.
* Drive rigorous performance management, ensuring technical quality and project delivery align with organizational goals.

3. Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence

* Act as a strategic partner to Product, Business, and Engineering leadership to shape product strategy.
* Champion data-driven decision-making across the organization, influencing key business outcomes through actionable insights.

4. Model Quality & Operational Excellence

* Establish and enforce high standards for model reliability, scalability, and monitoring.
* Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of machine learning systems, ensuring robust alerting, cost optimization, and proactive issue resolution.

5. Strategic Planning & Innovation

* Lead quarterly and annual planning processes, ensuring project prioritization maximizes business impact.
* Identify and pursue high-value opportunities that leverage cutting-edge ML/GenAI techniques to drive innovation and competitive advantage.
* Champion engineering best practices, including rigorous documentation and scalable code management.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
* At least 9+ years of experience in data science or advanced analytics with a strong research-oriented mindset.
* Proven track record of directly managing and developing high-performing teams of data scientists.
* Deep expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Statistics, and Optimization algorithms.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and PySpark; experience with Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, SQL, and Scala.
* Hands-on experience building data pipelines, feature engineering, and deploying production-grade systems using Docker, Databricks, and Kubernetes.
* Experience developing and monitoring large-scale, automated ML workflows.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for Business, Product, and Engineering teams.
* Demonstrated success in implementing data science solutions that drive significant measurable business impact at scale.
* Proven ability to design and execute A/B experiments to optimize solutions across diverse business contexts.
* Experience in strategic planning, project management, and enforcing technical best practices.

**The Navi OS**

The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.

* **Start with the Customer**
* Master the Details
* Act with Urgency
* Own the Outcome
* Build for a Decade - Not a Day
* Win as One

We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation.

To read more about the Navi OS, visit
navi.com/our-values

**Life at Navi**

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.

If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page:
navi.com/careers/life-at-navi

If solving meaningful problems, building at scale and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you,

**Navi could be the place for you.**

**Company Description**
Opus Bloc Pvt. Ltd. is a fractional real estate platform in India that enables individuals to invest in premium properties through fractional ownership units called blocs, starting at ₹10,000. Each property is held via a dedicated Special Purpose Vehicle registered as an LLP, ensuring ownership is housed in a legally independent entity with details verifiable through Ministry of Corporate Affairs records. The Opus Bloc app streamlines the entire ownership journey, including onboarding, KYC, documentation, portfolio monitoring, and voting, while professional teams manage the properties. A secondary market for reselling holdings is under development, reinforcing liquidity and investor flexibility. Guided by the principles of Accessibility, Control, Transparency, and Ease (ACTE), the company focuses on making premium property ownership structured and accessible to a wider investor base in India.
  
**Role Description**
The Head of Growth is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad, responsible for driving user and revenue growth across the Opus Bloc platform. This role involves designing and executing growth strategies, leading customer acquisition initiatives, and optimizing the end-to-end funnel from awareness to conversion and retention. The Head of Growth will collaborate with product, marketing, and business development teams to test and scale growth experiments, analyze performance metrics, and refine campaigns for maximum impact. Daily responsibilities include overseeing growth marketing campaigns, coordinating sales and partnership efforts, managing budgets, and presenting growth insights and forecasts to leadership. The role also requires staying current with market trends and competitor activity in fractional real estate and fintech to identify new opportunities.
