jobs.title: Fincrime Quality Team Lead
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
We’re looking for a FinCrime Quality Team Lead to join our growing team.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
The main purpose of the Quality Control (QC) Team Lead role is to manage the performance of the QC team on an individual and team level, provide leadership, guidance, and direction to the quality assurance team to ensure the delivery of the right amount of QC reviews at the right time.
  
  
The QC Team Lead is responsible for managing performance and overseeing the activities of the quality assurance team. This includes task assignment, workload management, and ensuring that team members are aligned with priorities and objectives, while also actively promoting a positive and motivating work environment.
  
  
The QC Team Lead guarantees collaboration and opportunities to improve their stakeholders' (their assigned Service Operations area) state and scalability.
  
  
Activities performed on the job
  
  
Manages the quality assurance team on an individual and team level
  
  

* Performance management

+ Ensure timely delivery of QC reviews and keeps central task assignment documents up-to-date.
+ Completes demand vs capacity calculation for the QC team and assigned area.
+ Monitor and track the performance of QC specialists to ensure they meet or exceed set KPIs; identify and address performance issues or areas needing improvement through performance evaluations, feedback from stakeholders, or quality metrics analysis. Responsible for performance evaluation and recognition, assessing team performance, providing feedback, and recognizing achievements. Conducting regular performance reviews, setting and documenting development goals, and acknowledging outstanding contributions
+ Use mentoring, coaching and delegation in their team to create best practices for managing performance and for development opportunities.
+ Deliver monthly reports on team performance and KPIs.
+ Provides training and development opportunities for team members. This could include designing and delivering training programs, mentoring junior staff, and facilitating knowledge sharing sessions to enhance team capabilities.

* People management

+ Implements a monitoring system (talent map check ins) to identify team talents and provide support and development opportunities to those in need.
+ Talent map check-ins are completed twice a year by QC Lead
+ Propose decisions for direct reports like salary raise, promotion, leave approval, etc.
+ Hire, lead, develop and manage their quality team, including amongst others administrative tasks such as scheduling, interviewing, hiring, organising team activities, conducting the GrowWises’ etc
+ QC Lead is responsible for holding coaching sessions and 1:1s with their direct reports generally once every two weeks.
+ QC Lead is responsible for holding team meeting on a biweekly / monthly basis.
+ QC Lead is responsible for facilitating the sharing of information, skills, and best practices among team members to enhance collective learning and improve overall performance. QC Lead promotes a culture of knowledge sharing where team members feel encouraged and motivated to share their knowledge and expertise with one another.
+ QC Lead is responsible for pairing experienced team members with junior or less experienced colleagues to facilitate knowledge exchange.
+ QC Lead is responsible for regular team building activities to drive engagement in the team.
+ QC Lead is responsible for action planning based on Wiser Pulse results.

* Executing on strategy

QC Lead is responsible for aligning team objectives with broader organisational goals, ensuring the team is clear on the strategy and understands how their work supports it.
  
  
QC Lead is responsible for developing strategies to achieve targets and creating accessible documentation for these strategies.
  
  

* Quality reporting

+ Generating regular and timely reports on quality results, performance metrics, and key findings. The QC Team Lead communicates quality-related information to management and operational counterparts to facilitate decision-making and improve transparency.
+ Presents and delivers actionable insights and makes sure improvements are owned and followed up based on the stakeholder management framework.
+ Engage stakeholders to take necessary actions based on report findings and influence results positively.

* Change management

+ Effectively manages and communicates changes within their team (and to external stakeholders if needed) to ensure successful outcomes.
+ Ensures understanding so their team understands the nature and implications of any changes introduced. This involves providing clear explanations, answering questions, and addressing concerns to facilitate comprehension.
+ Facilitates adaptation and guides your team through changes, provides support, training, and resources as needed to facilitate a smooth transition.
+ Monitors progress and impact on their team's workflows and objectives. This involves gathering feedback, identifying challenges, and making adjustments as necessary to ensure successful integration.

* Manages stakeholder relationships

+ QC Lead is responsible for clear communication with stakeholders.
+ QC Lead is responsible for engaging with the stakeholders on weekly or monthly meetings to share key findings and insights from QC Reporting.
+ Conduct meetings with stakeholders according to a clear cadence, ensuring agendas are set, and notes are taken.
+ QC Lead is responsible for actionable insights to be formed on the stakeholder meetings and to find owners for the agreed actions and follow up and monitor and report impact.
+ Serving as the primary point of contact for communication between the quality assurance team and other stakeholders, including project managers, developers, and customers.
+ QC Lead is responsible for collecting stakeholder feedback and acting on shared improvement areas and stakeholder needs.
+ QC Lead takes part in assigned area’s tribe or regional planning where needed to ensure that QC Lead understands the plans / goals / strategy of their stakeholders and make sure that their actions support these objectives.
+ Proactively informs stakeholders of any changes and responds to queries within a reasonable timeframe.

* Operational efficiency

+ QC Lead is responsible for implementing continuous improvement initiatives within their quality assurance team / sharing ideas with peers and management.
+ QC Lead is responsible for their team’s use of tools and technology. This could include providing training on existing tools, and leveraging technology to streamline processes and improve efficiency.

**Qualifications**
**About you**

* You’re experienced — with at least 1 year in a FinCrime, Quality Control or Quality Assurance role.
* You’re knowledgeable — you understand procedures and processes, stay up-to-date, and understand Wise's products, tools, and policies.
* You proactively solve problems — identifying and addressing issues to implement improvements that benefit customers and the team.
* You’re customer-centric — always prioritising customer satisfaction and advocating for their needs within the organisation.
* You embrace adaptability — readily accepting change and quickly integrating new processes while maintaining quality.

jobs.title: Senior Manager of Software Engineering - Java, AWS, AI
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
When you mentor and advise multiple technical teams and move financial technologies forward, it's a big challenge with big impact. You were made for this.
  
  
As a Senior Manager of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within the Consumer and Community Banking, you serve in a leadership role by providing technical coaching and advisory for multiple technical teams, as well as anticipate the needs and potential dependencies of other functions within the firm. As an expert in your field, your insights influence budget and technical considerations to advance operational efficiencies and functionalities.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Provide overall direction, oversight, and coaching for a team of entry-level to mid-level software engineers that work on basic to moderately complex tasks
* Accountable for decisions that influence teams' resources, budget, tactical operations, and the execution and implementation of processes and procedures
* Sets and scales operating practices for enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering and SDLC/TLM automation across multiple teams to improve delivery speed, quality, and operational outcomes; establishes measurable expectations (e.g., throughput, defect reduction, reliability) and ensures consistent validation, security, resiliency, and reuse of proven patterns.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to drive efficiency and support capacity unlock initiatives across teams, prioritizing reuse of existing firm technology assets.
* Ensures successful collaboration across teams and stakeholders. Identifies and mitigates issues to execute a book of work while escalating issues as necessary
* Provides input to leadership regarding budget, approach, and technical considerations to improve operational efficiencies and functionality for the team
* Java, Spring, Spring Boot, Micro Services, Web Services SOAP/ReST, SQL, Oracle RDBMS, Design Patterns, Java Messaging, Cloud Foundry, Domain Driven Design, Event Driven Architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, No SQL, Kafka, Cassandra, Test Driven Development
* Develop and enhance Java-based backend services to support high-volume transaction processing. Build and operate solutions using AWS services (e.g., Aurora Postgres, ECS/Fargate, EC2 as applicable) with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Contribute to solution design by partnering with senior engineers/architects and participating in design reviews to ensure implementations align with technical standards and business needs.
* Use AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, where approved) to improve development efficiency, testing, and code quality.
* Follow and promote strong engineering practices (code reviews, CI/CD, testing, observability, documentation) and continuously improve the codebase. Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to clarify requirements and translate them into technical deliverables. Support security and compliance requirements by applying secure coding practices and adhering to Community Banking standards and applicable regulatory expectations

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience . In addition, 2 + years of experience leading technologists to manage and solve complex technical items within your domain of expertise
* Experience leading teams of technologists. Ability to guide and coach teams on approach to achieve goals aligned against a set of strategic initiatives
* Experience leading multi-team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and delivery tools, including defining governance/ways of working (human-in-the-loop validation, quality gates), measuring outcomes, and ensuring secure handling of sensitive inputs/outputs.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, resiliency/security implications, and control expectations; ability to coach managers/leads and influence leaders on safe scaling patterns.
* Experience with hiring, developing, and recognizing talent
* In-depth knowledge of the services industry and their IT systems
* Practical cloud native experience.
* Demonstrated experience with Java backend development, object-oriented design, and common design patterns.
* Experience with AWS (e.g., Aurora Postgres, ECS/Fargate, Glue and/or Airflow) and building distributed services.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to learn quickly in a complex domain.
* Solid communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and product teams.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Financial services and/or connected commerce experience is a plus, but not required.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Copilot) is a plus (confirm tool approval for your environment before use).
* Experience working at code level (preferred)

**About the Company**

Propelld is a new-age lending startup focused on the education market, with an annual INR 1,000 Cr disbursal. Backed by WestBridge Capital, Propelld is focused on scaling rapidly and building one of the largest FinTech businesses in India. The role offers significant exposure to growth, sales, partnerships and execution in a high-growth startup environment.

**About the Role**

We are hiring a
**Sales & Growth Manager (Founder’s Office)**
who will combine hands-on sales execution with growth initiatives and founder-level business support.

The role will involve actively visiting colleges, universities, coaching institutes and other education partners across Hyderabad, building relationships with key decision-makers, developing institutional partnerships and generating education-loan business. The candidate will also drive sales targets, manage team productivity and work closely with cross-functional teams to execute growth plans.

**Key Responsibilities / Expected Deliverables**

* Drive sales and business targets for the education lending product through direct customer engagement and institutional partnerships.
* Visit colleges, universities, coaching institutes and other relevant educational institutions to identify opportunities and build partnerships.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with institute management, placement teams, admission teams and other key stakeholders to generate business.
* Identify new institutes, activate partnerships and create a consistent pipeline of education-loan leads and disbursements.
* Manage the end-to-end sales process, including lead generation, customer engagement, follow-up, conversion and post-sales coordination.
* Set sales priorities, monitor daily/weekly performance and take corrective action to improve conversions and business outcomes.
* Maintain strong customer and partner relationships, including post-sales support and issue resolution to ensure customer satisfaction.
* Maintain accurate sales data, MIS and reporting for performance tracking, analytics and business reviews.
* Conduct product and market research, track competitor activity and identify new opportunities to improve growth.
* Work closely with Credit, Operations, Collections, RCU, Product, Marketing and Customer Support teams to align sales execution with business objectives.
* Support the Founder’s Office on growth initiatives, strategic projects, market expansion and execution of high-priority business plans.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management or a related field is preferred.
* Relevant experience in sales, business development, tele-sales, field sales or financial services. Experience in education loans, NBFCs, FinTech, insurance or investment products is preferred.
* Strong sales orientation with a demonstrated track record of achieving targets and delivering high performance.
* Experience managing or leading a team of 5 or more individuals, with the ability to recruit, train, coach and motivate a sales team.
* Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills, with the ability to convince and sell to individuals as well as institutional partners.
* Proficient in English and Hindi, with strong communication and presentation skills.
* Clear understanding of education finance products and the ability to quickly learn and explain new products.
* Comfortable with extensive field visits and institution-facing sales activity.
* Solution-oriented, proactive and able to demonstrate strong problem-solving capabilities.
* Strong analytical ability with comfort in sales MIS, reporting, funnel tracking and performance metrics.
* Actively seeking a high-growth startup environment with a strong willingness to contribute, learn and work hard.
* Comfortable working a six-day week, Monday to Saturday, with the 2nd Saturday off.
* Willing to work from and travel across Hyderabad as required for institute visits and business development.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Consistent achievement and growth of sales/disbursement targets.
* Strong pipeline of active college/institute partnerships and education-loan opportunities.
* Improved institute activation, lead generation and conversion.
* High productivity and performance of the sales team.

jobs.title: Head Forging
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic **Head Forging** to lead and manage forging operations within our Steel Division at Hyderabad. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in forging operations, production planning, process optimization, quality management, and team leadership within a steel or heavy manufacturing environment.

The incumbent will be responsible for overseeing end-to-end forging operations, ensuring production efficiency, product quality, workplace safety, cost optimization, and on-time delivery while driving continuous improvement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Forging Operations & Production Management**

* Lead and manage end-to-end forging operations, ensuring efficient utilization of manpower, machinery, and resources.
* Develop and execute production plans to meet business targets, quality standards, and delivery schedules.
* Oversee forging processes, including heating, billet preparation, hot forging, trimming, heat treatment coordination, and associated operations, as applicable.
* Monitor production output, cycle time, rejection rates, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
* Ensure optimum utilization of forging presses, hammers, furnaces, and related equipment.

**2. Process Optimization & Operational Excellence**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce cycle time, and minimize material wastage.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, energy conservation, and cost reduction.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, TPM, and other operational excellence practices.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for forging operations.

**3. Quality Management**

* Ensure compliance with established quality standards, customer specifications, and applicable industry requirements.
* Reduce rejection, rework, and scrap through root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions.
* Work closely with Quality and Engineering teams to resolve process-related quality issues.
* Ensure proper process control, traceability, and documentation throughout production.

**4. Maintenance & Equipment Management**

* Coordinate with the Maintenance team to ensure equipment reliability and minimum downtime.
* Drive preventive and predictive maintenance practices for forging equipment and furnaces.
* Support equipment upgrades, capacity expansion, tooling improvements, and new process implementation.

**5. Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to industrial safety standards, particularly for hot forging, furnace operations, material handling, and heavy equipment.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with applicable statutory and environmental requirements.
* Conduct regular safety reviews, risk assessments, and corrective action follow-ups.

**6. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop production managers, engineers, supervisors, and shop-floor teams.
* Establish clear performance objectives and accountability across the department.
* Identify training needs and improve technical competencies and workforce productivity.
* Foster collaboration across Production, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Supply Chain functions.

**7. Cost Control & Business Performance**

* Prepare and monitor departmental budgets, production costs, and resource utilization.
* Drive initiatives to reduce conversion costs, consumable costs, energy consumption, and manufacturing losses.
* Review daily, weekly, and monthly production performance and present operational reports to senior management.

**Educational Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification in Operations or Manufacturing Management would be an added advantage.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Minimum **15+ years of experience** in manufacturing, preferably in the steel, forging, automotive components, heavy engineering, or allied industries.
* Significant hands-on experience in forging operations and production management, preferably in a steel manufacturing environment.
* Proven experience in managing large-scale manufacturing operations, production teams, and shop-floor activities.
* Strong understanding of forging processes, tooling, metallurgy, heat treatment, quality systems, and manufacturing technologies, as applicable.
* Experience in production planning, capacity utilization, cost control, process improvement, and productivity enhancement.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, 5S, Kaizen, and root cause analysis methodologies.
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and deliver operational targets.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Production output and achievement of production targets.
* Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and machine utilization.
* Rejection, rework, and scrap reduction.
* Manufacturing cost and energy consumption per unit.
* On-time delivery and adherence to production schedules.
* Workplace safety performance and compliance.
* Implementation of productivity and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Global Process Owner Support (GPOS) role exists to strengthen first-line-of-defence risk management and governance across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes within Client Coverage. It supports Global Process Owners in embedding applicable policies, standards and controls into day-to-day business activities, helping the business manage operational and process risks consistently across markets. The role delivers oversight of control effectiveness, coordinated remediation of control gaps and exceptions, and clear reporting and escalation of material risks to support informed governance decisions. Working with business, country teams and second-line stakeholders, it also supports process simplification and the implementation of change with appropriate risk assessments and controls. Its primary focus is to maintain effective, consistent and efficient credit processes that support business delivery while operating within established risk tolerances.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

The role holder is an individual contributor with no formal people-management accountability. The role leads and coordinates assigned risk, control and process-improvement activities through stakeholder collaboration, supporting the Global Process Owner / delegate and GPOS Lead across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes. The role holder is accountable for the quality and timely delivery of assigned assessments, assurance oversight, reporting and remediation coordination; designated action owners remain responsible for completing their actions.
  
**Risk assessment and control implementation**  
• Implement applicable control requirements and procedures, and support each stage of the RCSA, from process and risk identification to monitoring implemented controls, at least annually and when trigger events occur, to maintain a current view of process and residual risks.
  
**Timely risk treatment**  
• Coordinate and track agreed elevated residual-risk actions and treatment plans with designated action owners, maintain records in the Group operational risk management system, and escalate delays to support timely completion.
  
**Learning from risk events**  
• Initiate Root Cause Reviews for in-scope material risk events and, where required, aggregate smaller events with similar root causes to identify recurring weaknesses and support corrective action.
  
**Controlled change delivery**  
• Identify delivery risks and dependencies, assess impacts on critical processes and residual risk, and review and support Operational and Change Risk Assessments and process-impact assessments before go-live, including minor changes where required.

**Broad Accountabilities**  
**Strategy**  
• Targeted Improvements: Work with internal stakeholders to identify gaps and improvement opportunities in credit processes, and lead assigned change and remediation activities to make processes more effective and streamlined.
  
• Support the GPO’s credit transformation agenda by translating agreed priorities into implementation activities and delivering assigned work within agreed timelines.
  
• Automation and Streamlining: Review operational efficiency, effectiveness and quality against changing business and customer needs, and identify actions to improve process performance.
  
• Drive continuous improvement and automation, and remove or simplify unnecessary process steps to improve efficiency and consistency across systems and processes.
  
• Support CPA Team Heads, including the CPA Hub, in improving process efficiency, simplifying processes and increasing capacity.
  
**Business**  
• Assess the process and operational-risk implications of business strategies, projects and programmes, and provide remediation guidance to support informed decisions.
  
• Support global adoption of Credit COE initiatives and work with management to implement agreed process improvements and strategic credit transformation initiatives.
  
• Maintain effective relationships with Business, Finance, Risk, Technology and Operations to resolve process issues and coordinate delivery across markets.
  
• Coordinate stakeholder inputs and supporting information for regulatory and audit requests to enable timely responses.

**Processes**  
• Support the Process Owner in delivering BAU operational-risk requirements on time and in designing and maintaining the Control Assessment Standards framework for front-office processes globally.
  
• Monitor CST/KCI exception trends and agree practical improvement actions with countries to strengthen processes and controls.
  
• Guide QC teams in GBS and countries in understanding and consistently applying checks, particularly those involving qualitative or subjective assessments.
  
• Support process governance by streamlining existing processes, rolling out new processes and resolving Credit and Credit Monitoring queries with the relevant GPOS Lead.
  
• Work with CPAs, Client Management, CPOs, R&C, Business Heads and other regional and country stakeholders to share developments, lessons and best practices, and deliver agreed requirements on time.
  
• Assess change impacts through CCIA, evaluate change readiness and perform GRAM assessments. Provide subject-matter expertise to help mitigate identified process risks.
  
• Support the resolution of Group-specific process issues and related actions identified by GIA.
  
• Support the Process Owner in promptly escalating significant risks and issues to Process Universe Owners, relevant RFOs or Policy Owners. Maintain effective relationships with 2LOD across applicable risk types to support management of the Bank’s risk profile.
  
**Risk Management**  
• Identify process risks and support implementation of the Operational Risk Framework and appropriate controls. Help operations manage risk within established tolerance thresholds and minimise risks and losses in Credit Origination.

* Identify non-standard processes and agree appropriate controls with the GPOS Lead. Review proposed process and system changes for material impacts, and keep DOIs and process documentation up to date.

• Support implementation of applicable Credit, Fraud, Climate, Reputational and Sustainability Risk policies and standards within CC COE, embedding their requirements in managed processes.
  
• Prepare updates on risk initiatives for CC Governance Committee packs, and provide subject-matter expertise for Root Cause Reviews and boundary events to support oversight and corrective action.
  
• Support the design and delivery of relevant Credit Transformation initiatives and partner with TB, FM and Lending to improve the operating model and execution through existing CC credit processes.
  
• Provide ongoing learning and guidance on policies, process risks, controls and governance. Work with 2LOD and Product partners to develop and implement a roadmap for improving the control framework.
  
• Support implementation and closure of Group-level audit Management Action Plans, and delivery of actions arising from PRA Dear CEO Letters and specific reviews relating to owned processes.
  
**Governance**  
• Ensure risks are clearly identified, quantified and reported to the appropriate governance forums, with timely visibility and escalation of material issues.
  
• Assess how effectively the control framework addresses key risks and initiate treatment plans where required. Coordinate remediation of capability, process, data and documentation gaps.
  
• Provide central oversight of CST/KCI assurance checks performed by GBS, including ongoing training and guidance, to maintain standardised and consistent assessments.

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**About Us :-**

*In a short span of 2.5 years since inception, Birla Pivot has evolved into a comprehensive B2B e-commerce platform offering integrated procurement and financial solutions that help businesses become efficient and grow. We offer products across 35 categories, 40,000+SKUs from 300+ brands across* ***Building Material, Chemicals & Metals****. We launched private labels in 3 categories : Tiles, Ply and Bath ware. With a robust network of suppliers and transporters, we have delivered to 4,000+ pin codes across 375 cities. Our customer base now spans top-tier EPC companies, civil contractors, real estate developers, OEMs, fabricators, manufacturing companies, dealers, and retailers. We connect Sellers, Buyers, Logistics service providers, Lending partners, Payment solution providers on a unified digital backbone thereby creating end to end visibility and providing a B2C like fulfilment experience for the B2B ecosystem.*

*The evolution of B2B ecommerce is expected to mirror the B2C ecommerce journey, where technology transformed discovery, pricing, fulfilment, and customer experience at scale. Digital penetration today in B2B ecommerce is still under* ***2%****, indicating massive headroom for scalable digital-first platforms. As the Aditya Birla Group, we are uniquely positioned to transform and shape the way commerce is done across these verticals by leveraging our deep industry expertise and scale. We have built a unique Quote based, Credit linked commerce journey that solves for the needs of B2B commerce with a diverse team that is a mix of deep industry expertise and experience of building complex technology platforms from the ground up. Our goal is to drive this digital adoption and create a distribution platform that can become* ***the most trusted B2B ecommerce platform in the country.***
  
  
***Why is this role exciting?***
  
  
***As our Security Engineer, you are the single hands-on owner of security operations and governance for Birla Pivot's cloud native B2B commerce platform —keeping every security KRI Green and closing audits with no major findings. In this role you get to:***
  
***?Own both sides of security —vulnerability, cloud posture, detection and access controls, and the policies, evidence and cadence that audits and the DPDP Act require.***
  
***?Shape how a high-growth business adopts AI securely, from the AI usage policy to reviews of every AI use case.***
  
***?Work closely with the Head of Cybersecurity, InfoSec & Cloud, the ABG central security team, legal and our vendors.***
  
  
***What will you do?***
  
  
***Security Operations & Incident Response***
  
  
***?Triage SIEM and EDR alerts daily; act as first responder for security incidents.***
  
***?Run incident response playbooks; prepare CERT-In reports within 6 hours of a reportable incident.***
  
***?Run tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews.***
  
  
***Vulnerability & Exposure Management***
  
***?Run vulnerability scanning across cloud, containers, code and endpoints; track remediation against SLA (Critical 7 days, High 30 days).***
  
***?Coordinate VAPT and red team engagements and drive findings to closure.***
  
***?Maintain WAF rules and virtual patching for internet-facing apps.***
  
  
***Endpoint, Patching & Resilience***
  
  
***?Keep EDR healthy on all endpoints and servers; validate patch compliance monthly.***
  
***?Verify backup restore tests and support DR drills.***
  
  
***Cloud Security (AWS)***
  
  
***?Monitor posture with Prisma Cloud, Security Hub and Prowler; fix critical misconfigurations within 72 hours.***
  
***?Review IAM, security groups, network ACLs and firewall rules weekly.***
  
***?Enforce encryption, logging, key rotation, MFA and least privilege.***
  
  
***Identity & Privileged Access***
  
  
***?Integrate IAM with the HR system for joiner-mover-leaver; disable leaver accounts within 24 hours.***
  
***?Run the monthly manager certification of off-role and contractor IDs, and quarterly access reviews.***
  
***?Onboard servers, databases and admin accounts to PAM; deploy LAPS and domain-only login.***
  
  
***ISO 27001, Policies & Audits***

***?Maintain the ISMS document set: policies, procedures, risk register, Statement of Applicability.***
  
***?Draft policy amendments for approval; keep the policy register current.***
  
***?Collect audit evidence for internal, external and ISO audits; track findings to closure.***
  
  
***Data Privacy & Vendor Risk***

***?Maintain the personal-data inventory and DPDP records with legal; implement technical controls (encryption, logging, erasure).***
  
***?Run vendor risk assessments and keep all vendor contracts in the central repository***
  
  
***Cadence, Reporting & Awareness***

***?Run the Friday SPOC and vendor ticket review; issue and close monthly, quarterly and half-yearly checklists.***
  
***?Prepare the monthly KRI pack and feed the central security dashboard (SIEM, VAPT, patching, DPDP, change, PAM).***
  
***?Publish the weekly infosec mailer; run trainings and phishing simulations.***
  
  
***AI Security & Governance***

***?Maintain the AI usage policy and the approved AI tools list —enterprise or ABG central accounts only, and no new AI initiative live without review.***
  
***?Run a security and privacy review for every AI use case: data shared, model and vendor, prompt injection, output handling, access rights.***
  
***?Detect and block unapproved AI tools through Zscaler logs; apply DLP so confidential and personal data stays out of public AI tools.***
  
***?Secure AI integrations against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications: least-privilege API keys, guardrails, logging, human approval for high-impact actions.***
  
***?Keep an AI use-case register for audit.***
  
  
***What success looks like in your first 6 months***

***?EDR coverage 98%; leaver accounts disabled within 24 hours, 100% of the time.***
  
***?No Critical vulnerability past its 7-day SLA. ?Critical log sources in SIEM with 180-day retention ( 95%).***
  
***? 95% of privileged accounts in PAM. ?Internal audit for ISO 27001 closed with no major technical findings.***
  
***?All monthly and quarterly checklists closed on time; weekly mailer running every week.***
  
***?AI usage policy published; every AI use case in the register with a completed risk review; no unapproved AI tools in use.***

***A Day In Life of a Security Engineer at Birla Pivot***

***Your day moves fast —from triaging the morning's SIEM and EDR alerts and chasing a Critical finding to closure, to fixing a cloud misconfiguration, reviewing a new AI use case with the product team, and pulling audit evidence together. At Birla Pivot, you operate at the pace of a high-growth business where every control counts.***

**What makes you a great fit?**

?Hands-on AWS security: IAM, VPC, security groups, CloudTrail, GuardDuty or Security Hub, KMS.
  
?Working knowledge of SIEM, EDR, WAF and vulnerability scanners (e.g. Qualys, Prisma Cloud, Snyk).
  
?Understanding of ISO 27001 controls and audit evidence.
  
?Scripting in Python or Bash for automation.
  
?Experience preparing audit evidence, writing policies and running review cadences.
  
?Clear written communication for incident reports and audit responses

**Good to have**

?Certifications: AWS Certified Security –Specialty, CompTIA Security+, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor.
  
?Exposure to PAM (BeyondTrust, Arcon), Zscaler, Kubernetes security, DevSecOps pipelines (SAST, SCA, DAST).
  
?Knowledge of the DPDP Act 2023 and CERT-In directions.
  
?AI security: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, securing LLM APIs and AI agents.

**Department:** Customer Service & Operations  
**Designation:** Customer Service Executive

**Employment Type:** Full-time, Office-based  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Reporting To:** Customer Service Manager / Head of Operations  
**Salary:** As per experience and suitability (Fixed + Performance Incentive)

1. About Loan2grow Fincap

Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited is a growing lending and financial services company focused on providing responsible, accessible and technology-enabled credit solutions to underserved customer segments.

The company offers financing solutions across multiple customer categories and is expanding its digital lending and financial services operations.

At Loan2grow, we believe that a good customer experience is central to responsible lending. We aim to make financial services accessible, transparent and convenient through technology-enabled platforms and responsive customer support.

2. About the Role

We are looking for customer-oriented and proactive professionals to join our Customer Service & Operations team as Customer Service Executives.

The selected candidates will be responsible for handling customer queries, providing assistance throughout the loan application and servicing journey, resolving customer complaints and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.

The role will involve handling inbound and outbound customer calls, responding to service requests, guiding customers through digital processes and maintaining accurate records of customer interactions.

The Customer Service Executive will serve as an important point of contact between the company and its customers, ensuring that customer concerns are addressed professionally, efficiently and within defined timelines.

This is a full-time, office-based role involving regular telephone-based customer interaction and coordination with internal departments.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Customer Support & Query Management

* Handle inbound and outbound customer calls relating to loan products and financial services.
* Respond to customer queries regarding loan features, eligibility, application procedures and documentation requirements.
* Provide information on loan application status, approval, disbursement and repayment schedules.
* Assist customers in understanding their loan accounts, outstanding balances, EMI obligations and payment timelines.
* Provide accurate information regarding applicable interest rates, processing fees, charges and other loan-related terms.
* Ensure that customer queries are addressed in a professional, courteous and timely manner.
* Escalate complex queries to the appropriate internal teams.

B. Loan Application & Customer Onboarding Support

* Assist prospective customers with the digital loan application process.
* Guide customers through KYC verification, documentation and other onboarding requirements.
* Help customers resolve issues related to application submission, document uploads and verification.
* Follow up on incomplete applications and pending documentation.
* Coordinate with Credit and Operations teams to track application progress.
* Keep customers informed about application status and pending requirements.
* Assist customers in navigating the company's digital platforms and applications.

C. Loan Servicing & Repayment Support

* Handle customer queries relating to loan disbursement, repayment schedules and EMI deductions.
* Assist customers with repayment-related issues, including failed transactions, incorrect deductions and payment confirmation.
* Guide customers on approved repayment channels and payment procedures.
* Coordinate with Finance and Collections teams to resolve payment reconciliation issues.
* Support customers in obtaining loan statements, repayment schedules and other account-related information.
* Track and follow up on unresolved loan servicing requests.
* Ensure that customer concerns relating to loan servicing are addressed within defined timelines.

D. Customer Complaint & Grievance Resolution

* Receive, register and track customer complaints and service requests.
* Understand the nature of customer grievances and identify the appropriate resolution mechanism.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve complaints.
* Follow up on pending complaints until closure.
* Maintain accurate records of complaints, actions taken and resolution timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or sensitive customer grievances to the reporting manager.
* Ensure that customer complaints are handled in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Customer Relationship & Communication

* Maintain professional and positive relationships with customers.
* Communicate loan-related information in simple, clear and understandable language.
* Proactively contact customers regarding pending documentation, application updates and service requests.
* Provide appropriate guidance to customers throughout their loan journey.
* Handle dissatisfied customers and difficult conversations with patience and professionalism.
* Ensure transparency in all customer communications.
* Never make unauthorised commitments regarding loan approvals, interest waivers, settlements or changes in repayment terms.

F. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with Sales and Business Development teams for customer acquisition and onboarding-related queries.
* Work with Credit teams to obtain updates on loan applications and pending verifications.
* Coordinate with Operations for documentation, disbursement and loan servicing issues.
* Work with Collections teams on repayment-related customer queries and payment confirmation.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment reconciliation and account-related discrepancies.
* Ensure timely communication and closure of customer requests across departments.

G. Customer Service MIS & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of customer calls, queries, complaints and service requests.
* Update customer interactions and service request status in the CRM or designated systems.
* Maintain daily customer service reports covering:

* Customer queries received.
* Customer requests registered.
* Complaints received and resolved.
* Pending service requests.
* Average query resolution time.
* Escalated complaints.
* Customer follow-up status.
* Share daily and weekly performance updates with the reporting manager.
* Identify recurring customer issues and highlight opportunities to improve service delivery.

4. Qualifications & Experience

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in customer service, customer support, telecalling, contact centres or customer relationship management.
* Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and basic English.
* Comfortable handling inbound and outbound customer calls.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and customer management systems.
* Ability to handle multiple customer queries and service requests simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience in banking, NBFCs, fintech, digital lending, microfinance or other financial services organisations.
* Experience handling loan-related customer queries and servicing requests.
* Familiarity with loan application processes, KYC documentation and digital onboarding.
* Experience resolving EMI, repayment and payment-related queries.
* Experience working with CRM, LOS or LMS platforms.
* Exposure to complaint management and customer grievance resolution.

5. Key Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication and listening skills.
* Customer relationship management.
* Problem-solving and query resolution.
* Professional telephone etiquette.
* Patience and empathy in customer interactions.
* Ability to handle difficult customer conversations.

DigieSign is a Bengaluru-based legal-tech and fintech company building a connected suite of products that help lenders digitise the full lifecycle of a loan — from signing the agreement to recovering dues and resolving disputes. **Key Performance Indicators**

* Revenue and pipeline value against target

* SLA adherence for notice dispatch, eSign and ODR delivery

* Client retention, expansion revenue and cross-sell across products

**Requirements Must have**

* 3–6 years of experience in B2B / enterprise sales, account management or operations in BFSI, fintech, legal-tech or SaaS.

* A proven record of selling to NBFCs and/or banks, with an existing network among collections, legal, credit or operations leaders.

* Understanding of the lending lifecycle in India — loan origination, documentation, collections, NPA recovery and legal/recovery processes (SARFAESI, Section 138 NI Act, arbitration).

* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills in English; Kannada and/or Hindi strongly preferred.

* Comfortable with CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets and preparing MIS reports.

* Willing to travel within Bengaluru and Karnataka for client meetings. Good to have

* Experience selling eSign, eStamp, legal notice, collections or ODR solutions.

* Exposure to RBI digital lending guidelines and outsourcing norms for regulated entities.

* Experience setting up or scaling a city or regional business from an early stage.

* Experience hiring and leading a small team.

**What We Offer**

* A chance to build and own a city business at an early-stage, fast-growing legal-tech company.

* Direct work with the founding team and real influence on product and go-to-market.

* Competitive fixed pay plus a performance-linked incentive plan.

* A clear growth path to Regional / Zonal Head as we expand to more cities.

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹110,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Appwork IT Solutions is a technology-driven company focused on building innovative software solutions that help businesses streamline operations, improve customer engagement, and accelerate digital transformation.

This role requires someone who understands enterprise B2B sales cycles and can confidently engage with senior-level decision-makers, including Founders, CEOs, CXOs, Business Heads, Operations Heads, and Technology Leaders across BFSI and NBFC organizations.

* Experience with cold outreach, lead qualification, appointment setting, and enterprise pipeline development.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms, sales automation tools, and lead research tools.
* Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

### **What Makes This Opportunity Different?**

* Own strategic prospecting initiatives targeting a focused list of enterprise accounts.

Candidates with experience in enterprise SaaS, fintech, NBFC technology, lending technology, KYC solutions, collections technology, conversational AI, or customer experience platforms will be preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Hire - Marketing & Growth
jobs.description:
**Location:**
Dubai

**Experience:**
7-12 years

**Industry:**
FinTech (Mandatory)

**About Sav:**

Sav is a Series A-stage company, founded by experienced operators with backgrounds across global banking, payments, and financial infrastructure. The company is backed by institutional investors and strategic partners, supporting its build-out at the intersection of open finance, AI, and regulated financial products.

Operating across the GCC with a growing global footprint, SAV is building an autonomous finance platform that unifies how consumers spend, save, invest, and manage credit. The company has been recognized among the UAE Future 100, Deloitte Fast 50, and as a Top 10 AI startup in MENA by Google for Startups.

**The job**

You will be responsible for growing Sav’s customer base 10x. Not part of it, all of it. You’ll own the target, the plan, the budget and the result. You will report to the founder.

We don’t want the usual playbook of more ad spend and more agencies. We want someone who finds new ways to grow:

* partnerships and embedded distribution
* referral and word-of-mouth loops
* community
* employers and other groups that bring many customers at once
* on-ground activations
* product-led growth
* channels nobody in UAE fintech is using yet

Paid media is one tool among many.

**How marketing works at Sav**

Our marketing is fully AI-native. We run AI agents for media planning, creative production, content distribution, analytics, performance media and more. You’ll run this system, decide where to point it, and build new agents where the work needs them. You'll spend your time finding growth, not producing assets by hand.

**What you will do**

* Own customer growth across all four products: new customers, activation, cross-sell and retention.
* Find and test new growth channels quickly. Keep the ones that work, drop the ones that don’t, and scale the winners.
* Build partnerships and distribution deals that bring customers in large numbers.
* Design referral, community and product-led loops with the Product team.
* Direct the AI marketing system and decide what it should do next.
* Launch new products and campaigns with Product and Compliance. Explain regulated products in plain English and Arabic.
* Hire and lead a small team that works the same way.

**What success looks like**

* **In your first 90 days:**
  a growth plan to 10x, with the three bets you’d make first, and at least one of them live with early results.
* **Within 12 months:**
  a clear path to 10x customers, a lower cost per customer, and at least one growth channel that didn’t exist at Sav before you joined.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* 6+ years in growth or marketing, with at least 3 years on financial products such as payments, cards, investing, savings, or digital banking.
* A track record of growing a customer base several times over, with the numbers to show it.
* At least one growth idea you came up with and scaled that wasn’t paid ads: a partnership, a referral loop, a community or a distribution deal.
* Real hands-on use of AI in your work: you’ve built or run workflows that do marketing work, not just used a chatbot for copy.
* Comfort with funnels, unit economics, and data. You read the numbers yourself.
* GCC experience and Arabic are strong pluses.

**How to apply**

Send your CV and a short note, under 200 words, covering:

1. The biggest customer growth you’ve been responsible for: from what number to what number, and how.
2. One unconventional growth idea you’d try for Sav, and why.
3. One example of how you’ve used AI to do marketing work. Tell us what you built, what it did, and what broke.

Applications without all three will not be reviewed.

jobs.title: AI and Data Lead
jobs.description:
**DT One | Dubai | Full-time**
**About Us**
DT One operates a leading global network for mobile top-up, digital value products and rewards. Through a single API connection, we link more than 2,800 partners, including mobile operators, money transfer operators, e-wallets, super apps and retail networks, across 190 countries. Our partners can offer over 23,000 products, from airtime and data top-ups to gift cards and bill payments. We have processed more than 1.2 billion transactions and reach a potential audience of over five billion people, helping to ensure that no one is left unconnected.
  
  
Founded in 2005 and part of the Thunes group, DT One is headquartered in Singapore with regional offices in Dubai, Miami, Nairobi, London and Barcelona.
  
  
For more information visit www.dtone.com
  
  
**Context of the role**
We're looking for a Data and AI Lead who is passionate about turning data into products and decisions, and wants to work in a disruptive, fast-growing and exciting environment. Every transaction on our network tells us something about what customers want, which products perform in which markets and how our partners can grow. This role will bring that intelligence together and put it to work across the business.
  
  
You will combine a startup mindset with the scale of an industry leader. Working closely with the leadership team, product, engineering and commercial teams, you will set the direction for how DT One uses data, analytics and AI, build the team to deliver it, and make sure it has a measurable impact on growth and profitability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We're looking for a highly driven, commercially minded leader who is truly excited about having a meaningful impact within the company. In this role, you will own data and AI end to end, from strategy and platforms through to the products, insights and automation that our teams and partners use every day.
  
  

* Define and drive the data and AI strategy and roadmap, making sure it is aligned with commercial, product and technology priorities
* Build, lead and grow a multi-disciplinary team across data engineering, data science and machine learning, analytics and data governance
* Own the data platform, bringing together transaction, product and partner data into a trusted, scalable foundation for real-time and batch analytics
* Deliver data and AI products that drive growth, such as product recommendations, pricing and demand insights, partner performance analytics, and fraud and anomaly detection
* Lead the adoption of AI, including generative AI, to automate operations and improve decision-making across the business
* Establish data governance, quality, privacy and compliance standards that work across multiple markets and regulatory environments
* Partner with the leadership team and business units to prioritise use cases, measure value delivered and manage the data and AI budget
* Act as a senior voice for data and AI with partners and the wider Thunes group

**What we are looking for**

* 15+ years' experience in data, analytics and machine learning, including several years leading data and AI functions
* Advanced degree (MSc or PhD) in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics or a related field, or equivalent experience
* A proven record of building and scaling multi-disciplinary data teams, including across multiple countries
* Experience delivering data platforms and data products at scale in digital, e-commerce, fintech or other high-volume consumer businesses
* Hands-on depth in applied machine learning in production, such as personalisation, recommendation, forecasting or customer analytics
* Experience setting up data governance and working with data privacy requirements across multiple jurisdictions
* The ability to translate business goals into a clear data roadmap, and to communicate with and influence senior stakeholders
* Experience with fintech, payments or mobile data, or with deploying generative AI in production, is a plus
* Interest in the Fintech industry and market innovations

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
**Chief Technology Officer (CTO)**

**The Role**

The CTO is a senior executive responsible for defining and governing the company’s overall technology strategy, ensuring alignment with business growth, regulatory requirements, and investor expectations. This role operates at the enterprise level, owning strategic direction, technology risk mitigation, organisational performance and delivery outcomes through accountable senior leaders.

The CTO is a core member of the executive leadership team, reporting to the CEO and working closely with the executive team, with regular engagement with the Board, regulators and investors. Success in this role is defined by long-term platform scalability, resilience and commercial value creation.

This is a strategy-first executive role with accountability for delivery and production outcomes through senior leaders, requiring technical judgement and leadership at Board and regulator level. Day-to-day coding and engineering execution sit with the engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technology Strategy & Executive Leadership**

* Define and maintain a multi-year technology strategy aligned with company growth, product expansion, and geographic scale.
* Own the technology roadmap at executive level, ensuring clear prioritisation aligned to commercial outcomes.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the CEO, Board, and investors.
* Translate complex technology topics into clear business decisions for non-technical stakeholders.
* Lead company-wide AI governance and adoption, shape AI and data strategy with business leaders and specialists, and own the supporting technology delivery.

**Architecture Governance & Technical Accountability**

* Maintain governance frameworks for platform architecture, ensuring scalability, resilience, and future readiness.
* Challenge and approve major architectural decisions and investment trade-offs, holding architecture and engineering leaders accountable for sound design and implementation.
* Ensure technology standards are defined and adhered to across all engineering and platform teams.

**Regulatory, Risk & Compliance Ownership**

* Own technology risk identification, mitigation and reporting, working with the CRO, who owns the enterprise risk register.
* Act as the primary interface with regulators (e.g., central bank authorities) on all technology-related matters.
* Ensure full compliance with regulatory technology requirements, including timelines, audits, and controls.
* Be accountable for cybersecurity posture, operational resilience and technical data custody, supporting enterprise data governance with the accountable business owners.

**Commercial & Financial Accountability**

* Own technology financial planning, including budgeting, cost optimisation, and investment prioritisation.
* Establish and maintain platform cost models (e.g., cost per transaction, cost per user) and ensure alignment with unit economics.
* Partner with the CFO to ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
* Lead technology input into investor discussions, due diligence processes, and funding activities.

**Technology Organisation and Sourcing Leadership**

* Build on and strengthen the established technology organisation, delivering through a lean internal team and external engineering partners, with further organisational changes driven by demonstrated business needs.
* Lead engineering, architecture, delivery, technology operations, DevOps/SRE and cybersecurity through accountable senior leaders.
* Set performance expectations and accountability frameworks across senior technology leaders.
* Build a culture of ownership, governance, and execution discipline at leadership level.
* Own build-versus-buy decisions, engineering-partner performance and controlled supplier transitions.

**Governance & Operational Oversight**

* Maintain and strengthen enterprise governance frameworks covering change control, incident management, and operational risk.
* The CTO is accountable for technology delivery, production performance and transformation outcomes through senior leaders, without personally coding, managing sprints or owning team backlogs.
* Ensure organisational readiness for scale, audits, and external scrutiny.

**Investor & Board Engagement**

* Present technology strategy, risks, and investment cases directly to Board members and investors.
* Ensure the technology function is fully prepared for external due diligence.
* Provide transparency on risks, trade-offs, and investment requirements.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* Established CTO, or CIO with equivalent scope, with substantive executive accountability in regulated fintech or financial services, and a proven record of independently leading the full technology function, including software engineering, through growth and transformation.
* Proven experience leading regulated wallet or payments platforms, with sound judgement across transaction integrity, reconciliation, settlement and partner integrations.
* Proven experience protecting live payments while building and safely migrating to new platforms, delivering through internal teams and external partners, with measurable improvements in reliability, delivery speed and cost.
* Demonstrated track record of scaling technology platforms through significant growth phases.
* Experience operating at Board and investor level, including direct engagement on strategy and risk.
* Strong understanding of regulatory environments and technology compliance obligations.
* Experience leading the full technology function through senior leadership teams, with accountability for delivery, operations, architecture and security.

**Skills and Characteristics**

* Executive-level thinker with the ability to connect technology decisions to commercial outcomes.
* Strong governance and risk management mindset.
* Ability to operate effectively with ambiguity at enterprise scale.
* Clear and confident communicator at Board and investor level.
* High level of accountability and ownership for outcomes.
* Technically credible across platform architecture, payments and engineering, able to challenge designs, make sound decisions, and hold engineering to account, without being hands-on.

**What This Role Is**

* A C-suite CTO role with executive ownership of strategy, governance, business alignment and technology outcomes.
* An executive leadership position, driving outcomes through accountable senior leaders and intervening where material decisions, risks or performance require it.
* A role with executive accountability for technology risk, technology-related regulatory compliance and transparent Board and investor reporting.

**What This Role Is Not**

* This is not a hands-on engineering or architecture role.
* This role does not involve direct coding, sprint management, or backlog ownership.
* This is not an engineering manager or individual contributor position.

**Key Stakeholders**

* CEO
* CFO
* CPO
* COO
* CRO
* Board of Directors
* Investors
* Regulatory Authorities

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager - HAL
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
**About SC Ventures**
**SC Ventures is Standard Chartered ’s innovation, fintech investment and ventures arm. We were established to reinvent banking, as the significant technological disruptions to the industry was impacting its ability to serve clients and customers, in the ways they needed to be served. We are a unique ecosystem of innovators, banking experts, business builders and partners who are focused on rewiring the DNA in banking and bringing breakthrough ideas to scale, together. We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy & Lifestyle, SMEs & World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability & Inclusion. We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates**
**About HAL**
**HAL is a B2B domestic and cross border marketplace being built for SMEs in the UAE. Incubated by SC Ventures, the ventures arm of Standard Chartered Bank, the platform will enable digital commerce and access to financial & value-added services. HAL’s vision is to act as a super glue connecting multiple partners & ecosystems by bringing together buyers, sellers, financial institutions, logistics partners under one roof. We are building this as an agentic AI native stack along with several strategic partners in the UAE who bring different capabilities into the platform.**
**SMEs are the backbone of the UAE economy and vital for economic growth and diversification. We want to help SMEs grow profitably, safely and with ease. Hal is being built for scale with the latest technologies and with a vision to truly become the one stop shop for SMEs. We are looking to launch later in the year.**
**The Senior Marketing Manager will lead HAL's marketing function, working closely with the CEO and the commercial, product and partnerships teams. This is a commercially driven role: success is measured by the qualified B2B leads you generate (sellers, buyers and SMEs looking for finance), the revenue they bring in, and HAL's growing share of the UAE SME market. You will be hands-on and highly experimental, testing new channels and ideas quickly, doubling down on what works, and doing whatever it takes to help HAL win in the market.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Develop and own HAL's go-to-market marketing plan, turning business targets for sellers, buyers and finance referrals into lead generation goals, channel priorities and budget.
* Run a structured test-and-learn approach: set clear hypotheses, launch quick experiments across channels, measure results, and scale what works.
* Build simple, reliable full-funnel reporting covering leads, cost per lead, conversion to onboarded users and revenue, and share insights and recommendations with leadership regularly.
* Plan a rolling quarterly marketing calendar aligned to HAL's launch milestones and key UAE moments (e.g. Ramadan, National Day, major trade exhibitions).
* Lead, coach and develop the marketing team, working as one team with sales, product and partnerships to hit shared growth targets.

**Business**

* Own B2B lead generation for HAL: build a predictable pipeline of qualified sellers, buyers and SMEs needing finance (e.g. trade finance, working capital, invoice discounting), and ensure smooth handover to the commercial team.
* Agree with the sales team on the ideal customer profile, lead qualification criteria, and a shared process for lead handover and follow-up.
* Drive seller and buyer acquisition for the marketplace launch, and support activation campaigns so that new users start trading on the platform.
* Partner with banks, logistics, payments and other strategic partners on co-marketing campaigns and joint lead generation.
* Manage the marketing budget with discipline, tracking cost per lead and return on spend and moving budget to the best-performing channels.

**Processes**
**Lead Generation & Performance Marketing**

* Plan, launch and optimise paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, Meta and regional platforms, owning cost per lead, conversion rates and return on ad spend.
* Continuously experiment with new acquisition channels, such as WhatsApp campaigns, outbound email sequences, account-based marketing for high-value accounts, partner referrals and B2B directories.
* Build landing pages, lead forms and email and WhatsApp nurture journeys that turn interest into qualified leads.
* Set up and manage the core marketing tools (e.g. CRM and marketing automation such as HubSpot) and tracking so every lead can be traced back to its source.
* Grow HAL's organic visibility through SEO and content, including in AI-assisted search.

**Events & Field Marketing**

* Plan and deliver HAL's events programme: launch events, SME workshops, roundtables, webinars and networking sessions.
* Represent HAL at relevant trade shows and industry events across the UAE, making sure every event produces qualified leads with clear follow-up.
* Build relationships with chambers of commerce, trade associations, free zones and SME programmes to reach SMEs at scale.

**Thought Leadership, Content & PR**

* Build a thought leadership programme that positions HAL and its leaders as trusted voices on SME growth, B2B trade and trade finance in the UAE.
* Manage leadership's LinkedIn presence and secure speaking slots, panels and media interviews.
* Create content that educates and converts, such as articles, guides, case studies, newsletters, short videos and webinars, in English and Arabic where needed.
* Manage PR and media relations for launches and milestones, working with agencies where needed.

**Brand & Sales Enablement**
  
  

+ Establish HAL's brand positioning, key messages and visual identity, and keep them consistent across all touchpoints.
+ Create sales materials, such as pitch decks, one-pagers and case studies, that help the commercial team convert leads.
+ Gather customer and market insights (feedback, competitor moves, win/loss reasons) to sharpen messaging and targeting.

**Risk Management**

* Continuously evaluate agency roster to ensure that right agencies are onboarded while accommodating within the budget requirements

**Governance**

* Ensure compliance with all SCB and venture governance frameworks.
* Manage the function within budgetary constraints, seeking operational efficiencies

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Internal: CEO, CCO, COO, Head of digital commerce, Head of Financial Services, Head of partnerships.
* External: Relevant external regulator

**Other Responsibilities**

* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the business and SC Ventures;
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.

**Skills And Experience**

* Marketing
* Branding
* Marketing Channels
* Planning : Tactical & Strategic
* Marketing Strategy & Positioning
* Brand Management

**Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of marketing experience, including at least 3 years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing.
* Highly commercially driven, with a proven track record of generating B2B leads and pipeline and a clear link to revenue (e.g. lead volume, cost per lead, conversion, revenue impact).
* Strong startup or scale-up background, with experience building marketing from the ground up in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
* Experimental minds
