**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About this role**

As a part of our team, you'll help us shape a platform that works for One — a business owner, an artist, a freelancer. In this role, you will build and manage a growth system based on data, AI, and user intent, transforming marketing from a communication function into a real-time decision layer. We provide the space for you to exercise true strategic autonomy, stripping away micromanagement so you can integrate marketing directly into the product, drive user acquisition and retention through intent detection, and evolve UMO into a trusted financial assistant end-to-end.

**You'll take ownership of:**

* **Growth & Decision Layer (The Core):**
  Build an intent detection and decisioning system based on user data. Integrate marketing directly into the product (product-led growth) to drive "one intent -> one action" logic, shaping the user's experience by correctly reacting to their state in the moment.
* **Data & MarTech Architecture:**
  Build our first-party data strategy, developing the CDP, data layer, event tracking, and data clean rooms while maintaining data quality, structure, and accessibility for automated decisioning.
* **Customer Lifecycle & Personalization:**
  Design the end-to-end customer journey, transitioning from traditional segments to individual scenarios powered by behavior, context, financial status, and life event triggers.
* **Go-to-Market & Growth Execution:**
  Develop GTM strategies for new products and markets while managing performance, partnership, and product-led acquisition channels focused on LTV, engagement, and value delivered.
* **Brand & Trust:**
  Shape UMO's positioning as an AI-native financial assistant and trusted decision layer, ensuring absolute communication consistency across all customer touchpoints.
* **Compliance & Data Governance:**
  Ensure strict compliance with GDPR, privacy rules, advertising standards, and consent management frameworks in close coordination with CISO, Risk, and Legal teams.
* **Analytics & Intelligence:**
  Build a real-time metrics system measuring intent detection accuracy, context conversions, LTV, retention, and value delivered.
* **Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment:**
  Lead Growth, Data, Marketing, and CRM/Lifecycle teams while partnering closely with Product, Tech, AI, Risk, and Compliance.

**About you:**

* **Executive Growth Leadership:**
  You have extensive commercial experience in a senior marketing or growth leadership capacity (at least 7+ years) within high-growth fintech, tech, or data-driven digital environments.
* **Data & AI-Native Architecture:**
  You feel at home building first-party data strategies, CDPs, and event-tracking frameworks, leveraging AI tooling and predictive models to turn raw data into actionable decision engines.
* **Product-Led Growth (PLG) Depth:**
  You have proven experience driving acquisition, engagement, and retention directly through product workflows rather than relying solely on external ad campaigns.
* **Regulated Environment & Compliance:**
  You understand data protection principles, GDPR, advertising regulations, and consent governance, ensuring data is used transparently and in the user's best interest.
* **Autonomous Milestone Execution:**
  You manage complex growth goals comfortably, taking complete end-to-end problem ownership over market entry, LTV metrics, and product-led journeys.
* **Transparent & Supportive Leadership:**
  You communicate openly, foster cross-functional collaboration with product and tech teams, and prioritize an absolute zero-tolerance policy for rudeness or politics.
* **Linguistic Fluency:**
  You speak and write English fluently to comfortably lead global teams and align cross-functional executive tracks.

**Can get you a few bonus points:**

* **Fintech & Digital Asset Background:**
  Prior experience building growth systems or personalized financial products within fintech, neobanks, or regulated web3 platforms.
* **MarTech & AI Tooling Expertise:**
  Direct experience configuring advanced CDP platforms, custom LLM prompt setups, or AI-driven marketing automation engines.
* **Startup Agility:**
  Experience operating within zero-to-one or lean startup environments where market entry strategies evolve quickly.

**The UMO Standard**

* Mandate & Ownership: Full ownership of the product organization and roadmap, reporting directly to the founders.
* Equity: A meaningful equity stake in a venture built from zero to one.
* Location & Flexibility: Base yourself in Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, or Lviv, with openness to remote for the right fit.
* Impact & Ownership: Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Cluster Sales Head - Current Account, Consumer Banking Group
jobs.description:
**Business Function**
As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits, investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans, to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business – they were made just for you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.
* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.
* Translate cluster targets into branch-, team- and individual-level productivity plans.
* Own the current-account business plan, sales funnel, conversion pipeline and weekly performance rhythm.
* Improve portfolio quality by prioritising transaction-active, balance-building and cross-sell-ready relationships over dormant or low-value acquisition.
* Lead, coach and motivate a field-sales organisation to consistently deliver acquisition and value-build targets.
* Establish a disciplined sales cadence covering joint calls, market visits, lead reviews, branch huddles, pipeline reviews and conversion tracking.
* Ensure each relationship manager follows a profile-based sales approach rather than a generic product pitch.
* Develop market intelligence on competitor propositions, local business clusters, referral sources and emerging commercial hubs.
* Build productive referral ecosystems with Chartered Accountants, trade associations, market intermediaries, merchant networks, developers, institutional administrators and existing clients.
* Ensure newly acquired accounts become transaction-active within defined activation timelines.
* Drive operating balances, inward credits, collections, payment activity and digital banking adoption.
* Track early-warning indicators including low funding, non-activation, declining balances, low transaction velocity and potential attrition.
* Build strategies to migrate primary transaction flows—collections, vendor payments, payroll, taxes and operating cash—to the bank.
* Improve account quality by monitoring average balance, debit transactions, credit transactions and account profitability.
* Use the current account as the primary operating hub for business clients and identify the appropriate product solution based on the customer’s business model.
* Drive adoption of corporate internet banking and mobile approvals; cash management and bulk payment solutions; POS, Android POS, QR and Soundbox; sweep-in / sweep-out or FFD structures; debit cards; collections and transaction banking solutions; and promoter, family, wealth and premium savings propositions.
* Partner with product teams to convert business pain points into integrated propositions—for example, POS for collections, Internet Banking for payment controls, FFD for temporary balances and Aspire/premium banking for promoter wallet deepening.
* Build senior-level relationships with anchor clients and participate in strategic joint calls for high-value prospects.
* Ensure timely resolution of onboarding, account-opening, transaction, service and digital-banking issues.
* Work with branches and operations teams to reduce turnaround time, improve onboarding quality and strengthen client experience.
* Review top customers and at-risk accounts regularly to protect balances, transactions and wallet share.
* Drive customer retention through proactive engagement, problem solving and relevant product deepening.
* Ensure all sourcing, onboarding and account activation follows internal policies and applicable KYC, AML, fraud-risk and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain high standards of customer due diligence, documentation quality, source-of-funds understanding and business-profile validation.
* Monitor exceptions, unusual transaction behaviour, documentation gaps and operational risks; escalate promptly where needed.
* Build a culture of right-first-time acquisition, with no compromise on compliance for target achievement.
* Recruit, develop, retain and performance-manage a high-quality current-account sales team.
* Set clear scorecards covering acquisition, activation, AQB/AMB, transaction activity, fee income, cross-sell, productivity, service quality and compliance.
* Conduct structured coaching through joint market visits, call observations, weekly reviews and capability-building sessions.
* Identify skill gaps and develop targeted interventions around sales planning, segment understanding, solution selling, digital banking and compliance.
* Maintain a strong talent pipeline and manage attrition proactively.

**Requirements**

* 8–15 years of relevant experience in banking, preferably in current accounts, CASA, business banking, SME banking, transaction banking, branch banking or merchant acquiring.
* At least 3–5 years in a people-leadership role managing sales managers, relationship managers or acquisition teams.
* Demonstrated track record of building a current-account portfolio, increasing operating balances and delivering cross-sell revenue.
* Experience in managing business clusters, market catchments, branch ecosystems or multi-location sales teams is preferred.
* Strong understanding of current-account economics, CASA, transaction banking, payments, merchant acquiring and business-client needs.
* Proven ability to lead field sales, build market networks and execute through branches and partner channels.
* Solution-selling mindset with ability to connect client pain points to banking products.
* Strong command of sales analytics, funnel management, portfolio reviews and performance dashboards.
* Excellent stakeholder-management skills across branches, products, operations, risk and service.
* High integrity, sound judgement and uncompromising compliance orientation.
* Strong communication, negotiation, coaching and executive-presence skills.
* Graduate degree required.
* MBA / PGDM in Finance, Sales, Marketing or Banking preferred.
* Relevant certifications in banking, KYC/AML, payments or financial products are an advantage.

**Apply Now**

* We offer a competitive salary and benefits package and the professional advantages of a dynamic environment that supports your development and recognises your achievements.

Devanahalli
  
  
**Job:**
Relationship Management
  
  
**Schedule:**
Regular

Full time

jobs.title: Head – Wealth Advisory & Business Growth
jobs.description:
**About The Opportunity**

* Fintoo is a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser and fee-based financial planning firm offering holistic financial planning, investment advisory, global investing, and tax advisory services. The company’s philosophy prioritizes planning before execution and places client interests first, combining professional advice with technology to help individuals make informed financial decisions.
* The company is expanding its advisory footprint and seeks a leader to build and scale its Wealth Advisory business in Bengaluru, translating its strong foundation (₹5,000+ Cr Assets Under Tracking, ₹1,000+ Cr Assets Under Advisory, 2,300+ Paid Customers) into a scalable, sustainable, and profitable business.

Role & Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the Bengaluru business plan, revenue targets, growth strategy, and profitability.
* Develop and execute a go-to-market strategy targeting affluent professionals, HNI clients, and other relevant segments through referrals, professional networks, chartered accountants, corporate relationships, and strategic alliances.
* Personally lead key client conversations, business negotiations, and high-value conversions; manage the full customer journey from prospecting to long-term advisory.
* Identify growth opportunities, improve conversion ratios, and strengthen revenue productivity; present forecasts and quarterly plans to senior management.
* Champion a planning-led, fiduciary, and client-first advisory approach; understand clients’ goals, income, liabilities, risk profiles, liquidity needs, and investment horizons to support comprehensive financial planning.
* Ensure recommendations are appropriate to clients’ circumstances, supported by suitable documentation and disclosures; drive holistic financial planning over transactional, product-led selling.
* Lead periodic portfolio reviews, goal tracking, and proactive client engagement in collaboration with research, investment, product, and technology teams.
* Grow AUA sustainably through appropriate client acquisition, retention, and deeper advisory engagement; convert paid financial planning customers into ongoing advisory relationships.
* Improve renewals, referrals, customer lifetime value, and relationship longevity through consistent service and demonstrable advisory value.
* Establish client segmentation, engagement frequency, review, and escalation frameworks; personally manage key relationships and strategic prospects.
* Lead an initial team of six professionals across advisory, relationship management, and business development; set clear KRAs, revenue goals, productivity benchmarks, and accountability mechanisms.
* Recruit, coach, and develop professionals with financial planning capabilities, client orientation, and commercial acumen; build a high-performance culture based on ownership, collaboration, integrity, and continuous learning.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, pipeline reviews, and capability-building initiatives; identify and develop future leaders; scale the team in line with approved budgets and performance.
* Translate annual objectives into actionable quarterly and monthly plans; track revenue, conversion ratios, paid customer acquisition, AUA growth, client retention, and individual productivity.
* Identify performance gaps early and implement corrective actions; balance growth investment, acquisition costs, team capacity, and profitability; build dashboards and repeatable processes for scale.
* Partner with product and technology teams to improve advisory workflows, customer experience, and advisor productivity; use digital tools, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to make financial advice scalable and accessible.
* Collaborate with marketing on targeted campaigns, financial education, and lead generation; work with operations, finance, and compliance teams for efficient execution and robust governance.
* Share market and customer insights to inform advisory products and business strategy.
* Uphold Fintoo’s fiduciary, fee-based, and client-first advisory philosophy; ensure compliance with SEBI requirements, internal policies, and ethical standards; maintain high standards of client suitability, documentation, disclosures, and transparency.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* 8–12 years of relevant experience in BFSI / Wealth Management, including at least 4 years in business development and team leadership.
* Proven track record of building a business, acquiring clients, and achieving revenue targets.
* Strong understanding of comprehensive financial planning, investment advisory, asset allocation, and relationship management.
* Experience working with affluent professionals and HNI clients, with the ability to build credibility and long-term relationships.
* Commercial judgment, analytical ability, and ownership of business performance.
* Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, motivate, and scale teams in a growth-oriented environment.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Both NISM Series X-A and Series X-B certifications are mandatory.

**Preferred**

* Experience in building and scaling advisory businesses in competitive markets.
* Deep understanding of digital tools and technology-enabled advisory workflows.
* Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with product, marketing, and operations teams.

Benefits & Culture Highlights
  
  

* Opportunity to build a trusted, high-performing, and profitable advisory business in Bengaluru.
* Focus on establishing a strong local presence, creating a consistent acquisition engine, growing AUA and long-term advisory relationships.
* Culture that values ownership, ethical advice, and measurable outcomes.
* Support to develop a capable team and build operating systems that support the next stage of expansion.

s

jobs.title: Head, PaPM Change and CoE
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* The PaPM CoE Delivery Head is responsible for leading the end-to-end PaPM Centre of Excellence (CoE), create a centralised capability to drive solution standardisation, architectural governance, delivery excellence, reusable assets, technical expertise across PaPM implementation. Partner with Technology and Finance stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into scalable solutions, improve delivery efficiency, build organisational capabilities and maximise value derived from PaPM Investments.

**The PaPM CoE Delivery Head In India Will**
**Strategy & Leadership**

* Ensuring successful execution of the strategic roadmap, delivery of business use cases, platform governance, and operational excellence. The role is accountable for building and managing a high-performing team of PaPM specialists, establishing delivery standards, ensuring architecture compliance, and maximizing value realization from the PaPM platform across Finance, Treasury, Risk, Sustainability, and Performance Management functions. The role acts as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and senior leadership
* Define and execute the SAP PaPM CoE vision, operating model, and strategic roadmap.
* Drive adoption of SAP PaPM as the strategic platform for allocations, profitability analysis, scenario modelling, regulatory calculations, and performance management.
* Align PaPM initiatives with Finance Transformation, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Analytics, and AI strategies.
* Establish long-term capability plans covering people, process, technology, and governance.
* Provide thought leadership on emerging SAP PaPM capabilities, AI enablement, and automation opportunities

**Delivery & Execution**

* Own the delivery portfolio and annual Book of Work (BoW) across all PaPM programs and initiatives.
* Ensure successful delivery of projects through design, build, testing, deployment, and stabilization.
* Establish predictable delivery governance, quality standards, and execution metrics.
* Drive prioritization of demand, capacity planning, and resource allocation.
* Ensure timely delivery within agreed scope, budget, quality, and risk parameters.
* Lead resolution of critical delivery issues and escalationsReview the lessons learned from previous releases / phases and to ensure that follow up / corrective actions are taken on time to ensure the smooth execution of upcoming test phases.

**Architecture & Solution Governance**

* Own PaPM design standards, architecture principles, and implementation patterns.
* Chair Solution Design Reviews and Architecture Governance forums.
* Ensure solutions adhere to enterprise architecture, security, compliance, and non-functional requirements.
* Approve onboarding of new use cases into PaPM based on complexity, ROI, data readiness, and strategic fit.
* Drive reusability and standardization across solution components.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the senior point of contact for CFO, Finance Transformation, Treasury, Risk, Technology, and Operations stakeholders.
* Build trusted relationships with senior business sponsors and journey owners.
* Present delivery status, risks, investment cases, and strategic recommendations to senior governance forums and steering committees.
* Manage vendor partnerships and oversee external delivery teams.

**CoE Management & Talent Development**

* Build and lead a multi-disciplinary team consisting of Solution Leads, Architects, Analysts, Modelers, and Platform Specialists.
* Define capability development strategy and certification pathways.
* Establish knowledge management, training programs, and communities of practice.
* Drive workforce planning and succession planning for niche PaPM skills.
* Foster innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement across global teams.

**Platform Operations & Sustainability**

* Own platform health, stability, scalability, and performance.
* Ensure robust support, maintenance, release management, and incident management processes.
* Drive continuous optimization and technical debt reduction initiatives.
* Establish operational KPIs and service management standards.
* Ensure business continuity and resilience of critical PaPM processes

**Risk, Governance & Controls**

* Embed strong delivery, technology, and operational risk management practices.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, security, and enterprise control requirements.
* Maintain transparent governance and reporting across all PaPM initiatives.
* Drive proactive identification and mitigation of delivery, platform, and resource risks

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Delivery of annual PaPM Book of Work.
* Time-to-market improvement for new use cases.
* Platform availability and stability.
* Stakeholder satisfaction scores.
* Budget adherence and cost efficiency.
* Adoption and utilization of PaPM capabilities.
* Audit and control compliance.
* Team capability and certification growth.
* Reuse of standard components and design patterns.

**Essential**
**Required Experience**

* 12+ years of experience in Finance Technology, Enterprise Applications, or Finance Transformation.
* 7+ years of SAP experience with significant exposure to SAP PaPM.
* Proven leadership experience managing global delivery teams and complex transformation programs.
* Strong understanding of:
* SAP PaPM
* SAP BW/BW4HANA
* SAP S/4HANA
* Finance and Controllership processes
* Profitability and Cost Management
* Transfer Pricing
* Allocations and Recharges
* Performance Management
* Experience managing senior business stakeholders and executive governance forums.
* Demonstrated success building and scaling Centres of Excellence.

**Preferred**

* Experience within Banking or Financial Services.
* Exposure to FP&A, Treasury, Risk, Regulatory Reporting, or Sustainability reporting.
* Experience leading vendor-delivered and hybrid delivery models.
* Knowledge of AI-enabled solution delivery and advanced analytics platforms.

**Skills And Competencies**

* SAP PaPM Architecture
* SAP PaPM Modelling
* Solution Design
* Enterprise Architecture
* SAP BW / HANA
* SAP S/4HANA Integration
* Program Delivery
* Agile Delivery
* Data Management & Governance
* Financial Modelling & Allocations

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

**Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis Manager – India Lead, CTF & BSRA**
At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.
  
  
Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.
  
  
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of
**Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis Manager**
to join our
**Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) & Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA)**
team within Finance. This role is located in
**Pune, India**
.
  
  
In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
  
  

* Functional leadership: Lead Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) and Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) from India, with full accountability for the quality, timeliness, control and continuous improvement of all deliverables.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:
  
  

* Education: Master’s degree in a financial discipline such as accounting, finance, economics or statistics, or local country equivalent, is required; MBA preferred. Professional qualifications such as CA, CFA, FRM or CPA are a strong advantage.

* Domain expertise: Strong knowledge of Asset and Liability Management (ALM), deposits, NII, FTP, liquidity (LCR/LST), interest rate risk and the bank balance sheet, with a sound understanding of financial controls and governance.
* Global operating model: Proven track record of building and scaling India-based Centers of Excellence that partner with US/EMEA senior leadership; ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex technical-financial topics into clear business narratives.
* Communication & tools: Excellent written, verbal and executive presentation skills; advanced MS Office; proficiency with enterprise planning, reporting and ERP tools (e.g., Planning Analytics/TM1, Cognos, HFM, Oracle) and Power BI – exposure to Python/SQL, automation and AI tools is a plus.
* People leadership: 7+ years leading multi-layered teams (VPs, AVPs, Specialists and Analysts), with demonstrated strength in organization design, workforce and succession planning, coaching and performance management, and in building an inclusive, high-performance culture.

The Delivery Area Lead (DAL) is accountable for end-to-end leadership of India offshore delivery for Managed Cloud Services. The role ensures delivery excellence, financial discipline, stakeholder confidence, organizational capability, service maturity and business continuity while representing India delivery in local and global leadership forums. The DAL converts global business priorities into an executable people, capacity, governance and transformation agenda.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Organization and People Leadership
* Own the organization structure, capacity model, spans of control, succession coverage and workforce plan in line with demand forecasts and growth priorities.
* Lead, coach and develop managers and technical leaders; establish clear objectives and support performance, promotion and talent-calibration processes.
* Drive experienced, lateral, campus and trainee hiring, including requisition validation, internal mobility, fitment decisions and permanent-versus-subcontractor choices.
* Build an inclusive, high-performance culture through town halls, pulse sessions, skip-level connects, recognition, wellbeing and retention interventions.
* Create certification, cross-skilling, leadership-development and AI-adoption roadmaps for critical Managed Cloud capabilities.
* Delivery Excellence and Customer Outcomes
* Ensure reliable delivery across cloud operations and managed services, with clear ownership of SLA/KPI performance, service quality, capacity and customer health.
* Chair or support weekly operational governance, monthly service reviews, quarterly business reviews and executive governance forums.
* Lead resolution of critical incidents, customer escalations, resource conflicts and cross-functional delivery risks; ensure corrective and preventive actions are sustained.
* Oversee onboarding, transitions, service standardization, operating-model maturity and continuous improvement across global and regional engagements.
* Stakeholder and Global Leadership
* Act as the senior India delivery interface for global service owners, regional delivery leaders, business units, Finance, HR, PMO and customer leadership.
* Represent India delivery in strategy, growth, transformation, service-roadmap and operational-review forums.
* Build trusted stakeholder relationships, maintain transparent communications and influence decisions on offshore growth, investment and capability expansion.
* Prepare leadership presentations, executive updates, service reviews and crisis communications.
* Financial and Commercial Governance
* Own annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, cost-center governance, cost optimization and investment decisions for the delivery area.
* Monitor revenue, margin, utilization, billable versus non-billable deployment and resource chargeability; address leakage and billing disputes.
* Govern overtime, shift allowances and special payments in accordance with policy and business need.
* Support pricing, rate-card reviews, resource costing, RFPs, business cases, solutioning and customer presentations.
* Risk, Compliance and Business Continuity
* Maintain an active risk register covering skill concentration, capacity gaps, attrition, SLA exposure, security, compliance, infrastructure disruption and major incidents.
* Ensure business-continuity and disaster-recovery readiness through backup ownership, cross-skilling, critical-role succession and tested escalation paths.
* Coordinate India-specific workplace, attendance, labor-law, facility and local compliance requirements with the relevant functions.
* Ensure audit evidence, SOPs, service catalogues, RACI matrices, handover documents and organizational repositories remain current and accessible.
* Technology, Automation and Transformation
* Provide strategic technical governance and participate in architecture reviews, technical due diligence, major escalations and transition approvals.
* Shape automation, AI, productivity, platform transformation and cloud-strategy initiatives; track benefits and adoption.
* Drive service maturity roadmaps, common standards and reusable best practices across locations, customers and service lines.

**Experience And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline; MBA or equivalent business qualification is advantageous.
* Typically 15+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, cloud operations, SAP managed services or enterprise managed services, including 5+ years in a senior delivery leadership role.
* Demonstrated ownership of large, multi-customer or multi-service delivery organizations, preferably in an India offshore / global delivery model.
* Strong understanding of managed cloud operating models, service governance, ITIL practices, incident/problem/change management, transitions and service-level management.
* Commercial acumen across budgeting, forecasting, utilization, margin, pricing, invoicing and workforce-cost decisions.
* Experience working with global stakeholders and customers across cultures, time zones and matrix organizations.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms, SAP landscapes, automation, observability, security/compliance and AI-enabled operations is desirable.
* ITIL 4, cloud certifications (Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud), SAP certifications, PMP/PRINCE2 or Lean Six Sigma are advantageous.

jobs.title: Area Manager - Credit & Operations
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONAREA MANAGER – CREDIT & OPERATIONS

**Industry:** NBFC- Gold Loan  
**Location:** Thiruvananthapuram / Assigned Area  
**Department:** Credit & Operations  
**Reporting To:** Regional Manager / Head of Operations

1. Job Purpose

The Area Manager – Credit & Operations will be responsible for managing credit operations, customer visits, loan appraisal and approval, branch performance, business development and portfolio quality across assigned branches.

The position requires an experienced professional who can balance credit discipline with business growth, regularly visit branches, motivate employees, support customer acquisition and ensure efficient branch operations.

The Area Manager will play a key role in improving business performance across Gold Loan, Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan products.

2. Duties & Responsibilities

**A. Branch Visits & Business Development**

* Visit every assigned branch at least once a week.
* Review branch-wise business performance, loan disbursements, outstanding and collection efficiency.
* Motivate Branch Managers and employees to improve business sourcing and achieve assigned targets.
* Conduct regular meetings with branch teams to review performance and business plans.
* Identify local business opportunities and support branches in acquiring new customers.
* Participate in important customer meetings and assist branch teams in converting high-value loan proposals.
* Identify operational and business challenges and provide suitable solutions.
* Monitor staff productivity and provide guidance to improve individual performance.
* Develop strategies to improve branch business across Gold Loans, Business Loans and Commercial Property Loans.
* Submit weekly branch visit reports with observations, business updates and action plans.

**B. Customer Visits & Credit Assessment**

* Conduct regular customer visits for Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan proposals.
* Visit business premises, commercial establishments and properties to assess customer credentials and business activities.
* Evaluate customer repayment capacity, business operations and financial position.
* Independently verify information provided in loan applications and identify discrepancies.
* Meet prospective and existing customers to understand their financial requirements.
* Support branch teams in handling high-value and critical loan proposals.
* Ensure proper field verification and due diligence before recommending loan proposals.

**C. Credit Appraisal & Loan Approval**

* Review and evaluate loan applications across assigned branches.
* Assess customer eligibility, repayment capacity, income documents and credit history.
* Ensure proper assessment of collateral, property valuation and legal documentation.
* Review and approve or recommend loan proposals within delegated authority.
* Ensure adherence to credit policies, lending norms and product-specific eligibility criteria.
* Identify potential credit risks and take preventive measures.
* Ensure proper documentation and verification before loan disbursement.
* Improve credit processing turnaround time without compromising lending standards.

**D. Gold Loan Operations**

* Monitor gold loan appraisal procedures and ensure adherence to company guidelines.
* Ensure accuracy in gold purity testing, weight assessment and valuation.
* Monitor Loan-to-Value (LTV) compliance and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct surprise inspections and verification of gold packets and vault procedures.
* Ensure proper custody, security and reconciliation of pledged gold ornaments.
* Monitor gold loan renewals, closures, overdue accounts and auction procedures.

**E. Business Loan & Commercial Property Loan Operations**

* Supervise credit evaluation and processing of Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan applications.
* Review financial statements, bank statements, income documents and business cash flows.
* Ensure proper property valuation, legal scrutiny and title verification for property-backed loans.
* Coordinate with legal, technical and credit teams for timely processing.
* Ensure compliance with approved lending policies and sanction conditions.
* Monitor documentation, disbursement and post-disbursement compliance.

**F. Branch Operations & Process Control**

* Monitor daily branch operations and ensure operational discipline.
* Conduct periodic branch inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure proper cash management, document custody and record maintenance.
* Review daily transactions, disbursement reports and operational MIS.
* Identify process gaps and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and operational guidelines.

**G. Portfolio Monitoring, Collections & Recovery**

* Monitor branch-wise portfolio performance and overdue accounts.
* Track NPA, delinquency and collection efficiency.
* Identify early warning signals and potentially stressed accounts.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers for recovery and overdue reduction.
* Ensure timely follow-up of maturing and overdue loan accounts.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve portfolio quality.

**H. Team Management & Motivation**

* Guide, supervise and motivate Branch Managers and branch employees.
* Train branch teams on credit policies, documentation and operational procedures.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and operational training.
* Ensure accountability and adherence to defined responsibilities.
* Support branch teams in achieving business and collection targets.
* Build a customer-focused and result-oriented working culture.

**I. Compliance, Risk Management & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with applicable RBI regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor KYC, AML and customer due diligence requirements.
* Coordinate internal, concurrent and statutory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Report operational irregularities, fraud indicators and policy violations to management.
* Ensure effective implementation of risk management practices across branches.

**J. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare and review branch-wise credit and operational performance reports.
* Monitor loan sanctions, disbursements, outstanding, collections and overdue positions.
* Submit periodic reports to Regional Management / Head Office.
* Analyse operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Prepare weekly branch visit reports and follow up on pending action points.
* Support management in implementing business growth and risk management strategies.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Branch Visits:** Minimum one visit to every assigned branch every week.
* **Business Growth:** Improvement in branch-wise sourcing and loan disbursements.
* **Customer Visits:** Regular field visits for customer verification and credit assessment.
* **Credit Approval:** Timely appraisal and decision-making.
* **Branch Motivation:** Regular performance meetings and staff engagement.
* **Credit Quality:** Effective control over NPA and overdue accounts.
* **Gold Loan Operations:** Accuracy in appraisal, LTV compliance and gold security.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Audit scores, process adherence and documentation quality.
* **Collections:** Improvement in recovery and collection efficiency.
* **Reporting:** Timely submission of weekly and monthly MIS reports.

4. Candidate Profile

* Graduate / Postgraduate in any discipline; finance or banking qualifications preferred.
* 8–15 years of experience in Banking or NBFC operations.
* Strong experience in credit appraisal, loan operations and branch administration.
* Exposure to Gold Loans, Business Loans and Loan Against Property / Commercial Property Loans.
* Experience in handling multiple branches or geographical areas preferred.
* Good knowledge of RBI regulations, KYC, AML and credit risk management.
* Strong customer relationship, business development and team leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly

JOB DESCRIPTION Zoho Books Accountant K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons Kasaragod, Kerala Position: Zoho Books Accountant Department: Accounts & Finance Location: Kasaragod, Kerala Employment Type: Full-time Reporting To: Management / Accounts Head 1. About the Company K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons is an established cashew processing and trading company with a legacy dating back to 1945. The company is engaged in cashew kernel processing, domestic and international trading, procurement of raw cashew nuts and sale of cashew by-products. We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible accountant with practical experience in Zoho Books and GST compliance to manage our accounting operations. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Zoho Books Management - Maintain complete and accurate accounting records in Zoho Books. - Record daily sales, purchases, receipts, payments and journal entries. - Maintain customer and supplier ledgers. - Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable. - Ensure timely and accurate accounting entries. - Maintain proper documentation of all financial transactions. B. GST & Statutory Compliance - Prepare and verify GST sales and purchase data. - Coordinate preparation and filing of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B. - Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records. - Verify GST input tax credit eligibility. - Coordinate with external auditors and tax consultants. - Maintain TDS records and assist with statutory compliance. C. Banking & Financial Transactions - Perform bank reconciliations regularly. - Monitor customer collections and supplier payments. - Maintain cash and bank books. - Prepare payment schedules. - Track outstanding receivables and payables. D. Inventory & Stock Accounting - Maintain inventory records in Zoho. - Monitor raw cashew nut purchases and stock. - Track cashew kernel grades and quantities. - Maintain stock records of finished goods, packing materials and by-products. - Reconcile physical stock with accounting records. - Coordinate with factory and stores personnel for stock verification. E. Sales & Purchase Accounting - Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices and debit/credit notes. - Ensure correct GST rates, HSN codes and tax classifications. - Track customer outstanding balances. - Monitor supplier balances and payment due dates. - Maintain proper records of domestic and export transactions. F. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare periodic reports for management, including: - Daily sales and purchase reports. - Customer outstanding and ageing reports. - Supplier outstanding reports. - Stock and inventory reports. - Monthly Profit & Loss statement. - Cash flow and fund position. - Expense analysis. - Product-wise and business-wise profitability reports, wherever data is available. 3. Required Qualifications & Experience - B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification. - 2–5 years of accounting experience. - Hands-on experience in Zoho Books is essential. - Good knowledge of GST and Indian accounting practices. - Experience with inventory accounting. - Knowledge of Excel and spreadsheets. - Experience in manufacturing, processing or trading businesses will be an advantage. 4. Skills & Competencies - Strong accounting fundamentals. - High accuracy and attention to detail. - Good analytical and reconciliation skills. - Ability to independently manage daily accounting operations. - Good communication and coordination skills. - Integrity, confidentiality and accountability. - Ability to meet deadlines. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The performance of the accountant will be evaluated on: 1. Accuracy and completeness of accounting entries. 2. Timely completion of bank reconciliations. 3. Timely GST preparation and compliance. 4. Accuracy of customer and supplier balances. 5. Timely submission of monthly MIS reports. 6. Accuracy of inventory and stock reconciliation. 7. Timely identification and reporting of accounting discrepancies. 6. What We Expect We expect the accountant to take ownership of the company's accounting system, ensure that all transactions are properly recorded and reconciled, and provide reliable financial information to management for decision-making. The objective is to maintain a transparent, accurate and well-organised accounting system through Zoho Books.

Pay: ₹8,500.00 - ₹42,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role **Head of Business Technology Intelligence**.

* Recognising data as an asset to HSBC by managing Data Risk and ensuring we are compliant with our Data standards and policies;

The role ensures that data is structured, governed, trusted, and managed as a strategic asset, enabling effective decision-making, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and technology transformation.

  

The role leads the development and execution of the organisation's data architecture, data quality, lineage, metadata, and data management capabilities, establishing robust controls and standards across the technology estate while driving adoption and accountability throughout the organisation.

Enterprise Data Model Ownership:

**Senior Manager, BG&C**
========================

Req ID: 124671

Department: GO - GCC Bengaluru

Division: Group Operations

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Manager, Business Governance & Controls (BG&C), leads the first-line operational risk and control agenda for the Bengaluru GCC. The role establishes a consistent and effective risk and control environment aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite and enterprise risk framework, while ensuring business and functional leaders retain clear ownership of their risks and controls.

  

As the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, the role provides independent-minded advice and constructive challenge, strengthens risk culture and operational resilience, and enables well-informed business decisions. The role also leads the continuous improvement of control testing, assurance insights and governance reporting across the GCC.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Full Time, Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Manager, BG&C, you will:

  

* Develop and execute the GCC first-line risk and control strategy, aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite, enterprise risk framework and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Establish and maintain a consistent GCC-wide approach to identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring and reporting operational and compliance risks, with clear business ownership of risks and controls.
* Act as the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, providing timely advice, evidence-based insights and constructive challenge to support informed decision-making.
* Lead GCC-wide risk assessments across operational, technology, cyber, data, third-party, people, conduct, regulatory and change risks, ensuring material exposures and emerging themes are identified and addressed.
* Oversee the GCC operational resilience agenda, including first-line oversight of critical operations, material service providers, intra group arrangements, business continuity and key dependency or concentration risks.
* Coordinate GCC implementation of relevant enterprise and regulatory risk requirements, including PACT, NFR framework changes and CPS 230-related obligations, in partnership with Group Risk and specialist teams.
* Lead the design, uplift and consistent application of control testing methodologies, quality benchmarks, documentation standards and review practices across GCC teams and portfolios.
* Champion data-led and automated testing approaches where appropriate, ensuring enhancements are well governed, scalable and improve the quality and efficiency of assurance outcomes.
* Synthesise risk assessments and control testing outcomes into clear, prioritised insights for the GCC Leadership Team and relevant governance forums, including transparent escalation of material weaknesses, systemic issues and non-compliance risks.

* Oversee the quality and progress of remediation, challenging whether actions address root causes and provide sufficient evidence of sustainable closure, while retaining accountability with the relevant business owner.
* Lead first-line coordination of internal, external and in-country audits for the GCC, ensuring effective business engagement, timely responses and disciplined tracking of agreed actions.
* Build a strong risk and compliance culture by coaching leaders, strengthening accountability and promoting open, transparent engagement across businesses, functions, second line, Audit and other key stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the BG&C team, ensuring effective resourcing, clear priorities and the skills and capability required to meet current and future GCC needs.
* Drive continuous improvement of the GCC risk and control environment, supporting business, process, systems and automation changes while ensuring associated risks are understood and appropriately managed.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

**‘Must have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* Strong degree of know-how and ability to drive strategic initiatives
* Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, including control taxonomies and enterprise risk standards.
* Knowledge of regulatory obligations relevant to conduct, compliance, and operational risk.
* Awareness of business processes, control design principles, and first‑line risk responsibilities.
* Analytical capability to interpret data, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey risk messages clearly and influence stakeholders.
* Ability to assess control adequacy and effectiveness, including root‑cause analysis and evidence evaluation.
* Stakeholder engagement and relationship‑building skills, with confidence to challenge constructively.
* Planning and prioritisation skills to manage testing cycles, competing workloads, and quality standards.
* Experience delivering control testing, quality assurance, or risk assessment activities in a regulated environment.
* Demonstrated involvement in analysing business processes and identifying control gaps or compliance issues.
* Strong understanding of risk management and operational risk
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead discussions and partner effectively with stakeholders across geographies
* Knowledge of banking processes and/or products
* Extensive experience in enterprise risk management and/or leadership roles within the banking, financial services or KPO sectors
* Knowledge of retail banking products and processes
* Demonstrated experience in risk and compliance management
* Strong stakeholder management
* Demonstrated experience in people leadership and capability development

**‘****Good to have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* ERP systems and Risk toolkits
* PACT

**Qualifications**

jobs.title: Director – Precious Metals Sales
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Organization Unit Purpose**

The Precious Metals business originates, structures and delivers physical and financial precious metals solutions for the Bank’s corporate, institutional, commercial and wealth clients. The unit connects client coverage with trading, structuring, operations, legal, credit and compliance capabilities to build a scalable, well-controlled and profitable bullion franchise across the UAE and ENBDs network markets.

**Job Purpose**

The Director – Precious Metals Sales is responsible for originating and growing precious metals revenue by developing client relationships and delivering solutions across physical bullion, price-risk management, financing and investment products. The role leads opportunity identification, solution design and transaction execution while ensuring suitability, documentation, conduct, operational readiness and risk requirements are fully satisfied.

The job holder will contribute to the strategic development of the Bank’s precious metals franchise, deepen wallet share across existing relationships, acquire new-to-bank flows, and position the Bank as a trusted regional liquidity, financing and physical bullion partner.

**Job Content**

**Sales strategy and revenue delivery:**
Develop and execute a client and product sales plan to achieve annual revenue, volume, profitability and franchise objectives. Maintain a disciplined pipeline, identify white-space opportunities and convert prospects into recurring business.

**Client origination and relationship management:**
Build senior relationships with banks, refiners, bullion traders, jewellery groups, retailers, family offices, sovereign-linked entities and large corporates. Lead account planning with relationship teams and coordinate multi-product engagement.

**Physical bullion solutions:**
Originate and execute outright sales and purchases of allocated or unallocated gold and silver, minted and investment products, consignment, deferred-payment structures, import/export flows, custody and vault-related solutions, subject to approved product and risk frameworks.

**Hedging and investment solutions:**
Advise clients on precious metals price-risk management and investment requirements using approved spot, forward, swap, option and structured solutions. Translate market views into suitable, executable ideas without compromising conduct or suitability standards.

**Financing and balance-sheet solutions:**
Partner with structuring, credit and relationship teams on gold loans, bullion repo, inventory or transit financing, collateralised structures and other approved precious metals financing solutions.

**End-to-end transaction leadership:**
Coordinate pricing, credit, documentation, KYC, sanctions screening, logistics, insurance, settlement, vaulting and post-trade follow-up. Escalate execution risks early and ensure responsibilities are clearly assigned.

**Market intelligence and franchise development:**
Monitor precious metals markets, regional physical premiums, competitor activity, regulation, refining and supply-chain developments. Provide actionable intelligence to clients and management and support new product, corridor and partnership development.

**Governance, risk and controls:**
Operate within approved mandates and policies covering market, credit, legal, operational, conduct, financial-crime and reputational risk. Maintain complete records and ensure transactions meet relevant internal approvals and regulatory requirements.

**Cross-functional collaboration and leadership:**
Work closely with trading, structuring, research, operations, finance, legal, compliance, credit and coverage teams. Share product knowledge, support joint client meetings, coach junior team members and strengthen a collaborative sales culture.

Achieve financial targets

Originate profitable client flows, manage the opportunity pipeline and deliver an appropriate mix of recurring and strategic transactions.

Expand client franchise

Build account plans, conduct regular senior client engagement and create cross-sell opportunities with coverage teams.

Deliver execution excellence

Lead transactions from idea through settlement, align internal stakeholders and resolve issues promptly.

Build strategic capability

Identify market gaps, support product development and establish scalable routes to market across priority jurisdictions.

Maintain strong controls

Ensure suitability, approvals, documentation, KYC, sanctions, credit and operational controls are completed before execution.

Strengthening team and connectivity

Share market and product expertise, support junior colleagues and improve coordination across sales, trading and support functions.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, engineering or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.
* CFA, FRM or relevant treasury/commodities qualifications.

**Experiences**

Minimum 10 years of relevant banking, precious metals experience, including a strong record in client-facing sales and revenue generation. Experience with physical bullion and/or precious metals derivatives is required.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of gold and silver markets, physical supply chains, spot/forward/swap pricing, hedging, financing and settlement conventions.
* Understanding of vaulting, logistics, custody and refining ecosystems is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to originate opportunities, build senior relationships, negotiate commercial terms, manage a pipeline and convert complex requirements into executable solutions.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Client centricity and trusted-adviser mindset
* Commercial judgement and revenue orientation
* Precious metals market expertise
* Strategic thinking and market development
* Negotiation and influencing
* Execution discipline and attention to detail
* Risk awareness, integrity and control ownership
* Collaboration, leadership and talent development

There’s never been a better time to join Emirates NBD.

We’re one of the region’s most recognizable brands. We’re banking innovation leaders. We’re growing across both the UAE and our global offices. We offer a huge range of professional development opportunities to accelerate your career. It also goes without saying that we provide extremely competitive rewards, benefits and perks too, like our flexible work policy so you can work from home whenever it suits.

At ENBD, we encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for positions that match their skills and capabilities.

**The Role**
As a Director, Islamic Finance (GCB 3) you’ll help develop and execute the Islamic finance agenda across the HBME MENAT region, based in the UAE. Working as a subject matter expert, you’ll support business growth through transaction origination, structuring, execution and Shariah governance. You’ll partner with relationship managers and product teams to deliver Shariah-compliant financing solutions that meet client needs while maintaining regulatory, risk and control standards. The role also covers launching new Islamic products across the CIB platform, from due diligence through to implementation. Success means delivering scalable Islamic structures, progressing opportunities from concept to closing and supporting consistent practices across jurisdictions. You’ll bring market awareness and practical judgement to help keep our propositions relevant and well governed.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Shape and execute the Islamic finance agenda across the HBME MENAT region
* Partner with relationship managers and business heads to identify and convert Islamic financing opportunities across GCC and wider MENAT
* Structure and execute Islamic finance transactions across bilateral and syndicated financing, structured finance and asset-backed transactions
* Draft and review Islamic term sheets, indicative proposals, transaction structures and approval papers
* Coordinate Shariah adviser engagement and governance forum approvals to resolve Shariah-related matters
* Oversee transaction progression through credit approval, Shariah approval, documentation, conditions precedent, closing and post-closing requirements
* Develop and launch new Islamic finance products across the CIB platform including due diligence, manuals, processes and client materials
* Strengthen risk, controls and conduct outcomes by identifying execution risks early and ensuring appropriate reviews and auditability

**What We're Looking For**

* Bring substantial experience in Islamic finance gained within a bank, financial institution or relevant market participant
* Demonstrate deep GCC experience with proven exposure to the UAE market
* Show a track record of originating, structuring and executing Shariah-compliant financing transactions
* Evidence collaboration with relationship managers and coverage teams to progress opportunities from origination to execution
* Apply proven capability across bilateral financing, syndicated financing and structured finance
* Demonstrate experience drafting Islamic term sheets and reviewing transaction documentation with external legal counsel
* Apply strong working knowledge of AAOIFI Shariah standards and relevant UAE regulatory and Shariah governance requirements
* Show experience supporting or delivering new Islamic product launches including operational implementation with internal stakeholders

**Building Shariah-Compliant Growth**
If you want to work at the centre of Islamic finance origination, structuring and product expansion across MENAT, this role offers a rare mix of advisory depth and execution responsibility. You’ll help clients access Shariah-compliant solutions across corporate and investment banking needs while keeping standards of governance and control front and centre. The scope spans complex transactions, new product delivery and close partnership with coverage teams and control functions. If this matches the work you’ve done and the impact you want to have, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Vice President – Investments and Funding (UAE National)

jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

To lead EDB’s investment and funding strategy by managing multi-asset portfolios and optimizing capital deployment across fixed income, equities, and private equity. The role ensures efficient liquidity and cost of funds through structured funding solutions, including public/private issuances and repo facilities. It also involves overseeing portfolio performance, regulatory compliance, and execution of investment and funding activities aligned with the bank’s strategic objectives, while driving cross-functional collaboration and revenue growth.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Formulate, evaluate and implement investment policies, guidelines, asset allocation, selection of external investment managers, risk management, compliance monitoring and rebalancing through advanced planning and management of investment risk at strategic, managerial and operational levels.
* Manage the investment portfolios, analyze market trends and economic indicators as well as execute trades based on their analysis.
* Construct and continuously manage the fixed income portfolios within the approved parameters to generate alpha (risk-adjusted return) for the bank.
* Utilize cash flow planning for the funds and investments across a multi-year time horizon to assist in strategic decision-making.
* Align investment goals with the overall objectives of the bank and position portfolios accordingly.
* Conduct detailed financial analysis of the private equity portfolio, coupled with arranging quarterly performance calls with their senior management teams, attending AGMs, developing exit strategies (where required), and apprising EDB management periodically.
* Assess the funding needs of the bank, develop funding strategies, source potential investors, and formulate capital structure strategies to advise on capital investment decision making and ensure compliance with financial regulation.
* Choose the most cost-efficient effective funding solutions for the bank to minimize CoF while continuously revamping the mix to achieve optimum results
* Grow the short-term financing tools and manage liquidity of the bank by establishing a Repo framework in accordance with GMRA guidelines to optimize returns or to raise funding using fixed income securities
* Execute all tasks related to any existing or new issuances by the bank (public or private), including deliberations with the JLMs (Joint Lead Managers), external counsels and auditors, securities exchanges, regulators, rating agencies, etc.

**Operational Responsibilities:**

* Originate, price, execute, book, manage and monitor investments like Fixed Income securities, Listed and Unlisted Equities, Repo and Reverse Repos and other investments.
* Assess the bank’s cash positioning, including forecasts, and recommend ways to utilize idle funds by identifying potential investment opportunities
* Anticipate interest rate shifts and optimize trade timing to secure favorable terms with brokers and banks while negotiating terms like interest rates, yield, pricing, before making any investment decisions, ensuring alignment with EDB Investment guidelines and objectives.
* Rotate cash across assets classes or within the same asset class to optimize returns in the short term (when required), while focusing on maximizing the annuity income for the bank on a longer-term risk adjusted net-FTP basis
* Manage the private equity portfolio, review and analyze the company’s yearly valuations, attend EGMs & AGMs, report to senior management on company’s performance, manage dividend payouts, capital reductions or injections, including devising exit strategies
* Coordinate with the Risk Management and Compliance teams to ensure exposure remains within the limits defined with adherence to CBUAE and Basel regulatory requirements
* Partner with EDB’s Balance Sheet Management function to understand the bank’s funding requirements in the short, medium and long term.
* Perform market scan with banks, investors and other external counterparties to select viable funding solutions for the bank and recommend the same to ALCO
* Work with internal as well as external stakeholders, from origination to completion, to close the selected approved financing solution
* Transact Repo and Reverse Repo trades to manage short-term financing needs in accordance with approved guidelines. This requires the presence of an approved Repo framework, including a Product Manual, Standard Operating Procedure (SoP), and Operational Risk Assessment Plan (ORAP) duly signed off. Additionally, all transactions must be supported by executed GMRA agreements with counterparties, a functional collateral management operation, established counterparty limits, and a pricing mechanism with clearly defined haircuts.
* Draft and submit memos related to the Investment and Funding businesses to the relevant committees of the bank for approvals as per the DoA matrix
* Coordinate with the MIS team/Finance to deliver periodic performance updates as well as reports for senior management’s review and monitoring
* Evaluate and manage the bank’s capital adequacy, liquidity, profitability, and other ratios with the Risk department.
* Cultivate strong relationships with external counterparties while managing internal stakeholders with an equal amount of care and responsibility.
* Ensure all revenue, cost, and volume targets are delivered under the stipulated guidelines.
* Be the key driver in delivering a larger share of the P&L responsibility for T&I.
* Conduct constructive and meaningful discussions with senior management, using market knowledge and business expertise to build trust and affinity, leading to better performance results
* Develop and implement sound business practices across all investment as well as funding related activities/operations to promote efficiencies in work processes.
* Maintain a trusted partner status with Middle Office, Market Risk, Finance, and Operations.
* Comply 100% with all Legal, Risk, Compliance, and Operational requirements as well as ensure there are no breaches
* Function within the framework and boundaries of EDB’s policies as well as overall organizational and governance frameworks
* Maintain adherence to Treasury & Investments policies, procedures, and processes that comply with the leading practices, laws, and regulations
* Take decisions as per the approved authorization matrix.
* Always maintain the highest standards of work ethics, making sure that one operates in a professional environment, there are zero compromises on compliance or principles, any breaches of limits, etc. are immediately escalated, and all activities are performed under the approved audit framework

Andersen is hiring an Enterprise PMO Lead in Abu Dhabi for a transformation program focused on governance, operations improvement, and business process optimization.

The project is focused on a strategic back-office transformation program aimed at improving governance, coordination, and operational processes. jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Description:**

This role is responsible for the ongoing monthly testing of the Quality Assurance program for all Wealth clients records in UAE. The Post Execution Quality process is a key risk indicator that is reported to the regulators monthly. The PEQ process is reviewed numerous times a year by Regulators, Internal Audit and Compliance Testing to ensure adherence to regulatory and Citi-wide policies and standards. This role is responsible to test the Post Execution Quality accuracy to ensure all KYC Quality reporting is in line with our regulatory commitments to the OCC. This role is responsible for independently testing each PEQ analyst and report all findings to the Head of Wealth KYC Quality for effective oversight of personnel.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

This role is critical in identifying any quality deficiencies immediately, raise self-identified issues for proper oversight and execution on the correction action plans in a timely manner. Without this role and process, KYC could introduce significant risks related to regulatory and internal audit findings for insufficient KYC program and controls. These results would lead to significant remediation population, remediation populations, procedures changes or even MRA (Matters Requiring Attention) if identified by a regulator.

Partner with internal units to ensure adequate due diligence process is carried out for customer accounts and documentation reviews.

Ensure all information and documentation comply with local regulation and Citi standards.

Ensure all AML risks are mitigated based on local regulation and internal procedural requirements.

Review all screening activities and making sure all true, false, and potential matches are dispositioned correctly including sanctions related activities, if applicable.

Update and review forms according to local regulation requirements and work with Compliance to expedite documentation reviews, providing clarification as needed.

Appropriately assess and verify CIP requirements based on internal and global requirements.

Strong understanding of wealth holding vehicles which includes the various structures, legality, and documentation for each type of entity.

Participate and assist with the organization of weekly meetings and calls to discuss “Sustainability and Remediation” population.

Appropriately assessing risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

**Reporting and Governance:**

* Establish standards for evidence quality, naming, ownership, version control, retention, permissions and audit traceability.
* Lead evidence coordination and quality review with process and control owners.
* Develop automated monitoring and continuous control-testing capabilities where supported by reliable data and repeatable testing logic.
* Define appropriate governance for automated testing, including data quality, access, change control, exception handling and periodic validation.
* Explore the responsible use of AI to support evidence review, control mapping, testing preparation, exception identification, thematic analysis and reporting.
* Ensure that automation and AI retain appropriate governance, validation and human oversight.

**Leadership and People Management:**

* Lead and develop the India-based Chief Technology Controls Team, initially comprising three VP-level control resources.

* Promote a constructive, evidence-led risk and control culture.
* Provide broader local Technology Management or Operations oversight only where formally assigned.

**Decision Authority (Within delegated authority, the role may):**

* Approve the proposed testing plan and material scope changes before governance submission.
* Determine testing methods, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and quality standards.
* Require additional evidence, expanded testing or retesting.
* Escalate material control failures, overdue remediation and inadequate risk acceptance.
* Prioritise team activity and allocate testing resources.
* Recommend control improvements and automation opportunities.
  ***Control owners remain accountable for operating their controls and remediating identified weaknesses. Risk acceptance remains subject to approval under the applicable risk-management framework.***

**Experience and Skills:**

* Significant experience in technology risk, technology controls, IT audit, cyber risk or a related discipline within regulated financial services.
* Experience leading a technology control-testing or management-assurance programme.
* Strong knowledge of control design and operating effectiveness testing, including walkthroughs, evidence assessment, sampling, reperformance and issue validation.

* Ability to work effectively across jurisdictions and multicultural teams.

**Job Summary**

Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.

Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).

The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will help in migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.

------------------------

• Partner with Global Head of IRRBB in developing and recommending risk mitigation strategies based on the findings from stress tests and scenario analyses. Ensure that these strategies are effectively communicated and implemented across relevant business units.

**Business**  
• Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates, with a focus on the Group’s participation in the Digital Assets and platforms space.
  
• Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
  
• Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

**Processes**  
• **Analytics:** Support the newly developed IRRBB analytics capabilities on a regular basis, including operating the RCO IRRBB calculation engine to run bespoke scenarios and extracting and analysing the results, covering key metric including, but not limited to, Weekly NIIS Flash, Hedging Strategy Assessments, Corporate Plan NII impact simulations and PV01 analysis.
