The primary role is to make direct contributions to the engagement team by assisting healthcare sector clients on Organization Readiness and integration or carve-outs in a deal / M&A scenario.

  

**Delivery of specific capability in Pharma M&A: DT & PMI**

**Organization readiness in a post deal integration:**

* Understand the integration vision and strategy set out in the deal objective
* Work with C-suite executives, business and internal firm stakeholders to identify integration guiding principles
* Identify the target operating model, organization construct and governance model for the consolidated entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100), desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans
* Contribute in Integration Management office (IMO) for end-to-end program management of workstreams involved in the Integration process
  

**Integration support for post-deal activities:**

* Program / Integration/ Transformation management office planning and readiness
* Day 1 / 100 Readiness planning
* Assess the IT landscape and identify the areas of synergies / dis-synergies
* Vendor evaluation and selection
* IT spend analysis (including vendor contract reviews for any hidden transactional costs), provide recommendations on the cost efficiencies
* Bid formulation and vendor management
* Facilitate execution of the post deal integration of IT operations and organization
  

**Carve-out and separation:**

* Develop the separation strategy and assess the separation readiness
* Evaluate financial and operational entanglements / interdependencies
* Identify the operating model, organization construct and governance model for the re-structured entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100) and desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans
* Contribute in managing the Separation Management Office (SMO) across the workstreams
* Assess the TSA requirements, prepare TSA schedules and TSA exit strategies
* Cost modelling for one-time and recurring costs due to separation (stranded cost, standalone costs etc.)
* Define step- wise separation road map
  

**Commercial and Operational Diligence and Transformation:**

* Evaluate the strategic and commercial feasibility of a deal / transaction
* Evaluate the current business capabilities and identify red flags on operational issues/risks
* Assess the Post deal consolidation and transformation opportunities
* Leverage industry best practices and Deloitte accelerators to define methodological approach to consolidation / separation
* Undertake detailed functional integration planning (e.g. Sales and Marketing, operations, Finance, IT, HR etc.) for Day 1 /100 and End state
* Support delivery of functional plans
  

**Synergy / dis-synergy assessment & delivery:**

* Identify areas of potential synergies / dis-synergies and establish the degree of integration required
* Define road map for delivery of synergies and advise on synergy benefits tracking
* Work with functional leads on Synergy realization
  

**Key skills required:**

* Candidate should be able to demonstrate experience of working on large transformations including pre-deal or post-deal M&A transactions in healthcare/pharma/hospitals space
* Candidate should possess good knowledge of healthcare chain from a business standpoint
* A strong and demonstrated interest in consulting with 8+ years of relevant experience in financial services industry preferably banking
* Relevant understanding of technology landscape of a Healthcare organization would be a key differentiator
* Excellent academic credentials for both undergraduate and graduate coursework. MBA preferred
* Strong advanced MS Excel and MS PowerPoint skills
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal
* Leadership qualities and the ability to mentor junior consultants and analysts
* Willingness and ability to take initiative and learn independently
* This role involves travelling.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer - India
jobs.description:
**Location & work modality: India , Mumbai**

**About Submer**  
  
**At Submer, we are redefining how data centers are built, integrated, and operated, with sustainability, efficiency, and innovation at the core. Our technology is designed to reduce environmental impact while improving performance and efficiency. We are a purpose-driven company with a passion for innovation and a growing global presence.**

**Your impact**

Submer India is seeking an experienced, commercially minded and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead and build the Finance function in India. This is a growth- and investment-oriented role with particular responsibility for capital strategy, fundraising and the financial architecture supporting enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion.

The CFO will own the India capital agenda within approved mandates, working with India and Group leadership to secure financing and lead transactions through financial closure. The role requires an accomplished senior finance leader with demonstrated CFO-level responsibility and a proven record of personally leading and closing capital-raising transactions, preferably within technology, infrastructure, digital infrastructure, datacentres, engineering, energy or other high-growth and capital-intensive businesses.

The successful candidate will combine capital-raising capability with strong financial stewardship, governance and compliance. The CFO must understand the complete business lifecycle, from establishment and capitalisation through growth, scaling, restructuring and potential strategic transactions and/or potential exit, and be able to operate in an entrepreneurial technology and infrastructure environment.

**What you'll do**

**1. Strategic Financial Leadership**
=====================================

* Act as a key member of the India leadership team and provide strategic financial leadership to support Submer's growth and long-term enterprise value.
* Develop and execute the financial and capital strategy for the India business, linking enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion to appropriate sources of funding.
* Partner with business and operational leadership on investments, expansion plans and commercial opportunities, providing financial insight, strategic decisions and constructive challenge.
* Build scalable financial structures, processes, controls and planning capabilities suitable for a high growth organisation
* Build long term business planning and value creation.

**2. Investment, Fundraising and Capital Raising**
==================================================

* Lead the development and execution of capital-raising strategies for Submer's India business and strategic initiatives, aligned with approved plans and funding mandates.
* Build and maintain relationships with institutional, private equity, venture capital, infrastructure and strategic investors/partners, banks, financial institutions and structured-finance providers, as relevant.
* Lead India investor and lender engagement, financial presentations and, 'fund-sourcing to fund-raising to investment' plans and subsequent discussions; *(coordinate with Group finance and support Group-led transactions under the agreed mandate.)*
* Distinguish corporate capital for enterprise growth, including growth equity, strategic investment and corporate debt, from project or asset capital, including JV/SPV equity, infrastructure debt, construction finance and project finance.
* Develop financial models, investment cases and business plans; evaluate funding structures, financing costs, dilution, security requirements and investment returns.
* Lead financial due diligence readiness, strategic investment, financial structuring and financing negotiations through financial closure, coordinating legal, tax, business and technical inputs and obtaining required approvals.
* Agree capital-raising milestones with leadership and report on funding secured, transaction progress, financing terms and deployment of proceeds; maintain appropriate investor and lender reporting.

**3. Business Lifecycle and Growth Strategy**
=============================================

Guide the business through its financial lifecycle and ensure that funding structures and financial capabilities evolve with its stage of development. This includes:

* Business establishment, entity structuring, financial planning and initial capitalisation.
* Early-stage growth, scaling, fundraising and infrastructure or project expansion.
* Financial governance, commercial growth, profitability and long-term value creation.
* Mergers, acquisitions, strategic partnerships, restructuring and business transformation.
* Transaction readiness and potential exit planning.

Align corporate growth capital, project or asset financing and subsequent refinancing or strategic transactions with business needs, risk appetite and approved return objectives.

**4. Financial Planning, Analysis and Performance Management**
==============================================================

* Lead annual budgeting, long-term financial planning, forecasts and scenario modelling.
* Monitor financial and operational performance against approved plans
* Analyze profitability, cash flow, capital requirements and investment returns.
* Track business and project performance against approved investment cases, identify variances and recommend corrective action.
* Develop management reports and financial dashboards for senior leadership, identifying risks and opportunities and enabling informed decisions.

**5. Corporate Finance and Strategic Transactions**
===================================================

* Evaluate investment and strategic opportunities through valuation, financial analysis and assessment of returns and risks.
* Lead financial due diligence and financial transaction structuring for India-led transactions; *(support Group-led transactions within the agreed mandate.)*
* Structure and financially govern joint ventures and special purpose vehicles (JVs/SPVs), including shareholder funding, debt/equity arrangements, inter-company transactions and project returns.
* Develop and oversee cash waterfalls, distributions, dividend or repatriation arrangements and investor reporting in accordance with approved agreements and applicable requirements.
* Contribute to mergers, acquisitions and strategic partnerships, working with legal, tax, banking and external advisory partners
* Support exit readiness and strategic transaction planning.

**6. Finance Operations, Governance and Compliance**
====================================================

* Establish and maintain robust financial controls, policies and governance, including oversight of capital deployment and entity-level reporting.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian accounting, taxation, corporate and regulatory requirements
* Oversee financial, accounting and statutory compliance reporting.
* Ensure timely and accurate financial management and statutory filings.
* Manage relationships with auditors, tax advisors and external consultants; *(coordinating with Group finance as appropriate.)*
* Identify and mitigate financial and business risks, including financing covenant compliance and related-party exposures.

**7. Cash Flow and Working Capital Management**
===============================================

* Lead cash flow, liquidity and working capital planning and management.
* Align liquidity and financing requirements with business growth, capital expenditure and project or JV/SPV funding commitments.
* Manage banking relationships and financing facilities
* Monitor funding availability, drawdown conditions and covenant headroom.
* Monitor capital expenditure and investment commitments and optimise the use of capital across approved business, for infrastructure- and project-based requirements.

**8. Technology and Infrastructure Business Understanding**
=======================================================

The role works closely with the head of Strategy and Business Planning for CMS, as well as the VP, Head of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA, as strategic and planning partner on all internal and external initiatives. This role will help drive the strategy and transformation of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA while collaborating with key members of the CEMEA Leadership Team, Global Visa Direct Team, and other stakeholders.
  
  
**Strategy**
This role encompasses:
  
  

* Own the end-to-end Visa Direct CEMEA strategy, and translate Visa 2030 priorities into sub-regional and country plans with clear owners and milestones.
* Set product and use-case priorities by market with Regional and Global Visa Direct Commercialization and Product teams; prioritise opportunities through market sizing, whitespace, competitor and market-share analysis.

**Business Planning & Performance**

* With Finance and key business partners, lead the annual operating plan (AOP) and multi-year outlook, target setting, OKR planning and review, scorecards and business reviews; track quarterly Opex and investment.
* Maintain one consolidated view of revenue, net revenue, AANR and other KPIs, flag gaps and risks early, and reuse CMS Data, Analytics & AI and global dashboards rather than duplicating reporting.
* Drive AANR-to-net-revenue conversion by tracking signed agreements through launch to live volume; run pipeline and AANR governance with sub-regional sales leaders and shape priority deal strategy with CMS Deals Management.

**Sales And Account Management Excellence**

* Support the sales and account management center of excellence (COE): manage sales and implementation pipelines, share sales goals with partnering client segment units and define the optimal client coverage model.
* Plan sales targets in line with the AOP; provide inputs to incentive design (SIP) and recognition programs; monitor team performance against targets.

**Communications**

* Lead materials for key cadences (MBRs, QBRs, all-staffs, Global and CEMEA LT sessions, client councils) and run the leadership operating rhythm with clear agendas, decisions and actions.
* Liaise with Global Money Movement, Investor Relations and Communications for Visa CEO, CFO, President and investment community forums.

**Execution**

* As a strategic partner to the CEMEA CMS head of BPO and head of Money Movement, organize and prioritize critical information and data for efficient decision-making and manage time-sensitive senior requests.
* Deliver strategic initiatives, from spinning up cross-functional teams to deal due diligence, and build the program management function to drive execution of key CEMEA Money Movement initiatives.

jobs.description:
We are partnering with a leading organisation to appoint a Director of AI Strategy & Transformation, a senior leadership position responsible for shaping and driving the organisation's corporate AI agenda.

This individual will work closely with the senior leadership team, including the CEO and executive stakeholders, to define the AI strategy, identify opportunities for AI adoption across the business, and translate emerging technologies into tangible business outcomes.

The role will have a strong focus on business transformation, organisational change management and AI enablement, ensuring AI is embedded into functional processes, decision-making and the wider organisational culture.

We are looking for a commercially minded AI leader who can bridge the gap between business strategy, technology and organisational transformation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and develop the organisation's overarching corporate AI strategy, roadmap and implementation priorities.
* Establish and drive the AI agenda in collaboration with the CEO, senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI to support business growth, develop new capabilities and create competitive advantages.
* Advise senior management on AI opportunities, deployment approaches, investment priorities and emerging technologies.

**Business Transformation & AI Adoption**

* Work closely with individual business and functional leaders to identify opportunities to embed AI into existing processes, products and services.
* Translate business challenges into practical AI use cases and scalable solutions, with a focus on growth, innovation and value creation rather than operational efficiency alone.
* Lead the organisation's AI transformation and change management agenda, ensuring successful adoption across business functions.
* Champion a culture of AI innovation, experimentation and continuous learning.
* Drive organisation-wide AI enablement initiatives, including the adoption of enterprise AI tools and platforms such as ChatGPT Enterprise and other productivity solutions.

**Technology & Solution Governance**

* Provide strategic oversight of AI architecture, platforms and implementation approaches.
* Maintain sufficient technical depth to engage in discussions around AI architecture, technology choices, solution design and deployment considerations.
* Work alongside technology teams, external partners and vendors to ensure AI initiatives are practical, scalable and aligned with the organisation's broader technology strategy.
* Oversee the testing, commissioning and deployment of AI initiatives, ensuring solutions deliver the intended business outcomes.

**Stakeholder & Relationship Management**

* Build strong relationships across the organisation, acting as a trusted AI advisor to senior executives and functional leaders.
* Lead discussions and workshops with business leaders to identify opportunities, address challenges and accelerate AI adoption.
* Act as the central point of leadership for the organisation's corporate AI agenda.

**Candidate Profile**

* Significant experience in AI strategy, digital transformation, technology strategy or enterprise-wide AI adoption.
* Proven experience developing and implementing corporate AI strategies within complex organisations.
* Demonstrable experience working closely with CEOs, C-suite executives and senior business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of enterprise AI, generative AI, large language models and emerging AI capabilities.
* Experience translating AI technologies into practical business applications and measurable commercial outcomes.
* Strong understanding of AI architecture, solution design and implementation approaches, without necessarily being a hands-on developer.
* Proven track record of leading organisational change management, technology adoption and cultural transformation initiatives.
* Experience engaging with multiple business functions and influencing stakeholders across an organisation.
* A confident, engaging and commercially minded individual who can build relationships, challenge conventional thinking and drive an organisation-wide agenda.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A clearly defined and actionable corporate AI strategy.
* Strong alignment and engagement from the CEO and senior leadership team.
* AI opportunities identified and embedded across key business functions.
* Successful adoption of enterprise AI tools and platforms across the organisation.
* A measurable shift in organisational culture, with AI becoming part of everyday business processes and decision-making.
* Tangible business growth, innovation and value creation through AI adoption.

jobs.description:
**About Dubai Holding:**

Dubai Holding is a diversified global investment company with investments in more than 30 countries and a combined workforce of more than 45,000 people. For over two decades, we have invested in the businesses, sectors, communities and destinations that drive Dubai’s growth and global competitiveness – building long-term, sustainable value For the Good of Tomorrow.

Our businesses span:

* **Real Estate & Land**
  – master development, land bank management and large-scale master planning aligned with the Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan

  – luxury hotels, resorts and residences, alongside an award-winning F&B portfolio across the Middle East, Europe and Asia

  – some of the region’s most-loved parks, attractions, live venues and media platforms
* **Retail & Asset Management**
  – landmark retail and lifestyle destinations, malls, community centres and residential communities
* **Community Management**
  – creating and managing sustainable, vibrant communities and districts across Dubai

  – facilities management, security and technical services that keep communities, assets and critical infrastructure running at city scale

We are building Strategy & Value Creation teams across the Group, covering three pillars: Strategy, Portfolio Management (PMO) and Technology Transformation, with opportunities at multiple levels. Each role will sit within one of our businesses. By applying to this posting, you will be considered for opportunities across the Group, and successful candidates will be aligned to the business and role that best fits their skills, sector experience and seniority.

**About the Job:**

Here’s your chance to step into the role of Director – Technology Transformation. Reporting to the VP / SVP – Strategy & Value Creation, you will lead the Technology Transformation pillar and shape the vertical’s technology, data and digital agenda. Key responsibilities include:

* Defining the technology, data, digital and AI transformation agenda and roadmap
* Building investment cases and holding initiatives accountable for adoption and benefits – not just go-live
* Leading governance of large-scale technology programmes
* Partnering with Group Technology on architecture, data platforms, security and privacy
* Leading vendor and systems integrator selection, negotiation and performance management
* Driving change management and adoption across the business
* Leading and developing the technology transformation team

**About You:**

The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:

* 10–12 years’ experience in technology transformation, digital / data transformation, technology consulting or large-scale tech programme leadership
* Proven track record shaping and delivering an enterprise tech / digital agenda for a business or major division
* Experience managing vendors and SIs at scale
* Ability to translate technology into commercial value for ExCo audiences
* Bachelor’s degree in technology, engineering, computer science or business; MBA or Master’s preferred; technology, architecture, data or programme certifications advantageous
* GCC / Dubai experience preferred

Sector experience in any of the following is highly valued and will help us match you to the right vertical:

* Real estate, master development or land
* Hospitality, tourism or destinations
* Entertainment, leisure or consumer-facing businesses
* Retail, asset management or community / property services
* Facilities management, integrated services or infrastructure operations

  

**About the Benefits:**

At Dubai Holding, we’re committed to nurturing the success and well-being of our colleagues. Join our dynamic and diverse team, and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive compensation, career development opportunities, and a collaborative work environment. We strongly believe in creating an empowered workforce that will help us build a connected city for tomorrow. We are committed to attracting the brightest minds and nurturing the most pioneering candidates who desire to make a great impact on the future of Dubai.

jobs.title: Head of People Transformation & Enterprise Process Excellence
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**

The Head of People Transformation & Enterprise Process Excellence will establish and lead a scalable, business-focused approach to transformation, process management and continuous improvement across a growing international organisation.

Reporting directly to the Chief People Officer (CPO) and operating as a senior member of the Human Resources leadership team, the Head will initially focus on transforming HR processes and the end-to-end employee experience. The role will establish the HR process architecture, assess current practices, design future-state processes, clarify process ownership and decision rights, and introduce meaningful KPIs, SLAs and governance frameworks.

The Chief People Officer retains accountability for the HR strategy, HR operating model and HR organisational structure. The Head will provide process-based insight to inform operating-model decisions and translate the agreed model into end-to-end processes, governance, roles, controls, measures and implementation plans.

The Head will also establish an enterprise process-excellence framework and practical methodology that can be adopted by other business functions. Working across organisational and geographic boundaries, the role will enable leaders and process owners to improve the performance, consistency, control and experience of their processes while retaining accountability within the relevant function.

The position combines strategic design with hands-on transformation delivery. It will ensure that organisational processes support continued international growth while reinforcing culture, values, regulatory obligations and commitment to fair, inclusive and high-quality employee experiences.

The role may commence as an individual contributor during the initial diagnostic and mobilisation period. Delivery of the broader enterprise mandate will require the timely establishment of a dedicated People Transformation and Enterprise Process Excellence team, supported by nominated process owners, subject-matter experts and enabling functions. The Head will define the required capability and phased resourcing model with the Chief People Officer. Scope, sequencing and delivery commitments will remain aligned with approved capacity and resources.

**Key Accountabilities**

1. Transformation Strategy & Leadership

* Partner with the Chief People Officer to define and deliver the People Transformation and Enterprise Process Excellence strategy.
* Translate business and growth priorities into a practical, prioritised and measurable transformation roadmap.
* Act as a trusted adviser to senior leadership on process, governance, transformation and organisational-effectiveness matters.
* Build senior stakeholder alignment around transformation priorities and develop evidence-based recommendations and business cases.
* Establish governance for transformation initiatives, including decision forums, escalation paths, risk management and benefits tracking.
* Provide transparent reporting on progress, outcomes and key decisions.

2. Alignment with the HR Operating Model

* Ensure process transformation aligns with the approved or evolving HR operating model.
* Provide evidence from process diagnostics, performance data, employee experience and stakeholder feedback to support decision-making.
* Translate the approved operating model into process architecture, workflows, governance, controls, measures and implementation plans.
* Clarify responsibilities through accountability frameworks and RACI models.
* Define effective process interfaces between HR, leaders, employees and enabling functions such as Finance, Technology, Compliance, Legal, Risk and Operations.
* Support the implementation of approved operating-model changes.

3. HR Process Architecture & End-to-End Process Transformation

* Establish a Group-wide HR process architecture covering the complete employee lifecycle.
* Lead discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, process mapping, maturity assessments and diagnostic reviews.
* Conduct gap analyses and identify inefficiencies, duplication, unclear ownership and control weaknesses.
* Design scalable, employee-focused and measurable future-state processes.
* Ensure processes are considered end-to-end, including workflows, systems, controls, decision points and employee touchpoints.
* Translate future-state designs into policies, procedures, controls, templates and implementation actions.
* Prioritise transformation initiatives according to business value, risk, employee impact and implementation feasibility.

Indicative HR Process Portfolio

Subject to agreed priorities, the portfolio may include:

* Position creation and requisition approval
* End-to-end recruitment and hiring
* Onboarding
* Performance management
* Learning, development and talent management
* Compensation, promotion, recognition and internal mobility
* Employee engagement
* Leave administration
* Offboarding, exit management and knowledge transfer

4. Process Governance, Documentation & Ownership

* Establish standards for process design, documentation, approval, ownership and change control.
* Create and maintain an accessible process repository.
* Establish regular process review and assurance cycles.
* Coordinate risk-based process health checks and conformance reviews.
* Partner with Internal Audit, Risk and Compliance functions to ensure appropriate control frameworks are embedded.
* Balance standardisation with local regulatory requirements.

5. Performance Excellence, KPIs & Service Levels

* Define KPIs, SLAs, targets, ownership and reporting frameworks.
* Introduce process-performance dashboards and review cadences.
* Use data and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain a continuous-improvement pipeline and benefits tracking methodology.
* Ensure measures drive end-to-end performance and employee experience.

6. Culture, Engagement, Equity & Inclusion

* Embed organisational values and leadership behaviours into people processes.
* Ensure fair, transparent and inclusive decision-making practices.
* Review people processes for potential barriers, bias and inconsistent application.
* Translate employee feedback into practical process and organisational improvements.
* Partner with HR leadership to strengthen accountability for employee experience outcomes.

7. Enterprise Process Excellence Capability

* Establish a practical enterprise process-excellence framework and methodology.
* Support business functions in defining process ownership, governance, KPIs and improvement priorities.
* Facilitate cross-functional transformation initiatives.
* Coach leaders and process owners on process management and continuous improvement.
* Develop a community of process owners and champions.
* Maintain clear accountability within business functions while providing specialist process expertise.

8. Technology, Data & Automation Enablement

* Assess current process-management, workflow and collaboration tools.
* Establish interim process-repository and governance solutions where required.
* Define business requirements for scalable BPM and process-management capabilities.
* Evaluate existing platforms and recommend fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Partner with Technology and business stakeholders to implement appropriate tools and workflows.
* Identify automation opportunities and improve data quality.
* Ensure technology decisions are driven by future-state process requirements and user needs.

9. Implementation, Adoption & Capability Building

* Translate approved designs into implementation plans with clear milestones and ownership.
* Develop communication, training and change-adoption strategies.
* Monitor adoption and address implementation challenges.
* Build internal process-management and continuous-improvement capability.
* Define future-state team structures, skills and resource requirements.
* Develop phased resourcing plans and supporting business cases.
* Recr

jobs.title: VCA Consulting Director, Acquiring Advisory
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary:
  
  
The Visa Consulting Director will be responsible for the growth of the Acquiring Advisory practice across CEMEA. This includes the overall strategy and successful delivery of offerings within this practice under the EMF umbrella, ensuring that it continues to grow across the region. This will require a depth of expertise in the Acquiring business, a solid understanding of the implications of the changing environment for payment service providers and the ability to design modules and set plays that will increase Visa's reputation as the leading advisor in this field. The Director will work in close cooperation with Visa's global consulting practices and with Value-Added Services, notably Visa Acceptance Solutions, and will lead a growing portfolio of Acquiring trainings, bringing a strong management consulting background and setting the standard for AI-enabled advisory delivery across the practice. Success will be measured on Visa's ability to provide proof points of growth in clients' businesses and being able to evidence the fact that we have supported our clients to define and implement strategies that will prepare them for future success.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities/Key Result Areas**

* Own and drive the Acquiring Advisory practice forward as its senior subject matter expert.
* Use this in-depth expertise to review, expand and grow the areas where Visa can support acquirers, processors and PayFacs to optimize and expand their business in a balanced manner that delivers clear results.
* Use Visa and external data to analyze client needs across the region's markets to identify opportunities for Acquiring Advisory consulting assignments with Visa's clients.
* In coordination with regional VCA teams, Country Managers, Products and Account Executives, ensure we operate as One Visa.
* Work in close partnership with Value-Added Services (VAS), and in particular Visa Acceptance Solutions, to shape joint propositions, embed acceptance solutions in consulting recommendations and generate pipeline for VAS products.
* Support the development of Acquiring Advisory project pitches and secure new consulting assignments with clients, as well as relevant re-engagement opportunities via a consultative sales approach in assigned markets under the guidance of the Hub lead and regional consulting leads.
* Deliver consulting projects. Resolve complex strategic problems. Synthesize and manage complex project structures when required. Manage, facilitate and implement consulting services and meet the client's business targets (assignment objectives, project scope, budget, paperwork, external consultants' supervision and project delivery). Ensure a seamless consulting experience for the client including all required areas/departments.
* Work on client site and/or virtually to design and project manage the implementation of recommendations as required.
* Ability and desire to mentor colleagues at all levels of the organization who are working to develop Acquiring expertise.
* Design, update and deliver the portfolio of Acquiring trainings for clients and internal Visa audiences, from executive briefings to in-depth technical and commercial programs, as an increasingly important part of the practice.
* Champion the use of AI across the Acquiring Advisory practice: embed AI tools into research, analysis, benchmarking and deliverable production, and ensure the team's AI fluency keeps pace with the fastest-moving tools available to consultants.
* Work closely with the global Acquiring practice and other global practices: share experience and project learnings in both directions, contribute to the set-up of standardized offerings, and leverage new global consulting solutions that will grow the practice.
* Take ownership of codifying best practices into reusable assets and of the ongoing build and maintenance of leading practices, new trends, business models and case studies to ensure that relevant information is always accessible and up to date.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent. Master's degree preferred.
* At least 10 years of overall experience, of which more than 5 years as a consultant in a top-tier management consulting firm with strong expertise in Banking and specifically in Acquiring — this consulting background is a core requirement of the role.
* Deep, first-hand expertise across all aspects of a payments acquiring business, including merchant solutions, processing, value proposition design, product development and launch.
* Experience gained within payment acquirers, processors, payment facilitators or card schemes is a strong plus. A combination of regional and global experience strongly desired.
* Strong facilitation and training delivery skills.
* Advanced consulting, client engagement, client contact and presentation skills. Credibility with clients and working teams and diplomatic skills to extract desired outcomes. Comfortable interacting with and presenting to senior management of clients and Visa.
* Full AI fluency and a genuine passion for AI: deep knowledge of GenAI and agentic AI concepts, capabilities and limitations, daily hands-on use of the leading AI tools, and the credibility to set and raise the AI standard for the team's research, analysis and deliverable production.
* Highly analytical with advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills.
* Superior project management skills. Fluent communicator.
* Must have financial acumen and commercial awareness skills.
* Results-driven, flexible and both internally and externally customer focused.
* Able to travel frequently and work on client site and in a multicultural environment across CEMEA.
* Self-motivated and able to use own initiative with limited direction.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with interdisciplinary groups.
* Russian language is plus.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Revenue and Profit Growth. Lead overall effort to grow [Account] account revenue and profit to emerge as a key strategic partner for [Account].
* Relationships. Leverage existing customer relationships with [Account] engineering influencers and decision makers at both executive and mid-level manager levels. Develop and expand relationships with senior and mid-level customers.
* Account Analysis, Plans and Implementation. Develop and implement in-depth analysis and strategic account planning (StrAP) for [Account] to identify key focus areas for growth including account headcount, competitive analysis, customer needs per engineering service area, SWOT, Quest relationship summary and Quest capability gaps. Make key business decisions on what services/solutions to pursue and invest in.
* Unsolicited Campaigns. Identify and lead unsolicited, strategic campaigns to grow the account. Leverage Quest relationships, influence customer decision makers, monitor milestones, track action item progress and lead the campaign proposal effort.
* Solicited Proposals. Lead and manage all solicited proposal responses for all new business services or customers. Develop plans and proposals to realize the revenue target from the account, quarter on quarter.
* Expand to New Locations/ Divisions. Develop and implement plans to enter new geographies or divisions of [Account] as per the strategic account plan.
* Customer Communications. Hold quarterly customer reviews, lead/author Account Branding Newsletters and other communications per Quest process.
* Cross Sell and Up Sell. Leverage Quest best practices and from other accounts, to develop and operationalize plans to introduce new services to [Account].
* Annual Budgets and Forecasts. Lead efforts to create annual revenue and expense forecasts as well as monthly rolling revenue forecasts.
* Lead ‘Virtual Account Unit’ (VAU). Lead sales-delivery matrixed team for [Account]. Coordinate efforts, hold weekly meetings and lead monthly report out to Quest Sales & Delivery executives.

* Deep domain knowledge of the [Vertical] Vertical, specifically [sub sectors], with knowledge of products & lifecycle, engineering & manufacturing processes, major OEMs, major engineering services suppliers, external drivers and funding.
* Strong relationships with senior and mid-level technical managers at [Account]
* [Account] engineering knowledge and complete product life-cycle knowledge including,
* Engineering processes including design, manufacturing, analysis, aftermarket, quality, fielded product support (both software & hardware)

* Decisive, analytical, strategic thinker.

jobs.title: Associate Vice President - Global Indian Premier RM
jobs.description:

**Business Description**
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Personal Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Global Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
To grow and nurture HSBC NR Premier relationships (the HNI segment of the PLB customer base) and achieve business targets as laid down and in accordance with the business plan. Manage clients with a portfolio between USD 0.5M to USD 1M. To facilitate a single point of contact for all Premier customers, anticipate needs and provide required banking/financial advisory services. The jobholder to ensure that high quality customer service is provided to customers in line with Global Premier Service Standards.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**
**Impact on the Business / Function**

* Maximize profit and achievement of the growth of Premier clients portfolio
* Achieve agreed financial targets by development of existing and new relationships
* Build effective relationships with clients to retain and develop sustainable relationships
* Complete regular reviews with clients to understand their current and long term needs and advise them on the products and services that help them achieve their goals
* Effective use of tools and information to drive client service delivery and RBWM performance
* Maintain a minimum standard of qualifying Premier clients within portfolio as stated by Group
* Build a high personal and corporate profile in the community in which you are based. Develop network of Group and External professional contacts with the aim of introducing new business, enhancing technical knowledge and promoting the brand
* Monitor and act on daily sales activity management information and other internal information tools, using them to coach the wider Branch team in support of business goals
* Establish and agree client contact strategies in line with Group operating models
* Fully utilize and input to Client Relationship Management data, ensuring all client information is complete and kept up to date

**Customers / Stakeholders**

* Own the client relationship with HSBC
* Maintain a deep understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services available from Group sources and elsewhere in order to provide the best solutions for clients and maximize revenues for Global Wealth and the Group
* Maintain highest standard of excellence in client service across the team and with individual portfolio - Ongoing analysis of client portfolios through marketing of ideas and researching clients
* Monitor client satisfaction data implementing portfolio level improvements
* Work with the broader branch, support and direct teams to ensure achievement of the business performance measures by delivering differentiated products and services to the client

**Leadership & Teamwork**

* To work as part of an integrated branch management team to ensure, standards and are met and operating models delivered
* Proactively support others through direct and indirect actions beyond activities particular to this role
* Collaborate with the wider team to deliver the Branch RBWM Performance measures and plan to support the multi-channel client journey
* Establish and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues in the wider RBWM businesses and others as appropriate to service client needs

**Operational Effectiveness & Control**

* Ensuring that sales & operations are undertaken in accordance with HSBC Bank plc FIM, BIM and Credit Policy Manual appropriate lending guidelines
* Agree and manage lending facilities within any agreed Approval Authority (RAA)
* Manage operational risk, by using relevant MI to identify risk situations and take any appropriate action to minimize loss
* Adhere to selling process and sales quality requirements
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ INM FCC office/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the AML and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of AML policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional FCC AML Office/ AML Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the AML and Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated by the AML Education Lead FCC;
* Requesting additional AML training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD & EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM RBWM is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP.
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by INM RBWM example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM RBWM customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal AML & Sanction Policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non-adherence to the policy laid down in the LoBP
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile

**Pro-tip :**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

**About the Role**

The role owns the commercial relationship and ensures each account is getting real value from Sarvam’s products, expanding into new use cases, and renewing with conviction. You are the single point of commercial accountability for your book of business. You will work at the intersection of the client, the delivery team (FDSEs, CSEs, CSMs), and Sarvam’s product and GTM leadership. What you learn in the field shapes how the company prioritises product improvements, structures pricing, and designs its post-sales playbooks. If you are someone who combines commercial sharpness with genuine curiosity about how AI products create value for enterprise clients, this role is for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the full commercial relationship across a portfolio of Sarvam’s enterprise accounts: renewals, expansion, cross-sell, and net revenue retention
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key stakeholders across your accounts, from operational teams running Sarvam products daily to CXO-level sponsors
* Drive account expansion by identifying new use cases, business units, and product lines where Sarvam can deliver incremental value
* Lead renewal negotiations end-to-end, including pricing, scope, and contract structuring, in close coordination with GTM leadership
* Run structured account reviews (QBRs, health checks, success plans) that demonstrate measurable business impact and align both sides on next steps
* Use product usage data, delivery metrics, and client feedback to proactively identify health signals, adoption gaps, and churn risk
* Work closely with FDSEs, CSEs, and CSMs to ensure delivery quality remains high and client expectations are met throughout the engagement lifecycle
* Translate client feedback, feature requests, and competitive intelligence back to product teams with enough context and specificity to be actionable
* Contribute to building Sarvam’s post-sales playbook: account segmentation frameworks, expansion motions, health scoring models, and renewal processes

**Qualifications**

* 8-20 years of experience in enterprise sales ales, account management, customer success, or post-sales roles within B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or AI/ML products
* Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets, specifically renewal rates and net revenue retention (NRR) metrics

**Required Skills**

* Commercial instinct: you segment your book by expansion potential, keep active expansion conversations going, and build business cases that land with economic buyers
* Ability to hold a technical conversation with an engineering or product team on the client side. You do not need to write code, but you need to understand how APIs, integrations, and AI workflows connect
* Strong communication skills: you can move fluidly between an operational lead, a technical counterpart, and a procurement team within the same account
* Comfort using product data and analytics to drive account decisions rather than relying on gut feel alone
* Experience working in a fast-moving environment where you build process as you go, not inherit it from a mature org

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience managing accounts in conversational AI, voice technology, language technology, or document intelligence
* Familiarity with the Indian enterprise buying landscape: procurement cycles, compliance requirements, multi-stakeholder decision-making, and government contracting norms
* Experience working alongside Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or delivery teams in a post-sales capacity
* Background in consulting, solutions engineering, or customer success before moving into account management
* Hands-on experience with CRM and customer health tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or equivalent)

**Pay range and compensation package**

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not people who match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you and you believe you can do this work, we want to hear from you.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact. Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar. High ownership and high impact, from day one. Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems. You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates. If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

**Director – Strategic Customer Acquisition & Revenue Growth**

**Location:**
Pune (Work from Office)

**Reporting To:**
COO / Managing Director

**About the Role**

We are looking for a high-energy, revenue-focused business leader who combines the mindset of a hunter with the maturity of a strategic account leader with 7-8 years of work experience. This role will be responsible for driving strategic customer acquisition, expanding existing accounts, managing key customer relationships, leading large delivery teams, and owning the P&L of assigned business units.

The ideal candidate has progressed from individual contributor sales roles into leadership positions and has successfully acquired new customers, built and expanded strategic accounts, developed high-performing teams, and delivered measurable revenue outcomes within IT Services, Technology Services, BPO, Demand Generation, Marketing Services, or Digital Services organizations.

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in startups and mid-sized organizations. Profiles from large organizations are not preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Customer Acquisition & Revenue Growth**

Identify, prospect, and convert high-value business opportunities into long-term customer relationships.

Develop and execute strategic sales plans to penetrate new markets and acquire key accounts.

Identify growth opportunities within existing customers through upselling, cross-selling, and service expansion.

Build and maintain executive-level relationships with customer stakeholders and decision-makers.

Develop account plans, revenue forecasts, and customer expansion roadmaps.

Drive customer retention, renewals, and long-term account profitability.

Own business unit P&L and profitability targets.

**2. Strategic Account Management**

Act as the primary relationship owner for strategic customer accounts.

Build strong relationships with decision-makers and influencers across customer organizations.

Ensure high customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term partnership growth.

Lead quarterly and annual business reviews with customers.

Proactively manage customer expectations, escalations, and relationship risks.

Identify opportunities to strengthen customer engagement and maximize account value.

**3. Operational Leadership**

Serve as the bridge between customers and internal execution teams.

Lead and mentor teams comprising Program Managers, Assistant Program Managers, Team Leads, and Business Development Specialists.

Ensure delivery excellence and achievement of customer SLAs, KPIs, and business outcomes.

Build scalable operational processes, governance models, and best practices.

Drive productivity, quality improvements, and operational efficiency initiatives.

Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**4. Business Strategy & Governance**

Present monthly and quarterly business reviews, revenue forecasts, strategic plans, and performance achievements.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, Digital, and Delivery teams to improve customer outcomes and accelerate business growth.

* The Executive Director, Client Coverage, Public Sector is the strategic adviser and relationship lead for a portfolio of major public sector clients, primarily across the Middle East and Pakistan. The portfolio includes central banks, ministries of finance, government entities and agencies, export credit and development agencies, multilateral organisations, regional development banks and selected development organisations. The role is accountable for developing senior client relationships, originating and delivering relevant solutions across Transaction Banking, Financial Markets and Global Banking, and achieving sustainable revenues and returns while maintaining strong credit, financial crime, conduct and regulatory risk discipline. The role also supports the regional team head on origination and client engagement across the region and selectively develops approved prospect relationships.

**Portfolio Strategy And Financial Performance**

* Lead client strategies through disciplined account planning and deliver agreed revenue, profitability, RoRWA and franchise objectives for the designated portfolio.

**Origination And Trusted-adviser Coverage**

* Build senior relationships up to ministerial and C-suite level, anticipate client needs, originate new business and position the Bank as a consistent strategic partner rather than a transactional provider.

**Integrated Client Solutions**

* Mobilise Transaction Banking, Financial Markets, Global Banking, structuring, advisory and industry partners to deliver relevant solutions, deepen inbound flows and selectively deploy balance sheet where supported by appropriate ancillary returns and Group economics.

**Sustainable And Innovative Finance**

* Originate and structure sustainable finance solutions including debt-for-nature, debt-for-development and sustainable loans, and replicate successful structures across the public sector segment.

**Risk, Compliance And Portfolio Stewardship**

* Own client acceptance and ongoing risk management, including AML, CDD and credit; maintain accurate account plans, call reports and deal pipelines; identify, escalate and resolve conduct, regulatory, reputational and credit issues.

**Market Insight And Franchise Development**

* Maintain strong knowledge of political, macroeconomic, country-risk and industry developments; bring international best practice, investment opportunities and thought leadership to clients; support investor roadshows, RFPs and industry engagement.

**Collaboration And Execution**

* Maintain effective relationships with Country and Cluster leadership, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Client Management and product teams; ensure timely meeting notes, coordinated execution and high-quality client outcomes across the Bank network.

**Role Scope**

* This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. The role holder is expected to contribute to team capability, knowledge sharing, diversity initiatives and the development of colleagues through informal coaching and collaboration.

**Individual Contribution and Team Leadership**

* Operate as a senior individual contributor, providing leadership through client judgement, execution discipline and collaboration across the regional Public Sector franchise.
* Invest in personal development, share knowledge and support the development of colleagues through coaching, inclusive teamwork and participation in learning and diversity initiatives.
* Maintain mandatory learning, professional development and risk-awareness standards applicable to the role.
* Share sector, thematic and market insights with clients and internal partners to strengthen strategic engagement and the Bank’s market position.

**Motivations**

* Strategic client impact: Energised by solving complex public sector priorities and building trusted relationships with senior government, central bank and development-institution stakeholders.

* International collaboration: Thrives in a cross-border environment that requires judgement, resilience, teamwork and effective mobilisation of the Bank’s network.

**Key Experiences, Qualifications And Languages**

* 10+ years of relevant banking experience, preferably in senior relationship management, origination or sales covering public sector, sovereign, financial institution or development-finance clients.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex client relationships, originating cross-product opportunities and coordinating execution across Transaction Banking, Financial Markets and Global Banking.

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

jobs.title: Emerging Markets Lead – MENA (Arabic speaking)
jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
As Column’s Emerging Markets Lead, you will spearhead one of our most strategic international expansion initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for driving 0-to-1 growth for a new banking product, with a particular focus on building and nurturing relationships with prospective partners and customers in select markets, with a specific focus on markets within MENA. This role combines global expansion strategy, business development with hands-on relationship management, requiring a general business athlete who thrives on networking and executing complex partnerships. This is a unique opportunity to be on the founding team for a new business line, with significant autonomy and direct impact on Column’s global expansion strategy.
  
  
This position will be based in Dubai with regular travel throughout the region and occasional travel to Column’s headquarters in San Francisco.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead regional market development: Own the end-to-end process of identifying, evaluating, and executing on high-value partnerships with banks across a number of international markets.
* Build and maintain key relationships: Serve as the primary relationship owner for prospective and existing customers, conducting regular in-person meetings, attending local industry events, and managing ongoing partnership development.
* Own partnership execution: Lead complex deal processes from initial outreach through contract signature, working collaboratively with Column’s Legal, Compliance, and Product teams.
* Develop market intelligence: Gather and synthesize insights on local market conditions, regulatory developments, competitive landscape, and customer needs to inform Column’s regional strategy.
* Market expertise and network: Become an expert on the correspondent banking space in our key emerging markets and build an extensive network within their banking and fintech ecosystems.
* Drive operational excellence: Build scalable processes for onboarding, relationship management, and ongoing support that can be replicated as we expand.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* 6+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, growth, operations or strategy in a high-caliber environment
* 4+ years of business experience specifically in MENA
* Native fluency in Arabic and experience managing business relationships with Arabic-speaking clients and stakeholders
* Track record of successfully managing complex partnerships and high-value deals with executive stakeholders
* Natural networker who thrives on building trust and long-term relationships with senior executives, market experts and decision-makers
* Strong strategic thinking - ability to assess market opportunities, evaluate potential partners, and provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership
* Hyper-organized approach to project management, including coordinating efforts across multiple teams; comfort juggling multiple projects and priorities is critical
* Scrappy, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude - we thrive because we work harder, are more creative, and have zero ego when it comes to getting our hands dirty to build a business

**We look forward to hearing from you**
Column is committed to working with the best and brightest people from the broadest talent pool possible. We value bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences, and believe a diversity of ideas is what allows us to develop the best solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please reach out to accommodations@column.com.

jobs.title: Account Management Specialist
jobs.description:
**Department:**
Merchant Business
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
UAE
  
  
**Description**
**About Tabby:**
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 20 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.
  
  
The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 40,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
  
  
Tabby generates over $14 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.
  
  
Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and now has an implied valuation of $4.5 billion.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The Account Management Specialist manages a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving long-term growth, retention, and product adoption across accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor, the specialist is responsible for developing account strategies, identifying revenue opportunities, and delivering data-driven recommendations that maximize merchant performance and business outcomes.
  
  
This role requires strong commercial acumen, analytical capabilities, and stakeholder management skills. The Account Management Specialist is expected to operate independently, lead strategic merchant conversations, influence decision-making, and drive the adoption of Tabby's full product suite. The role also plays a key part in cross-functional initiatives, process improvements, and strategic projects that support broader business objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Strategic Account Management:**

* Own and manage a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving retention, growth, and long-term partnership success.
* Build relationships with key decision-makers and act as a trusted advisor to merchants.
* Develop and execute account growth plans aligned with merchant objectives and Tabby's commercial strategy.

**Revenue Growth & Product Expansion:**

* Drive revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and expansion of Tabby's products and services.
* Identify opportunities to increase product penetration across the portfolio, including new and existing solutions.
* Lead commercial discussions and proactively position relevant products based on merchant needs and performance insights.
* Own pipeline generation within the portfolio and track expansion opportunities through to execution.

**Data Analytics & Portfolio Optimization:**

* Analyze merchant performance, transaction trends, conversion metrics, and product adoption to identify growth opportunities and risks.
* Translate complex datasets into actionable recommendations that improve merchant performance and revenue contribution.
* Conduct portfolio reviews, business reviews, and strategic performance discussions with merchants.
* Build dashboards, reports, and presentations to support data-driven decision-making.

**Strategic Projects & Business Initiatives:**

* Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives, product launches, operational improvements, and merchant experience enhancements.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and support automation and scalability initiatives across the business.
* Partner with leadership and cross-functional teams on high-impact commercial and operational projects.

**Merchant Success & Problem Resolution:**

* Proactively identify merchant challenges and business risks before they impact performance.
* Take ownership of complex merchant escalations and coordinate stakeholders to drive timely resolution.
* Ensure merchants receive strategic recommendations and solutions that support continued growth.

**Cross-Functional Leadership:**

* Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Risk, Finance, and Tech teams to deliver merchant solutions and achieve business objectives.
* Act as the primary point of coordination for strategic merchant initiatives requiring cross-functional involvement.
* Influence internal stakeholders and drive alignment to achieve successful merchant outcomes.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
* 3-5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, Business Development, or a similar client-facing role.
* Proven experience independently managing enterprise or strategic accounts.
* Strong commercial mindset with demonstrated success in driving revenue growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
* Advanced analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into business recommendations.
* Experience conducting portfolio reviews, business reviews, and presenting performance insights to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives and priorities simultaneously.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Technical teams.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics tools.
* Experience within fintech, payments, BNPL, e-commerce, or technology industries is preferred.

Job Benefits
  
  

* We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well at times that suit you and your team.
* A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
* You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career.
* Participation in the company’s employee stock options program.
* Health Insurance.
* Flexi Perks: a monetary benefit to spend on what matters most to you — health, well-being, education, or professional development.
