jobs.title: Account Director, Private Sector (MEA & Turkey)
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.
  
  
TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.
  
  
TRM helps financial institutions detect and stop illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to private sector clients including banks, payment providers, crypto natives and fintechs across MEAT. You will own the Private Sector business in a territory where TRM is building coverage, setting account strategy and strategic deals with compliance and risk leaders. What makes this seat unusual is a large greenfield territory plus the freedom to shape your own go-to-market with local partners and AI-assisted research.
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**

* Open new private sector accounts across the MEAT region. Working with internal and external stakeholders to build effective networks to deliver commercial execution of TRM’s services to leading private sector organisations across the region.
* Win a mixture of high velocity and larger more strategic engagements, by turning AML and fraud pain points into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans and proposals that you sharpen with your own market judgment.
* Own and define the model to build a 3x qualified pipeline each quarter through targeted campaigns, using AI-assisted segmentation and local-language messaging, and measure what converts.
* Decide how TRM enters each market, choosing between direct selling, resellers, and regional partners, and back each choice with AI-assisted analysis of account data.
* Grow strategic existing customers engagements through renewals, upsells, and new use cases.
* Bring customer and regulatory insight back to Product and Marketing so the next release matches how banks in your region actually work.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years selling SaaS or data products into banks, payment firms, crypto or fintechs in MEAT, or 4+ years with deep AML and financial crime expertise, plus experience using AI tools to research and prioritize accounts.
* A record of closing a mixture of quick deal cycle and strategic longer term, higher value engagements and meeting quota, with AI-supported forecasting and pipeline reviews.
* Working knowledge of regional AML and sanctions frameworks and how compliance, risk, and procurement teams buy.
* Hands-on use of AI for prospecting, account planning, and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.
* Experience building pipeline in a new territory, forming human lead networks and AI-assisted tools to test and measure what works.
* Credible, clear communication with senior compliance and risk executives, in person and virtually, including AI-assisted preparation for each meeting.
* Fluent English, other relevant languages including Arabic, Turkish, French a bonus
* Based in Dubai and willingness to travel regularly across the region.

**About The Team**

* TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director full ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.
* The team collaborates closely and supports one another through shared pipeline insight, deal reviews, and open sharing of what works.
* The work is hard in a useful way: regulated buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a product category that is still new to many banks.
* You will work with RevOps, Marketing, Legal, Product, and Solutions Architecture, who move quickly to back your deals.

**Learn About TRM Speed In This Position**

* Within your first 30 days, you rank every target bank and fintech in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.
* When a compliance leader asks for a demo late on a Friday, you and TRM’s Solutions team deliver it that day, turning a warm inquiry into a scheduled evaluation by Monday.
* Within 90 days, you build qualified pipeline worth at least 3x your quota, backed by an account plan for every Tier 1 target.

**Team Operating Rhythms**

* Distributed, not distant: the team works across Gulf time, and occasional US calls on complex deals.
* Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses.
* Weekly 1:1 with your manager, a weekly team call, a weekly pipeline call, a weekly forecast call, and regular pod calls.
* Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission.

**Required Online And Collaboration Hours**

* Schedule: Core hours overlapping Gulf Time, with flexibility for occasional US calls.

**Application Instructions**
If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.
  
  
Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.
  
  
If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.
  
  
**Interviewing with TRM**
Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.
  
  

* Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.
* Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
* First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
* Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
* References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.
* Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.
* Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.
  
  
**AI Fluency at TRM**
AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.
  
  
We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.
  
  
At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To
  
  

* Accelerate repeatable workflows
* Structure and solve problems
* Improve output quality
* Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.
  
  
**Life at TRM**
We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.
  
  
TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.
  
  
Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.
  
  
**At TRM, You Should Expect**

* Priorities and targets to change quickly
* Operating with a high degree of ambiguity
* A high level of personal ownership and accountability
* Close collaboration across teams and functions
* Frequent, high-touch communication
* Creati

jobs.title: Sales Director / Manager - Africa
jobs.description:
Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 170 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.
  
  
We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.
  
  
**Job Description**
The
**Sales Director / Manager – Africa**
is responsible for driving
**revenue growth, market expansion, and strategic client acquisition**
across the region. The role owns the
**end‑to‑end sales lifecycle**
, including pipeline development, strategic account management, complex deal structuring, and executive‑level stakeholder engagement, while working closely with
**delivery, product, marketing, and partner ecosystems**
to ensure sustainable growth and customer success
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Regional Revenue & Growth Ownership**

* Own and deliver regional sales targets, pipeline coverage, and forecast accuracy.
* Drive new logo acquisition and expansion of existing strategic accounts across banking, wealth management, asset management, and capital markets.
* Develop and execute country‑level and segment‑specific go‑to‑market strategies aligned with regional priorities (GCC, Levant, North Africa).

**Strategic Account & CXO Engagement**

* Build and maintain C‑suite relationships (CEO, CIO, COO, Heads of Wealth, Digital, and Transformation).
* Lead complex, multi‑stakeholder sales cycles, including RFPs, negotiations, and commercial structuring.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients on business transformation, platform modernization, and regulatory change.

**Sales Execution & Deal Leadership**

* Lead the full sales lifecycle: opportunity qualification, solution positioning, pricing, contracting, and closure.
* Partner with pre‑sales, solution architects, and delivery teams to shape winning proposals and value‑based business cases.
* Ensure governance, compliance, and internal approval processes are followed for all deals.

**Partner & Ecosystem Development**

* Build and manage a strong regional partner ecosystem (system integrators, advisory firms, technology partners, introducers).
* Identify and execute co‑sell and joint go‑to‑market initiatives with strategic partners.
* Strengthen regional market credibility through alliances and industry presence.

**Market Intelligence & Competitive Positioning**

* Track market trends, regulatory changes, and competitive dynamics in the Middle East.
* Provide structured feedback into product, pricing, and regional solution strategies.
* Position differentiated value propositions against global and regional competitors.

**Team Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead, coach, and develop sales and account management teams (where applicable).
* Foster strong collaboration with marketing, delivery, governance, and operations teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Contribute to regional leadership forums and management committees.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Regional revenue achievement and pipeline coverage
* New logo wins and strategic account expansion
* Forecast accuracy and deal governance compliance
* Average deal size and margin quality
* Partner‑sourced revenue contribution
* Client satisfaction and long‑term account sustainability

**Qualifications**

* Experience: Minimum of 15 years of proven sales experience in the banking, wealth management, or financial technology (fintech) industry, with a track record of exceeding sales targets, especially in the Middle Eastern region.
* Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of the banking, wealth management, and financial services landscape, including regulations, technology trends, and challenges faced by financial institutions.
* Sales Skills: Demonstrated ability to sell complex software solutions to senior executives, with expertise in consultative and solution-based selling methodologies.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts in a clear, concise, and persuasive manner.
* Relationship Management: Proven ability to build, nurture, and maintain strong client relationships, with a customer-centric approach to sales.
* Leadership: Ability to work independently and collaborate with a team, manage multiple opportunities simultaneously, and mentor junior team members.
* Education: Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. MBA or relevant certifications in sales or financial services is a plus.
* Technical Proficiency: Comfortable using CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.), Microsoft Office Suite, and other sales and presentation tools. Familiarity with banking and wealth management software is advantageous.
* Proficiency in English. French & Arabic language would be an added advantage.

**Additional Information**
We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
  
  
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
  
  
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
  
  
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

jobs.title: Customer Success Director
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
The Job in short
  
  
As a Customer Success Director at Backbase, you will be at the forefront of driving customer satisfaction and success across the Middle East You will be responsible for ensuring that our customers derive maximum value from Backbase’s Engagement Banking Platform. This role involves frequent travel across the region and requires a strong ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders at all levels, from C-suite decision-makers to programme leaders.
  
  
Your mission is to foster product adoption and license consumption, enhance customer satisfaction, and contribute to Net ARR Growth by ensuring that our customers successfully leverage Backbase's solutions to achieve their business goals.
  
  
Meet the Job
  
  

* Customer Relationship Management:

Develop and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with key customers across your region.
  
  
Regularly engage with senior stakeholders to understand their evolving needs and expectations throughout the software development lifecycle, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor and valuable resource.
  
  
Facilitate complex discussions that involve multiple stakeholders, helping to align their goals with Backbase's solutions and unblocking any adoption and license consumption challenges.
  
  

* Value Maximization:

Collaborate with customers to identify opportunities to maximize the value they derive from Backbase products.
  
  
Work with Backbase Customer Advisory to localize business cases. Provide strategic guidance and best practices to ensure business cases align to the region and bank specific goals, ensuring customers are fully utilizing the range of product capabilities available to them.
  
  
Proactively identify and address potential challenges, working towards solutions that align with the customer’s business objectives.
  
  
Develop joint success plans with senior stakeholders, with clear objectives that are aligned with their strategic goals.
  
  
Actively work with the customer on roadmap planning to track and ensure the realization of the business case throughout the programme lifecycle.
  
  

* Advocacy Building:

Identify and cultivate customer advocates who are willing to share their success stories and experiences with Backbase solutions.
  
  
Collaborate with marketing teams to create case studies, testimonials, and other materials that showcase customer success.
  
  

* Feedback Collection and Product Improvement:

Gather and analyze product utilization, and end user feedback on product experiences, providing actionable insights to R&D and steward the Request for Feature (RFF) process as a joint responsibility with the Services team.
  
  
Act as a bridge between customers and Backbase’s product development organization. Work with the Backbase UX Research team, ensuring that customer needs and suggestions are considered in future product enhancements.
  
  

* Account Management:

Proactively manage renewals by aligning customer success plans and business cases with value realization, ensuring continued customer satisfaction and retention.
  
  
In collaboration with Sales, identify opportunities for account growth by understanding the banks’ business dynamics and leveraging them to expand ARR.
  
  
**How About You**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Business, or a related field.
* Experience: 10+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, including consulting, customer support, delivery or account management in KSA, with a focus on customer success in the technology or software industry.
* Technical Acumen: Previous experience in roles requiring technical understanding, particularly in customer success management within a software company.
* Language Proficiency: Fluent in Arabic, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in English is also required.
* Customer-Centric Mindset: Passionate about delivering success for customers, with a deep commitment to understanding customer needs and delivering solutions that exceed their expectations.
* Results-Driven: Strong focus on customer satisfaction, with the ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights and maintain dashboards that drive product adoption and customer success.
* Relationship Builder: Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to challenge, negotiate, influence, and persuade stakeholders.
* Autonomous and Cross-Functional: Ability to work independently, take ownership of customer success initiatives, and drive results, while collaborating across teams with Sales, R&D and Services colleagues, as well as Backbase’s partner network.
* Organizational Skills: Capable of prioritizing tasks, multitasking, and demonstrating adaptability in a dynamic environment.
* Commercial and Functional Acumen: Understand the unique cultural and digital trends in the customer’s market and speak to business drivers, with a strong focus on maximizing value for customers. Experience in banking or other Financial Services is a plus.
* Frequent Traveler: Willingness to travel frequently across the region to engage with banks and ensure their success with Backbase.

This role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on Backbase’s customer success, helping our customers achieve their strategic goals while driving growth and adoption of our engagement banking platform and other solutions.
  
  
Job Details
  
  
Role Level: Director Work Type: Full-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: www.backbase.com Job Function: Customer Service Company Industry/
  
  
Sector: Financial Services
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
**About The Company**
Searching, interviewing and hiring are all part of the professional life. The TALENTMATE Portal idea is to fill and help professionals doing one of them by bringing together the requisites under One Roof. Whether you're hunting for your Next Job Opportunity or Looking for Potential Employers, we're here to lend you a Helping Hand.
  
  
Report

We do NOT endorse any requests for money payments and strictly advice against sharing personal or bank related information. We also recommend you visit Security Advice for more information. If you suspect any fraud or malpractice, email us at abuse@talentmate.com.

jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**Job Summary / Introduction**
The role holder is primarily responsible for working with Coverage teams in structuring Cash and Trade solutions, managing and growing of Transaction Banking business across the UAE. The role holder will be a member of the team covering GTB Sales in the UAE.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and develop Cash and Trade business opportunities and profitability across the UAE on a sustainable basis, and making sure the customer experience is to the highest level.
* New Business: Responsible for Cash and Trade product growth jointly with the coverage teams in UAE. Plan and execute calling plans for each industry segment in conjunction with relationship managers (as appropriate) to deepen Cash and Trade product penetration across client portfolio.
* Use of consultative approach along with the Cash and Trade knowledge and experience to design and implement suitable innovative solutions for customer’s needs.
* Responsible for structuring complex cash management deals and responding to RFPs with a high-quality level, ensuring FAB is properly perceived by our customer base.
* New Markets & Products: Structuring of bespoke open account solutions (SCF & RF) and ensure a high-quality customer experience through consultative approach, design and implementing workable and innovative solutions for customer’s needs. Responsible for structuring Trade deals and providing technical expertise to client base and relationship managers.
* CASA Generation: Structure liquidity and liabilities solutions that drive CASA growth while ensuring best-in-class customer experience.
* Regulatory Oversight: Manage proactively the fraud and compliance risks in the Cash and Trade business when developing solutions for clients.
* Digital Penetration: Facilitate conversion of all existing and new to bank customers on to FAB’s electronic channels.
* Pipeline Discipline: Work with the coverage to build and maintain a strong Cash and Trade pipeline while remaining focused on pipeline deal mandate closures. This includes regular review and communication to the relevant stakeholders.
* Partner with coverage teams to develop quality credit proposals supporting structuring of Trade facilities and proactively managing transactional risk in an efficient and profitable manner. Ensure ancillary business in cash management is ring-fenced to FAB.
* Service Delivery: Collaborate with other stakeholders to Ensure that customer comes first by delivering best-in-class service.
* Business Liaison: Maintain close liaison with intra region and cross regional stakeholders to bring about network connectivity to facilitate cross border transactions and opportunities where possible.
* Customer lead generation/origination to increase share of wallet with existing relationships by deep selling new Cash and Trade products and support
* Coverage team to generate new revenue opportunities from new to bank clients and opportunities.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Provide technical expertise to coverage and partner with coverage teams to develop quality proposals and RFPs that win mandates.
* Driving Cash and Trade sales for clients, in line with specific needs of clients.
* Delivery of specific revenue targets, CASA/liabilities, returns on risk adjusted assets and equity consistent and commensurate with the Bank’s acceptable risk parameters and pricing.
* Work closely with coverage teams and make the unit head aware of performance gaps in your portfolio.
* Actively engage with client together with the Unit Head and Coverage team to build business for the Bank.
* Responsible for structuring Cash & Trade deals and providing technical expertise to relationship managers and facilitate client discussions. This includes structuring Cash and Trade transactions, responding to RFPs and providing technical expertise to relationship managers.
* Participating in and contributing to deal teams where transactions require bespoke Cash and Trade solutions.
* Establish strong stakeholder relationships and work with colleagues and partners across the network to build a strong pipeline.
* Partner with coverage teams in contributing to quality credit proposals supporting structuring of existing and new Trade facilities.
* Proactively managing transactional risk in an efficient and profitable manner.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement of products, systems, processes, and practices while considering client needs, market developments and trends.
* Actively participate in opportunities to update product skills, understand market trends and competitor behaviours.
* Work closely with Coverage teams across the region and network to propose new markets, clients, and products.
* Work with Coverage team on creating detailed Key Account Plan for growing trade business and maximize market share.
* Closely monitoring utilization of Trade facilities and cross sell non-credit trade products / services to deepen client wallet.
* Understand and comply with regulations and internal policies i.e., Credit/ Compliance/ Operational Risks, etc.
* Work closely with Cash & Trade Product innovation team in UAE to finalize documentation/ structures/ rollout new trade products/ solutions.
* Understand and apply Business Delegation of Authority Matrix accordingly.
* Compliance with regulations and internal policies i.e., Credit/ Compliance/ Operational Risks, etc. Understand the bank’s risk framework and the relevant internal policies including the lines of defence.

**Requirements / Qualifications**

* Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Commerce, or equivalent discipline.
* 10+ years Transactional Banking Experience with specialized knowledge and experience in Cash Management, Payments, Liquidity Management, Core Trade
* Finance and Value Added Trade Finance.
* Candidate should have a track record in Origination, managing a portfolio of relationships and meeting specific portfolio KPIs and development of client relationships, both new-to-product and new-to-Bank.
* A highly motivated and experienced salesperson with a track record of originating new clients and driving revenues within a portfolio of corporate clients.
* Strong Client network with focus to grow Cash and Trade business for the bank in the region.
* Strong technical knowledge in Cash and Trade Finance products including core and value added Trade Finance. Cash Management products including
* Payments and Digital/Electronic Channels; Collections and Reconciliation tools, Account Services, Liquidity and Liabilities management.
* Self-starter who can handle all enquiries relating to Cash and Trade Finance independently.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills as well as a team player.
* Strong origination capability coupled with excellent customer orientation & negotiation skills.
* Strong communication skills.
* Self-confident and performance driven. Ability to work under pressure and with a strong delivery focus.
* Ability to articulate, formulate and deliver high quality client presentation.
* Understanding of operations processes and procedures, and related risk in cash and trade transactions.
* Familiar with the regulatory environment concerning financial industry in UAE.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Development - Digital Giant Segment
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Business Development - Digital Giant Segment
  
  
**Overview**
1- Overview
  
  
Market Development is looking for a Manager, Business Development, Digital Giant Segment to build, develop and manage the Digital Giant segment key strategic clients across the EEMEA markets. The primary objective of the role is developing the strategy and growing revenue in the segment across the region by identifying and pursuing opportunities with new or existing customers/markets, growing market share and deepening Mastercard’s regional footprint; embedding multiple products, platforms, and capability bundles that drive innovation and stickiness. Developing and setting sales & commercial strategies aligned with geographies and segments including pipeline management and go to market at the segment level.
  
  
The ideal candidate is passionate about leveraging payments technology to digitally transform new and emerging sectors, digital innovation, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial and commercially astute mindset.
  
  
This role will be based in UAE
  
  
2- Role
  
  

* In this high-profile, customer facing position, you will partner with the digital giants across EEMEA deepening our relationship with them across the key marketplace segment partners . Your focus will be on deal commercializing, doubling down on acceptance, VAS, portfolio optimization including revenue diversification with a strong bottom line focus.
* You will be the ‘owner’ of Mastercard’s relationship with your assigned accounts and accountable to build mutually aligned strategies and plans with your partners and execute on them by effectively leveraging the Mastercard organization
* You will be responsible for driving Mastercard revenue growth and be comfortable developing business cases including ROI analyses as well as leading responses to RFPs.
* You will dive into financial and payment related data to be grounded in facts to provide customer specific recommendations that drive value for partners and Mastercard.
* You will be the expert on your assigned partners and learn about Mastercard’s capabilities and be ready to provide insight into a digital giants business, thinking strategically and broadly.
* You will establish day to day and senior business relationships and work with partners to create roadmaps and through QBRs and daily interactions ensure alignment on strategy and execution on agreed projects.
* You will lead negotiations with partners and with internal stakeholders and develop terms sheets and contracts.
* Build, in cooperation and input by the region, roadmap & pipeline for ecosystem to accelerate growth and commercialization
* Entrepreneurial approach; ability to quickly understand business requirements and to translate them into potential business development opportunities
* Interpersonal and negotiation skills - extensive experience in communicating in international environment at senior management level.
* Account management experience - ability to understand customer’s need marketplace dynamics, industry trends and the competitive landscape.

3-This Jobholder
  
  

* Must be capable of operating with high levels of empowerment and accountability
* Capable of operating at both a strategic and operational level
* Strong relationship management skills and ability to build effective partnerships with the relevant business stack holders from banks, government, and third-party processors
* Negotiate, execute, and manage multiple multi-market & large digital giant customers
* Develop strategies, financial modeling and business cases for identified opportunities, as well as coordinate contract development
* Leadership in developing strategy, solutioning design, obtain investment funds, sales planning, delivery, and ongoing management (customer delivery, business risk management, optimization)
* Represent Mastercard in strategic partnership programs & events.

4- All About You
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in business or equivalent work experience
* Strong written and verbal communication skills. Expertise on deal commercialization and P & L management.
* Expert relevant work experience with a core knowledge of payments, data processing concepts and financial industry/banking operations practices
* Deep knowledge and understanding of payment solutions, with significant experience in sales and business development
* Thorough understanding of the marketplace Landscape across the region
* Action-oriented and results driven and with a disciplined approach to deliver sales targets, financial analysis, and strategic development
* A passion and comfort in meeting new people and building & nurturing meaningful relationships at all levels including with senior-level and C-Suite executives.
* Strong Business Development & Relationship management expertise.
* Possess a blend of analytical capability, strategic thinking, and emotional intelligence and able to dive deep on all areas of the business to deliver creative solutions to unstructured problems.
* Comfortable aptitude for onboarding complex business and technical knowledge to a level sufficient to engage in meaningful partner discussions and identify and drive solutions.
* Enjoy collaborating with a team while working independently towards a goal.
* Strong relationship management skills - experience of managing multiple stakeholders in a multicultural environment. Strong negotiating and influencing skills, with the ability to execute through others who are cross functional teams
* Committed to quality with a strong focus on customer needs
* A team player who easily builds relationships
* Strong people management and coaching skills
* Language: fluent in English & Arabic preferred

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

As a

within
**Priority Banking**

**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. 9

**About Your Role**
Provide implementation expertise and strategic guidance for complex enterprise client implementations to support successful onboarding, conversion, expansion, and deployment of payment processing products and services. Partner with Enterprise Implementation teams, clients, Sales, Product, Operations, Technology, Credit, Compliance, Product Support, and other stakeholders to develop implementation strategies, address complex requirements, identify and mitigate delivery risks, and resolve implementation challenges. Serve as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor who helps teams navigate highly complex implementations, improve delivery practices, and ensure enterprise clients are positioned for successful production launch and transition to ongoing support.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Serve as a subject matter expert and strategic advisor for complex, high-impact, or escalated enterprise implementations involving multiple products, platforms, locations, workstreams, integrations, and stakeholders.

* Partner with Sales and pre-sales stakeholders when needed to assess implementation complexity, identify delivery considerations, clarify implementation requirements, and support effective transition from sales into implementation.

* Review implementation plans, solution approaches, requirements, project controls, readiness criteria, and other key implementation deliverables for complex or high-risk engagements and provide recommendations to project teams and leadership.

* Provide implementation insights and recommendations to leadership based on project trends, client feedback, recurring delivery challenges, emerging risks, and opportunities to improve the enterprise implementation experience.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives designed to increase implementation quality, predictability, scalability, client satisfaction, and speed to production.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

**Experience You'll Need To Have**

* 7+ years of experience leading or supporting complex enterprise implementations, payment processing implementations, technology deployments, client onboarding, conversions, or related implementation and delivery work.
* 5+ years of experience managing or advising complex projects involving multiple products, platforms, integrations, workstreams, dependencies, timelines, and internal and external stakeholders.
* Experience working directly with large enterprise clients throughout an implementation lifecycle, including requirements, planning, solutioning, testing, readiness, launch, and transition to ongoing support.
* Experience identifying and resolving complex implementation risks, issues, dependencies, escalations, and delivery challenges involving multiple cross-functional teams.
* Experience advising project teams or stakeholders on implementation strategy, project governance, risk management, readiness, and delivery best practices.
* Experience facilitating complex discussions and communicating implementation strategy, risks, recommendations, trade-offs, and decisions to client stakeholders, internal partners, and senior leadership.
* Experience applying project management and implementation methodologies to complex client engagements, including scope, schedule, risk, issue, dependency, change, and stakeholder management.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or an equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**

* Experience with Clarity, Salesforce, or similar project management, client relationship management, reporting, and support platforms.

jobs.title: Lead Architect/ Senior Associate Director
jobs.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Solution Architecture
  
  
Ready to set the architecture direction for HSBC’s CTO Platforms domain?
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Join CTO Platforms to shape the architectural direction for a value stream or domain within a large regulated bank. This role sets target and transition architectures and keeps delivery aligned to reference architectures, standards and guardrails. You’ll represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options and trade-offs and helping decisions land clearly. The role also focuses on cross-programme dependencies and early risk identification so delivery stays coherent across teams. You’ll influence strategic initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda by promoting shared platforms and governed capabilities. Success looks like simpler, reusable and well-controlled technology outcomes that engineering teams can deliver with clarity and pace.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Set architectural direction for an assigned value stream or domain aligned to target architecture, reference architectures, standards and guardrails
* Produce and maintain target and transition architectures with clear sequencing, dependencies, decision points and interim guardrails
* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts
* Identify and manage cross-programme architectural dependencies, risks and constraints and escalate early to support timely decisions
* Embed alignment to Group architecture strategy and standards including Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and control-by-design
* Shape architectural direction for strategic R&C initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda to converge on shared platforms and governed capabilities
* Translate architectural direction into solution designs with engineering teams using patterns, non-functional requirements and guardrails to maintain delivery alignment
* Strengthen solution architecture capability across engineering through coaching, quality reviews and communities of practice

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring extensive experience as a solution, domain or enterprise architect in a large complex and regulated organisation
* Demonstrate defining target-state architectures and translating them into transition states, roadmaps and decision frameworks
* Show strong experience reviewing solution designs and articulating options, trade-offs and recommendations based on evidence and standards
* Apply broad understanding of modern application, integration, data and cloud architectures including APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, CI/CD and operational non-functional requirements
* Embed security, resilience, privacy, records management and auditability requirements into designs and delivery workflows
* Apply Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and technology rationalisation including assessing Low-Code/No-Code and third-party options
* Use working knowledge of AI and GenAI architecture including responsible adoption, platform integration, data and knowledge foundations, governance, monitoring and evidence
* Operate effectively in senior governance forums and across geographically distributed teams with clear stakeholder management and influencing
* Communicate complex technology choices clearly through concise architecture artefacts for business and technology audiences

Building coherent platforms at scale
  
  
If you want to shape how platforms evolve across a complex environment this role offers the scope to make a visible difference. You’ll help teams converge on shared architectures that are easier to deliver, operate and govern. You’ll bring clarity to decisions that cut across programmes and turn architectural intent into practical delivery guardrails. If this aligns with the work you want to do next we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by – HSBC Software Development India

jobs.title: Solution Architect -VP
jobs.description:
Join us as a VP - Solution Architect at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
  
  
To be successful as a VP - Solution Architect at Barclays you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Strong experience in creating technical documents such E2E Design / High Level Design / Architectural Vision.
* Strong experience in relevant technologies (Java/.Net/Mainframe/DB2/MSSQL).
* Experience in application integration technologies (MQ, C:D, APIs).
* Experience in application infrastructure both on premises, external, and Public Cloud (AWS).
* Experience in Project Management both Agile and Waterfall.
* Able to demonstrate previous evidence of drive, energy, commitment and enthusiasm.
* Experienced technical Solution Architect.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Understanding of Trade and Working Capital domain.
* Professional certifications e.g. TOGAF.
* Experience with financial instruments deposits, loans, and treasury.
* Strong data and database architecture expertise across enterprise relational and NoSQL platforms.
* Proven leadership in regulatory driven design, ensuring auditability, traceability, model transparency, and compliance (e.g., Basel III).
* Understanding of Banking and Financial Services Industry.

Excellent senior stakeholder engagement and technology leadership, including mentoring architects, influencing roadmaps, and driving cross functional alignment.
  
  
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.
* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defence in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the banks governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures.
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design end-to-end architecture for complex, multi-tiered systems, from requirements through implementation and production support.
* Lead the transformation of traditional monolithic applications into modern, loosely coupled, microservices-based architectures.
* Design highly available, resilient, and fault-tolerant solutions for customer-facing applications operating at bank scale.
* Architect and guide the development of cloud-native applications and API-first solutions.
* Partner with engineering, infrastructure, security, and DevOps teams to ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for performance, scalability, and compliance.
* Conduct system and process analysis to identify architectural gaps and opportunities for automation and performance improvement.
* Evaluate and recommend data storage strategies across RDBMS, NoSQL, and legacy/emerging database technologies.
* Act as a technical liaison between engineering teams and non-technical/business stakeholders, clearly communicating architectural trade-offs and decisions.
* Ensure solutions adhere to banking-industry regulatory, security, and data-privacy requirements (e.g., PCI-DSS, SOX, GLBA, and internal risk/compliance frameworks).
* Contribute to architecture governance, design reviews, and the definition of reusable patterns and standards across the GCC.
* Mentor engineers and junior architects on architectural best practices (Principal level and above).

**Required Qualifications**

* 12–15 years of experience in web/software development, with progressively increasing responsibility in solutions or enterprise architecture.
* Proven, hands-on experience with the end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-tiered software systems.
* Strong foundation across multiple IT disciplines, with demonstrated understanding of core architectural concepts and patterns (e.g., SOA, event-driven, microservices, domain-driven design).
* Experience conducting system and process analysis to inform architectural decisions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions with both technical and non-technical/business stakeholders.
* Solid experience working with data and database management systems, including both legacy and modern/emerging database technologies.
* Experience with RDBMS required; hands-on experience with NoSQL is required.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building highly available, customer-facing applications in a global delivery/shared-services (GCC) model.
* Experience designing and building cloud-native applications and RESTful/GraphQL APIs.
* Demonstrated experience designing highly available, resilient architectures, including automation and performance-optimization initiatives.
* Proven experience transforming monolithic architectures into modern, decoupled microservices-based systems.
* Working experience in at least two to three of the following domains: Infrastructure, Security, DevOps, Application Development, Database Technologies, or Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or foreign equivalent); equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

**Desired / Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in the banking or financial services domain, including an understanding of consumer and custodial banking operations and experience handling sensitive financial data.
* Strong business analysis, solution-crafting, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience in cybersecurity architecture or secure-by-design principles.
* Working knowledge of multiple programming languages and at least one modern front-end framework (Angular, React, or Vue), such as Python, Java, JavaScript, Ruby, Golang, C, or C++.
* UI/UX design exposure, including familiarity with web/application branding and design-system practices.
* Cloud architecture certification(s) — AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect.
* Enterprise architecture framework knowledge (e.g., TOGAF) or equivalent certification.
* Experience working in Agile/SAFe delivery environments across distributed, global teams and time zones.

**Core Competencies**

* Technical Depth — Ability to go deep on architecture, code, and infrastructure when needed
* Strategic Thinking — Connects technical decisions to business and enterprise outcomes
* Communication — Translates complex technical concepts for varied audiences
* Collaboration — Works effectively across globally distributed, cross-functional teams
* Risk & Compliance Awareness — Understands the regulatory weight of decisions in a banking environment

jobs.title: Sr Manager - Process Transformation
jobs.description:
**Business Unit:**
Cubic Corporation
  
  
**Company Details:**
Cubic offers an opportunity to provide innovative technology for government and commercial customers around the globe, helping to solve their future problems today. We’re the leading integrator of payment and information technology and services for intelligent travel solutions worldwide, and the leading provider of realistic combat training systems, secure communications and networking and highly specialized support services for military and security forces of the U.S. and allied nations. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and thrive in an innovative environment, we want to talk to you about your next role at Cubic! We are seeking employees inspired by technology, and motivated by the rewards of hard work, commitment, teamwork, quality, integrity, and respect. We invite you to explore opportunities with Cubic.
  
  
**Job Details:**
**Job Summary:**
The Finance Operation Process leader will drive establishing baseline processes, increasing efficiency and leading continuous improvement across the finance operations teams and develop appropriate performance indicators to convey fact-based success measurements. In this role, the Finance Operations Process leader will drive the injection of contemporary finance practices rooted in automation, data modeling and integrated business planning and reporting. This position typically works under limited supervision and direction. Incumbents of this position regularly exercise discretionary and regular decision-making authority.
  
  

* Eliminate waste and non-value-added activities using Lean principles to build a results-driven, low-bureaucracy operating culture
* Apply DMAIC methodology to identify process gaps, design solutions, and deliver measurable improvements in operational efficiency
* Develop and deliver role-based training programs to drive consistent process adoption, reducing error rates and rework across Finance Operations
* Conduct regular internal audits using control frameworks to verify that process documentation is accurate, current, and compliant
* Define and track KPIs post-implementation — including cost savings, cycle time, and error reduction — to validate ROI and sustain process gains
* Lead continuous improvement and automation initiatives (RPA, workflow tools) with clear business cases showing efficiency, cost, and risk-reduction benefits
* Apply knowledge of modern finance practices — cloud ERP systems, data modeling, and automated controls — to strengthen financial operations
* Manage cross-functional project teams through full project lifecycles, from charter and scope definition to delivery and handovers using structured PM frameworks
* Perform root cause analysis on complex operational issues, developing corrective actions that align with business objectives and financial targets
* Champion a Kaizen mindset across teams, embedding a culture of incremental improvement, accountability, and quality at every process level

**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):**

The Consultant - Business Analyst is accountable for partnering with Payments Business and Operations teams to elicit, analyze, document, and validate functional and non-functional requirements for payment application upgrades and regulatory initiatives. The role provides subject matter expertise in SWIFT payments, ISO 20022, RTGS, and wire payments to support solution design, project delivery, testing readiness, and operational effectiveness. The job acts as a key liaison between business and technology partners to ensure solutions are delivered seamlessly, compliantly, and in alignment with business objectives.

**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):**

**Requirements Gathering:**

* Design and document end-to-end data flows, Data mapping documents, and data lineage to trace wire payments attributes from source in to central data repository.
* Analyze current and future state processes to ensure requirements are clear, complete, traceable, and suitable for technology implementation.
* Perform Data analysis, reconciliation, and validation to ensure data integrity, and auditability across historical and real-time wire payments stores.
* Partner with solution architects, data engineers, DBA's and QA leads to build scalable data storage, querying and reporting.
* Clarify scope, assumptions, dependencies, and constraints to support efficient project execution and reduce delivery risk.

**Solution Design:**

* Collaborate with Business, Operations, Quality Engineering, developers, and architects to design solutions aligned with business objectives and technical standards.
* Review, and validate solution design documentation to ensure completeness, quality, and alignment with approved scope and requirements.

**Stakeholder Management and Delivery Support:**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with business and technology partners to support effective communication, decision-making, and delivery outcomes.

* Provide regular status updates, risks, issues, and dependency insights to project managers and leadership to support informed decision-making.
* Coordinate with peer technology groups to ensure seamless delivery of changes across dependent systems and teams.

**Testing and Quality Enablement:**

* Support Quality Engineers on Operational Data Store (ODS) initiatives
* Review test scenarios, test cases, test results, and other testing artefacts prior to and during test execution phases to ensure coverage and quality.
* Participate in SIT and UAT support activities, including validation of business scenarios and analysis of defects and gaps.
* Contribute to defect triage discussions and recommend workarounds to support Operations teams in payment processing and settlement activities.
* Perform data analysis using SQL to validate requirements, investigate issues, and support testing activities.

**Compliance and Risk Management:**

* Incorporate regulatory, operational, and control considerations into analysis and solution definition for payments initiatives.
* Identify risks, control gaps, and compliance impacts early in the delivery lifecycle to support effective mitigation.
* Contribute to data governance, metadata, and documentation standards where applicable.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Identify and implement process enhancements to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of product and platform services.
* Recommend changes to business analysis practices, delivery processes, and documentation standards to enhance quality and consistency.
* Stay current on industry best practices, regulatory updates, and developments in the data warehousing payments landscape to inform solution design and delivery.
* Monitor changes to business processes and systems to ensure downstream data and reporting impacts are identified

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* This job works closely with Payments Business and Operations teams to elicit requirements, clarify process impacts, and validate business outcomes.
* This job collaborates with project managers to provide status updates, requirement insights, risk assessments, and delivery support.
* This job partners with developers, architects, and peer technology groups to translate requirements into effective technology solutions and ensure seamless implementation.
* This job interacts with Vendor Product SMEs to understand product capabilities, regulatory changes, and implementation considerations.
* This job supports Quality Engineering teams by providing subject matter expertise, reviewing testing artefacts, and helping resolve requirement gaps and defects.

**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines and controls.

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

* As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Supports data warehouse (ODS) initiatives across Enterprise Payments Technology.
* Provides specialized business analysis expertise for data processed from the wire engine and wire room applications
* Acts as a primary liaison between Business, Operations, Quality Engineering, and Technology partners for assigned projects and enhancements.
* Contributes to delivery of regulatory and operational changes mandated by SWIFT and/or Payments Canada.
* Provides advisory and support services

**Senior Organisational Development Consultant**
================================================

Req ID: 128692

Department: T&C Organisation Design & Implementation

Division: Talent & Culture

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

  

Organisation Design and Implementation are trusted advisors and delivery partners to T&C and the business, through a strategy led, data informed, and people enabled approach to delivering workforce transformation projects end-to-end.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Lead Organisation Design & Implementation in Talent & Culture, you’ll play a key role in helping day-to-day delivery and execution of large, complex people and workforce transformation initiatives, ensuring clear business outcomes are achieved. These initiatives may include the development of new operating models, organisation design and restructures, location or offshoring strategies, M&A people streams, data-led workforce analysis or broader transformation programs.

  

The role acts as a critical integrator across business stakeholders, T&C partners, project teams and cross-functional contributors to drive progress, manage complexity and deliver outcomes at pace. This includes leading project teams, managing risks and interdependencies, removing roadblocks, supporting governance and providing subject matter expertise across core OD&I delivery areas.

  

The role may lead a standalone program or manage a major stream within a broader enterprise transformation initiative, balancing strategic outcomes, stakeholder needs, total investment, delivery risk and time to benefit. The role will also provide strategic advice and challenge to business leaders on organisational effectiveness, operating model design, workforce impacts and implementation considerations.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type:** Permanent  
**Role Location:**  
Bengaluru  
**Work Hours:**  
Regular Shifts(Hybrid/Blended)

  

**Please note that while this advertisement is for a single role, there are multiple vacancies available for this position.**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

* Leading the end-to-end delivery of Organisation Design & Implementation initiatives across operating model, organisation design, data management, workforce transformation, restructuring and implementation.
* Providing strategic advice, challenge and subject matter expertise to senior business leaders, T&C Business Partners and project stakeholders.
* Conducting organisational diagnostics and analysis to identify opportunities, risks and recommendations relating to operating model effectiveness, workforce structure, spans and layers, capability, governance and role design.
* Developing evidence-based recommendations and implementation approaches that balance business outcomes, customer impacts, workforce experience, financial objectives and enterprise design principles.
* Leading project teams and cross-functional contributors to deliver agreed outcomes, ensuring work is planned, sequenced and delivered at pace.
* Acting as the integrator across stakeholders, workstreams and delivery teams to manage interdependencies and reduce execution risk.
* Driving decision-making by bringing structure, insight and recommendations to enable timely resolution of issues, risks and roadblocks.

**Detailed Description**
------------------------

* Supporting governance activities, including critical path analysis, risk and issue management, dependency management, stakeholder management, reporting, and supporting budget, resource and scope management.
* Identifying resourcing needs and recommending adjustments to ensure projects or programs are set up for successful delivery.
* Monitoring key metrics and measures of success, including progress against outcomes, delivery milestones, financial impacts and benefits realisation.
* Translating organisation design recommendations into practical implementation plans, ensuring changes are successfully embedded and benefits are realised.
* Supporting leaders and stakeholders through the people impacts of transformation, ensuring implementation activities are thoughtful, compliant and people-centred.
* Building trusted relationships with business leaders, T&C BPs, T&C teams, cross-functional partners and other key stakeholders to resolve issues and remove barriers to success.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

* 10+ years of relevant experience across Talent & Culture, organisational design, workforce transformation, consulting, or business transformation environments.
* Depth and breadth of experience in at least one of the OD&I core capabilities: organisation design, operating model design, restructuring, M&A people streams, workforce transformation, location strategy or data management.
* Proven experience leading complex people, workforce or business transformation initiatives from mobilisation through to implementation.
* Strong understanding of organisation design principles, operating model design, workforce analysis, role design, governance, and implementation planning.
* Ability to engage, influence and challenge senior stakeholders, including business leaders, T&C Business Partners, and cross-functional delivery partners.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams or project teams to execute complex business change and deliver agreed outcomes.
* Strong project and program management experience, including governance, critical path analysis, dependency management, issue and risk management, stakeholder management, and support for budget, resource, and scope management.
* Ability to quickly understand complex business problems, diagnose root causes and develop practical, evidence-based solutions.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, and facilitation skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and bring stakeholders together around clear recommendations.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear papers, updates, recommendations, and executive-level messaging.
* Tertiary qualifications in a relevant discipline
* Experience in supporting the professional development and capability uplift of teams.

**So why join us? (Bengaluru GCC)**
-----------------------------------

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.

  

We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.

  

We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.

  

To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You
